'dulab/ ṣā (181)3353 'dul ba tshig le'ur byas pa 3dpal 'phags pa sa ga'i lhas mdzad/bal/ ngo 'i paṇḍi ta dza yā sa ra dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong pra1 kirtis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/rgya gar shar phyogs sad na ga ra'i paṇḍi ta ba na ratna ma hā sbi bī ra la gtugs te sgra'i don la mkhas pa/ rong ston shes bya kun rig gis 'gyur cung zad bcos te gtan la phab/bsnyur mchan/153 bsdur 'bras re'u mig1663354 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i dge tshul gye tshig le'ur byas pa 167

'gal ba'i phyogs rnam par bshad pa/ 676bslab pa'i gzhi bcu bzhi pa/ sdom pa thams cad 'jig pa'i phyogs chenacas/ nga zang thab44spyad nga / 685bco lnga pa/ 'dul ba mdor bsdus pa rnam par bshad pa/ 697slob dngo na dul ba'i lhas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po budha shārnyi dang /lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(702) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(722)'dul ba/ ṣā/ / (182)3357 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i dge tshul gyi tshig /ce(byeshār /byutham thab 725slo ba dngo na klu sgrub kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po mu ni warma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba sna nam ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(731) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(732)3358 dge spyong gi kā ri kā lnga bcu pa mdo tsam du bshad pa/ 733rang gi lha la phyag 'tshal ba dang bstod pa'ibashadapa/ 733bslab pa nyams su blangs pa'i bshad pa/ ༷ 737snga dro'i dus na las gang bya ba bstan pa/ 7415

/ba /stecad bya /ba/ ༷ 40zheng1de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal ba ༷ ༷ 741mkhan po dang slob dpon la bsnyun gsol nas las su bya ba zhu ba/ 742chu la sogs pa brtag pa/ 744mkhan po dang slob dpon gyi las su bya ba bsgrub nga// 7rga(1sa nas zas bza' ba 74༅bsod nams bsngo ba/ 750/da/go /ba bya /ba/ 751phas pham pa'i gnas bstan pa/ 753srog gcod pa'i phas pham pa 753ma byen nga/ra len pa'i phas pham pa 766mi tshangs par spyod pa'i phas pham pa 772brdzun gyi phas pham pa 775bslab pa phra mo'i gnas bstan pa/ 779phyi dro phan chad kyi bya ba bstan pa/ 790ji ltar bstan pa bzhin nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu thob pa bstan pa/ ༷ ba/93slob dngo/na ka ma la shī las mdzad/basbur mchan/(794) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(799)3359 thams cad yod par smra ba rnams kyi dge tshul gye bya ba/ 800rang bi lha la phyag 'tshal ba dang bstodapa'ibashadapa/ 800bslab pa nyams su blangs pa'i bshadapa/ 803snga dre'i dus na las gang bya ba bstan pa/ 804dge tshul gyi bslab tshigs bcu bstan pa/ 811srog gcod pa'i bshad pa/ 811

zug dre)na pazang /spon pa:re btsanasprad pa/ 817mi tshangs par spyod pa'i bshad pa/ ༷ 822brdzun du smra ba'i bshad pa/ 82566pa :sgo pa//1pang ngab ngabasdonatshod nga / 83049 gar mi byu1 ba bshad pa/ ༷ 832lus la spos kyis mi byug pa bshad pa/ 833bla ma'i khri la mi 'dug pa bshad pa/ 833nyin phyed man chad zas mi bza' ba bshad pa/ 834gser dngul la mi reg pa bshad pa/ 836dge tshul dang / bla ma dang / 'og ma'i khyad par rim par bstan pa/ 837bsdur mchan/(843) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(847)336༷ dge tshul gyi bslab pa'i gzhi'i mdo/ ༷ 8rgababeeb pa'i gzhi dang po/ srog gcod pa spong ba/ 8rgababeeb pa'i gzhi gnyis pa/ ma byin par len pa spong ba/ 852basbab pa'i gzhi gsum pa/ mi tshangs par spyod pa spong ba/ 855babeeb pa'i gzhi bzhi pa/ brdzun du smra ba spong ba/ 858babeeb pa'i gzhi lnga pa/ 'bru'i chang dang btsos pa'i chang gi btung ba spong ba/ 861babeeb pa'i gzhi drug pa/ gar dang glu dang rol mo spong ba/ 862bslab pa'i gzhi bdun pa/ rgyan dang kha tog 'chang ba spong ba/ 863bslab pa'i gzhi brgyad pa/ mal mthon po dang mal chen po spong ba/ 864basbab pa'i gzhi dgu pa/ dus ma yin pa'i kha zas spong ba/ 865bslab pa'i gzhi bcu pa/ gser dngul len pa spong ba/ 866ste//skya / nga :re semabakabasgyu 15pa ngab/ 867rab tu byung ba'i rtags yang dag par blangs pa/ 8687

mdo sde 'dzin pa'i slob dpon ka spyo ṇa mi tras mdzad/kha che'i mkhan po grong khyer dpe med kyi paṇḍi ta ma hā dza na dang / shākya'i dge slong gzhon nu mchog gis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa las/ slad kyi kha che'i paṇḍi ta pa ra te ta dang /lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong gzhon nu mchog gis bcos shing zhus/bsdur mchan/(881) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(884)/tre /zhe /re /tshe /re3361 nga ga dang gang zag bsdus pa ga 'ur byas pa/ 885paṇḍi ta 'dul ba 'dzin pa shākya'i dge slong ba la shrī bha dras mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dri paṃ ka ra shrī tshwa na dang /lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong gzhon nu mchog gis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(901) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(903)3362 spyanamago grebye(ba 4) pa/pa 11:re shes 904kha che'i mkhan po na ra sa de ba dang /lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong rgyal ba'i shes rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(909) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(910)3363 pa/mgo 11pa :go pa/pa nges:re shes :dro ngas/ 911rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī tshwa na dang /lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(923) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(925)8

3364 'dul ba dri ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa 926/spo(1 tshodang nges:re :dro thab/ 926/ba(1 bkanyis pa:re :dro ba/ 928le(bye gsum pa'i dri ba/ 931/spo(bye ngab:de nga :re :dro /ba/ 932/ba(1 /snga nga /sde :dro ngab/ ༷ ༷༷ 935mdo sde 'dzin pa ka spyo ṇa mi tras mdzad/rgya gar byi mkhan ngo/ rnyarmā ka ra dang /zhu chen byi lo tsā ba bande dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(937) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(939)3365 'dul ba dri ba rgya cher 'grel pa/ 940le'u dang po'i gtan la dbab pa/ 940le'u gnyis pa'i gtan la dbab pa/ 980le'u gsum pa'i gtan la dbab pa/ ༷ 1026le'u bzhi pa'i gtan la dbab pa/ ༷ ༷ 1038le'u lnga pa'i gtan la dbab pa/ 1071mdo sde 'dzin pa ka lnga ṇa mi tras mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po rnyarmā ka ra dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1084) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1098)3366 par/du(ba ngab (ba thab/stetshod tsho// 1099btsun pa chos kyi tshong dpon byis mdzad/slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis

bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1102) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1103)3367 'dul ba la bstod pa'i tshig gi rnam par bshad pa/ 1104slob dpon dul ba'i lhas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(1122) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1125)3368 gzhung lugs kyi bye brag bkod pa'i 'khor lo/ 1126btsun pa/ dbyig gi bshes gnyen kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po rnyarmā 7 ra dang / lo tsā ba bande bzang skyong gis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1141) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1143)3369 sde pa tha dad par byed pa dang rnam par bshad pa/ 1144slob dpon bha byas mdzad/mkhas pa chen ngo/ dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na zhes bya ba'i pa/ṇḍi ta'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsnyur mchan/(1163) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1165)3370 gzhung tha dad pa rim par bklag pa'i 'khor lo las sde pa tha dad pa bstan pa basbus pa stunas com ba/ 1166slob dpon dul ba'i lhas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(1172) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1173)3371 spyan6) pa/stestezug bye) 110cab nga/ ngasasbyo1pa/ nga// 1174slob dpon chen po su na ya shrīs mdzad/10

rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang /lo tsā ba dge slong dar ma grags kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1175) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1176)3372 dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa brgyad pa'i bshad pa/ 1177slob dpon chen po su na ya shrīs mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta chen po su na ya shrī dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po dge slong dar ma grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1189) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1191)3373 rnam par grol ba'i lam las sbyangs pa'i yon tan bstan pa zhes bya ba/ )/1rdo rtenargya gar byi mkhan po beebyā ka ra pra bha dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1221) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1224)3374 gser mdog gi rtogs pa brjod pa/ 1225rgya gar gyi mkhan po rnyarma shrī bha dra dang /zhu chen byi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1357) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1370)3375 na/ cad (ba:re shestebakabasgyu nga/ ba:sdotshon pa/ 1371rgya gar gyi mkhan po padma ka ra barma dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen 11

bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1403) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1406)3376 'phags pa dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs pa brjod pa /de/ga /pho /ba 1'ju07rgya gar gyi mkhan po a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang /dge slong shākya 'od kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1418) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1419)3377 gzhon nu ma bdun gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/ 1420slob dpon gsang ba byin gyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(1440) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1442)3378 ngaba'ogangab nga ngabasdos:re byebye bka ngas(1bkabag/ 1443slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad/rtse thang lo tsā ba gzhon nu'i zhabs kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1445) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1445)3379 (pe rja'irjes/re pararjes(ba 25/ 1446rlo ba dpon rtag pa/'i rdo rjes mdzad/lo tsā ba gzhon nus bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(14go) basbur 'bras re'u mig(14go)

༄ga /'dul ba tshig le'ur byas pa/①༄༅༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ bi na ya ②kā ri kā/ bod skad du/'dul ba tshig le'ur byas pa/ bam po dang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis nyid kyi dbu yang rin chen 'od 'phro lta bu dang / /rab rgyas padma gser mdog dang 'dra'i btsun mo rnams kyang byin/ /ma lus don gnyer rab dgar mdzad nas byang chub mchog brnyes pa/ /chos 'dul zhi ba'i don du ston mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang thob ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa rnams las nges par sgol 'gyur zhing / /srid pa'i 'ching ba mtha' dag bcad nas mya ngan 'das gyur pa/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' med pa kun las sgol ba yi/ /gzings gyur gcig pu bde snegashegs kyis bstan ④chos de la yang 'dud—/ /gang yang yon tan kun ldan yon gnas dam par gang gyur pas/ /93—3

cung zad phul yang 'bras bu rgya chen shin tu 'phel 'gyur ba/ /bdag nyid kun gyis phyag 'os bde bar gshegs pas rab tu bsngags/ /gang zag brgyad mchog legs spyod ①kyis brgyan 'phags tshogs rnams la'ang 'dud/ /gang gis 'dul ba bstan pa dang / /gang gi ④gang zhig 'dul ba 'thob/ /ma dul spangs ①nas 'dul dbang gyur/ /'dul ba la ni yang dag gnas/ /chos dang 'phags pa'i tshogs bcas kyi/ /ston pa de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /gdul bya rnams ni gdul duba'i phyir/ /'dul ba las brtsams cung zad brjod/ /le lo can dang blo dman dag /gzhung mangs rnams kyis 'jigs pa ni⑤/ /legs gsungs 'dul ba'i rgya mtsho la/ /yon tan ldan yang 'dod mi byedarjo/ /de phyir de dag gzhug don du/ /skyo med 'gro ba'i che ba yi/ /tshig ler byas pa'i them skas kyis/ /rtag tu mu stegs ston byed bzhin/ /rab bsngags nor gyis ⑦phun tshogs shing / /lha yi khang bzangs ⑧dam par skye/ /ting nge 'dzin dang nges 'byung 'thob/ /tshul khrims 'di ni 'bras bu che/ /de la 'dir ni rnam kun du/ /'dul ba min pas dag pa med/ /ji ltar chu med 'dag chal gyisarka/ /mnyes kyang dri ma mi 'dag bzhin/ /ji ltar zla ba med pa yi/ /mtshan mo dag ni mdzes ma yin/ /de bzhin tshul khrims mi gnas pa'i/ /rab byung rgyal ba'i bstan mi mjes/ /de phyir stom ⑨las spangs nas ni/ /bya dang bya min shes nus phyir/ /tshul khrims kyis ni brgyan ⑩'dod pas/ /'dul la 'bad pas gnas par bya/ /gang phyir 'dul ba shes gyur cing / /gus par byed pa'i dge slong ni/ /rang nyid yid ches gnas gyur pas/ /gdams ngag rjes bstan ston pa yin/ /de yang 'khor rnam bzhi po yis/ /shin tu gus 93—4

bcas mdun bdar zhing / /'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gces mdzod 'dzin/ /skyes chen rnams la phan phyir yang / /dam pa'i chos la legs gnas brtson/ /'di yi rang gi tshul khrims kyi/ /phung po legs bsrungs nyams pa med/ /gzhan gang 'gyod pa dang bcas pa /thams cad de yi rjes su 'brang / /don rnams rnam par nges pa yang / /phul phyin mkhas pa thob pa yin/ /chos rig chos dang bcas pa yis pha rol rgol ba pham par byed/ /gtsug lag khang du'ang gzhan mi 'gran/ /dge 'dun dbus na 'jigs pa med/ /de phyir ①phyogs kyi sgron ma ste/ /'od gsal rab tu snang bar byed/ /gang du 'dul ba mkhas gnas pa/ /de ru nga ni snying las chung / /de ltar dpag med rnam pa yis/ /thub pas 'dul ba'i phan yon gsungs/ /de bas gus pa dang bcas pas/ /chos 'dul gzung ②phyir brtson par bya/ /lo bcu yang dag rdzogs pa yi/ /dge slong kun sdom bdag nyid can/ /gsal zhing kun spyod rig pa yis/ /rab byung dang ni bsnyen rdzogs bya/ /so sor thar dang rnam 'byed don/ /mkhas shing dge bas sbyin bya ste/ /gzhan la rjes su ston pa yi/ /mthu ldan zhu gnas bca' ba'i 'os—/ /ston pa'i gsung ni ma 'khrugs pa'i/ /byes pas mdo tsam bklags ④pa yis/ /gsal bar shes pa ma yin pas/ /rnam par phye ste rtogs par bya/ /so sor thar dang rnam 'byed ni/ /gang 'dir shin tu mi mkhas lo④/ /drug cu lon yang byes pa ste/ /de ni gzhan la brten pas gnas/ /slob dpon de las rgan yang ni/ /gzhon nus ji bzhin nges brten te/ /gsar ⑤bu yin phyir phyag mi bya/ /gzhan ni thams cad byis pas bzhin/ /pham pa byung dang 93—5

bu lon chags/ /nad pa rab tu dbyung mi bya/ /bran dang rgyal pos bkrabs par grags/ /chom rkun rgyal mtshan 'chang ba min/ /smad pa'i rigs dang yan lag med/ /sgul ①gyol lag sor sbrul 'dra dang / /smad 'khyal lag rdum 'jeng po dang / /sna leb ②dang ni sna rings min/ /gzhon ches pa dang rgan ches dang / /ha cang bong ring ha cang thung / /yan lag mi min rnam pa can/ /ha cang mgul rings mjing ①nub min/ /bud med lam dang khur gyis dub/ /mgo ring dumago thung mgo chung dang / /so ni shin tu phyir gyed ⑤dang / /mig yon dang ni lta stangs 'jigs/ /dmar dang ser dang sngo ches dang / /chu bur rnam pa lta bu'i mig /rab tu byung ba bkag pa ste/ /sprul pa la sogs de bzhin no/ /spang bar bya ba mdor bsdu na/ /mdog dang dbyibs la skyon chags dang / /ma rungs rigs te rnam pa gsum/ /'khor gyur kun nas sgod pa'o—/ /mdog skyon dmar skya la sogs te/ /dbyibs skyon bzhin ngan la sogs yin—/ /bong bu la sogs rna rjodang mgo/ /skra dang rna ba med nyid spang / /glang po rta dang spri ⑦sna 'dra/ /sna med pa dang mig gcig dang / /mig med ba lang la sogs kyi/ /so 'dra gang yang so med pa'o/ /rigs ni gshed ma sbyig ma mkhan/ /g.yung po la sogs rnam par spang / /shing rta mkhan la sogs pa dang / /bstan bcos las ni gang bkag pa/ /de bzhin gsal shing mkhan sogs dang / /chang 'tshong la sogs gang yin pa/ /rang bzhin dman gyur de dag la/ /rnam pa kun du bslab mi sbyin/ /de dag dge rgyun med min zhing / /thar pa'ang mi 'dod ma yin mod/ /gcig tu bstan la skye bo yis/ /thos na skyon du lta phyir bkag /bsam dang rjes kyi bsam shes shing / /mngon shes 93—6

ting 'dzin thob pa ni/ /mthu yis 'jig rten tshim byed phyir/ /rab tu 'byin na nyes pa med/ /ji skad bstan skyon rnams bral zhing / /dge ba don du gnyer rnams la/ /bar chad mtha' dag dris nas ni/ /mgo nas rkang pa'i bar du brtag /zhag brgyad la sogs bzung ①nas kyang / /ji srid bar du legs par brtag /gang zhig sngon du yongs brtags nas/ /nyi ma gcig kyang gzhag ④mi bya/ /thog mar skyabs gsum byen nas ni/ /babeeb gzhi lnga po dag kyang ngo / /dkar po'i gos ni 'dzin bzhin la/ /tshogs kyi nang du mkhyen par gsol/ /dge 'dun rtse gcig rjes gnang tshe/ /rab byung cho ga sngon 'gro bas/ /slob dpon rnam par mkhas pa yis/ /yan lag bcu yi sdom 'dzin gzhug /de ltar dge tshul byas ma thag /'di ni khyim pa thams cad kyisarka/ /phyag byed smon par 'gyur ba ste/ /gang phyir khyem gyi 'ching grol phyir//tshul ngan rab rib mun bsal te/ /ngur sprig gos ni 'dzin pa yis/ /nyi ma shar ltar lhang nger ni/ /phul phyin de ni shin tu mdzes/ /sum cu rtsa gsum yongs 'du'i shing / /sa brtol lo 'dab rnying pa bzhin/ /sdig pa kun las ldog don du/ /'di yi bsnyen rdzogs de bzhin no/ /yul dbus su ni dge slong rnams/ /bcu las nyung du mi rung ste/ /mtha' 'khob tu ni bsnyen rdzogs phyir| /lnga ①la sogs pas 'dod pa yin/ /li kha ra na tshang tshing nags/ /li khar shing 'phel ④shar phyogs nyid/ /u shi ra zhes brjod pa yi/ /ri bo mun pa can ni byang / /ka ba nye ba'i ka ba yi/ /grong khyer nub na gnas pa yin—/ /grong khyen 'dam bu can rmi grong / /chu klung 'dam bu can ni lho/ /'di dag gi ni bar rnams la/ /yul dbus su ni shes bya ste/ /phyi rol mtha' 93—7

'khob ces byar ni/ /mtha' yas mkhyen pas gsungs pa yin/ /tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /dge slong gis bsnyen rdzogs gsungs kyi/ /dung gi sgra dang khong rul dang / /'bras kyi nang gi srin bus min/ /gal te bzhi ni las brjod mkhas/ /tshul khrims ldan par gyur na ni/ /bsnyen rdzogs ma smad gyur pa ste/ /lha yis ①kyang ni phyag byar 'os/ /dge 'dun tshang dang mtshams phyir min—/ /las mkhan tshul khrims ldan pa dang / /las dag pa dang bar chad med—/ /bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i rgyu yin no/ /gang phyir bsnyen par rdzogs pa ni—/ /gzhan yang bye brag smra bas brjod/ /ji ltar gnas pa mkhyen pas na/ /'dren pa rang rgyal rang byung gi'o/ /'phags pa kauṇḍi n+ya sogs/ /lnga sde rnams ni nges pa las/ /gang zhig slob ma bzang sde dzeernams/ /thams cad skyabs su 'gro bas thob/ /pho nya yis ni mchod sbyin ma/ /tshur shog dge slong zhes byas kyang / /ston par khas blangs pa las ni/ /dge slong 'od srungs bdag nyid che//dri bas mnyes pa nyid kyis ni/ /slob ma legs sbyin de bzhin no/ /dbus dang mtha' 'khob pa dag sdel/ /bsnyen rdzogs yang dag bstan pa ni/ /bcu dang lnga yi tshogs kyis sam/ /de bas lhag pas kyang ni rung / /de bzhin 'khor tshogs bcas pa yi/ /go ta ma phyi chos kyis/ /de las gzhan ni ci rigs par/ /las ni sngon 'gro bya ba ste/ /bsnyen par rdzogs la sngar gyi ni/ /nyes par grags pa med pa yin/ /dgun dus dang ni so ga nyid/ /dbyar dang thung ngu de bzhin du/ /ring po'i ming can du yang shes/ /'di dag dus ni rnam pa lnga/ /lhung bzed snam rjosbyar grib tshod dang / /de bzhin dbyar ni tshul 'jug dag /rtag tu bdag gi dran byas te/ /gzhan du de la nyes byas 93—8

'gyur| /dge slong rnams las ①'di bsnyen rdzogs/ /de la zla phyed gdams ngag gsol/ /dge slong bcas gnas dbyar gnas nas/ /tshogs gnyis dang ni dgag dbye bya/ /tshul 'chal dge slong min par ni/ /mi gleng khro ba nyid kyang ngo / /phyi ba'i chos las 'das pa ④ni/ /zla phyed tshogs gnyis mgu byas te/ /bsnyen par rdzogs pa gsar bu las⑧/ /dge slong ma yi rjophyag bya'o/ /phyi ba'i chos brgyad 'di dag ni/ /dge slong ma la gsungs pa yin/ /bud med skyes pa'i rnam pa dang / /skyes pa bud med rnam pa dang / /mkhan po gtan med nyid dang ni/ /mkhan po khyim pa'i rtags sogs nyid/ /gang yang skal ldan rkun po dang / /yan lag bcad sogs khong chud dang / /de yang bsnyen par rdzogs 'gyur mod/ /dge slong 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur/ /mi 'dod bsnyen par rdzogs mi bya/ /gang gi lo ni mi shes na/ /de yi mtshan ni brtag ⑤bya ste/ /des duni na tshod mngon gsal 'gyur/ /gang 'di nyi shu ma rdzogs pa'i//lo yis dge slong byas na ni/ /zla shol mngal gyi zla rnams kyis/ /mkhas pa yi ni dgang bar bya/ /gal te de lta na yang 'di/ /lo ni nyi shu ma tshang na/ /dge tshul nyid du gnas 'gyur te/ /de ni bsnyen par rdzogs min nyid/ /lo ni gcig gam gnyis dag na/ /gal te dran pa rnyed gyur na/ /'di yi lo ni tshang ba yis/ /bsnyen par rdzogs pa nyid yin no/ /'on pas kyang ni go gyur na—/ /las brjod pa ⑦ni ma thos kyang / /'di la bsnyen rdzogs yod pa ste/ /tshul khrims ldan la nyes pa med/ /bsnyen par sgogs par byas nas de/ /gal te mtshan ni gyur pa na/ /'di ni bsnyen rdzogs kho na ste/ /dge slong ma yi 'khor nang bzhag /mkhan po mtshan ni gyur pa na/ /gal te gsol ba thos na 93—9

ni—/ /bsnyen par rdzogs pa kho na ste①/ /las byed pa la'ang nyes pa med/ /las byed pa ni ②mtshan gyur na/ /gal te las brjod thos na 'dir/ /mkhan po la ni nyes byas te/ /las byed rnams la skyon yod min/ /las byed nam mkha' la gnas te/ /sa la 'dug la byed gyur na/ /bsnyen par rdzogs pa rgyang ring ste/ /tshul khrims 'chal pas mtho ris bzhin/ /ji ltar mi yi bdag po yi④/ /gzhon nu rigs rgyud 'phel phyir bsrung / /de bzhin ston pa'i bstan pa dag /'phel phyir dge tshul rnams kyang bsrung / /shing sdong mtho la dge tshul ni/ /bla ma'i bka' yis 'dzegs 0pa las/ /shing chag nas ni lhung ba'i tshe/ /de la 'di dag gsungs pa yin/ /gang phyir 'di ni rab byung ba/ /bstan la thugs rje'i bdag nyid kyis/ /bya rog sgod nus gyur lta na/ /lo bdun pa yang rjes su gnang / /rab byung dang ni bsnyen rdzogs la/ /lhung bzed can min mi drang ste/ /bsod snyoms rgyu ba rnams la ni/ /de tshe snod don gnyer bas 'thob/ /gnas brtan nye dgas gang gi tshe/ /dge tshul bru bas nyen pa na/ /lhung bzed med par ldung bzed don/ /gzhan song ston mo'i bar du thob/ /blangs nas kyang ni lhung bzed sogs/ /blo bzangs kyis ⑤ni sbyin par bya/ /rang tshubyung bsnyen rdzogs dag kyang rung / /bram ze bzhin du slar mi 'gro/ /bsnyen par ma rdzogs gong du ni/ /nges par gnas rnams mi brjod de/ /thos nas 'di ni bya dka' zhes/ /bram ze slar yang khyim du song //dge slong rnams kyi las gcig gis/ /bzhi ni bsnyen par rdzogs mi bya/ /tshogs dag la ni tshogs gnyis kyis/ /las ni gang du'ang cung zad med/ /gnyis sam gsum po dag kyang rung / /dus gcig la ni bsnyen rdzogs na/ /93—10

na tshod bye brag yod gyur kyang / /rgan po ①med cing gsar bu med/ /phan tshun phyag kyang yod min te/ /rnyed pa gral rims skebazhin du'o/ /skul byed dbang gis ①de dag la/ /las bcol ba ni rim pas so/ /mtshams med lnga ni byas pa dang / /rku thabs gnas dang sprul pa dang / /mu stegs can zhugs 'on dang lkugs/ /'khrugs dang de bzhin phas pham byung / /dge slong ma ni sun phyung dang / /ma ning la sogs gnas mi bya/ /tshwa dusgo'i zhing ltar de dag la| /tshul khrims sa bon skye ba med/ /de bzhin gzhan yang bag med long / /bsdigs pa la sogs las rnams kyis/ /smad do blang bar bya ba ni/ /sems ni dul bar gyur na yin/ /mdo sde 'dul ba mngon pa rnams/ /mkhas shing grags dang ldan pa dang / /bsod nams chen po la sogs ni/ /bskrad cing bkar ⑤bar 'os pa min/ /gang phyir 'di dag mu stegs kyirjo/ /ri dwags skrag byed seng ge'i bu/ /'di dag khyem par gyur na yang / /ston pa'i blo yis rab dad bskyed/ /'di dag rnams kyis gtsug lag khang / /mdzes byed khyu mchog sgra sgrogs shing / /de bas 'di dag smad na ni/ /rang gi bstan pa ⑦smad pa yin/ /kun nas nyon mongs skyes na ⑧de/ /ma rungs gdon gyis rnam ⑨rmongs pas/ /bya min byed pa kho na ste⑩/ /'jig rten pas ⑪ni smod par 'gyur / /'thab krol can dang khyim sun 'byin/ /gsum pa tshul khrims 'chal pa ste/ /las ni byed pa na yang 'di/ /gal te 'gyur ba rten byed na/ /'bad pas gaṇḍi brdung ⑫byas nas/ /dge 'dun gyis ni bskrad par bya/ /ka ba la ⑫ni 'jus kyang bcad/ /sgo skyes la 'jus de bzhin no/ /yang na dge 'dun thams cad kyis/ /slar yang gso ba'i 'du byed bya/ /gang yang dge 93—11

'dun de dag las/ /dpung byed yan lag 'byen bya ste/ /min na de 'dra'i dge slong gi/ /rtags sun 'byen pa bzhag mi rung / /nan tan gyis ni bskrad bya ste/ /'thab dang rtsod pa med par bya/ /de yi gnas pa cir 'gyur na—/ /ro dang 'dra ba kho nar gsungs/ /dge slong shes ①skyon dri ma can/ /dge slong tshogs kyis chad byen la/ /dge slong mas ni gus bstan phyir/ /sngon du ldang gi phyag mi bya/ /dge bsnyen gsong por smra mi bya/ /khyem pas bsod stoms sbyin bya ste/ /'phags pa'i tshogs ni mnyes pa na/ /bya ba thams cad sngon bzhin no/ /'khyud chags phrag dog nad dang skyes/ /zla phyed ces bya ma ning lnga/ /'di dag re re'i mtshan nyid ni/ /rtogs pa'i don du brjod par bya//gang la gzhan gyis mnan pa na/ /'khrig phyir sems la 'dod chags ni/ /rnam rgyas de ni blo ldan gyis/ /'khyud dang ②ma ning shes par bya/ /gzhan gyi mtshan ni mthong ba las/ /rang la 'dod skye phrag dog grags①/ /mtshon nam nad kyis rtags nyams pa/ /de ni nad kyi ④ma ning brjod/ /gang skyes nyid nas mtshan ma ni/ /gnyis ka med pa skyes nas yin/ /zla phyed bud med zla phyed ni/ /skyes gyur zla phyed ma ning brjod/ /'dir ni sogs kyi sgra med kyang //zla sogs ma ning grub pa yin/ /gang zhig grong gi chos dag gi/ /nus med de ni za ⑤ma ste/ /mtshan ma gnyis ka dod rjopa ni/ /mtshan gnyis par ni 'dod pa yin/ /mu stegs log ltas bsgos pa yi/ /yid can de ni mu stegs 'dod/ /mu stegs chos kyi longs spyod gang / /de ni mu stegs can ⑦zhugs pa'o/ /dge tshul gang yang brdzun ④pa yis/ /rang gi rtags ni bzung nas kyang / /dge slong nyid du rab shes byed/ /de ni rku thabs gnas par 'dod/ /phyogs las 93—12

gzhan gyi phyogs dag ni/ /tha dad tshogs la yang dag brten// /gang zhig tshogs kyis chad pa byen/ /de ni tha dad gnas par 'dod/ /phas pham dag la log par lta/ /dge slong ma sogs ①sun 'byin dang / /bden dang dkon mchog gsum gyi ni/ /sngags min sgogs pa'i dge tshul nyid/ /skyon can bcu po 'di dag ni/ /chad pa'i las kyis bkar bar bya/ /phyung nas sbar yang mi gzhug ste/ /ji bzhin bshags sden skal ba bzhin/ /dge slong pham pa ma byung na/ /cho ga bzhin du bslab phul nas/ /song na'ang skal ldan slar yang ni//bsnyen rdzogs dga' ston chen po bya/ /sdom gtong rang bzhin gnas pa yi/ /brda phrad mi yi drung dag tu/ /bdag gis gang bzung bslab pa ni/ /gtong ngo zhes sogs tshig rnams 'bul/ /bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i rjes thogs la/ /phas pham rnams ni brjod par bya/ /rtogs ldan blo ni de dag las/ /'da' bar byed pa ma yin no/ /mi 'chab pa yi sems kyis ni/ /gal te byung na gcig la'ang mthol/ /chung ngu la 'ang 'jig ①pa'i phyir/ /de la phas pham mi 'byung ngo / /brtul zhugs can gyis bla ma bas/ /sngar nyid mal nas langs nas ni/ /so shing bcas nas de 'og tu/ /ston pa la ni phyag bya'o/ /de nas rab gus bskyed pa yis/ /bla ma la ni phyag bya ste/ /de ni de la gdams ngag sogs—/ /cho ga bzhin du phan 'dogs yin/ /de la khams bde sogs dris nas| /rab tu 'bad pas de yi ni/ /gnas khang chag chag yang dag gdab//nyer spyod sa yang sbyang bar bya/ /ston pa la ni maṇḍal dang / /mchod rten la yang bskor ba bya/ /brtul zhugs rgan la phyag byas nas/ /de yi nus pa ji bzhin du/ /bsam gtan klog pa'i las dag gis/ /lus la snying po blang bar 93—13

byaske/ /ngur smrig gyon tsam gyis chog pa'i/ /bsam pa nam yang mi bya'o/ /so shing dus dang mthun pa'i chu/ /'dug stan la sogs bstabs ①par bya/ /sman dang rnyed dka' zhim pa'i zas/ /'bras bu sogs kyang de bzhin no/ /lhung bzed la sogs bkru ba yis/ /gus pas bla ma'i nye gnas bya/ /bla ma rnam par mdzangs ②pas kyang / /thams cad du ni tshod rig bya/ /tshul khrims 'chal la zhe sdang dang / /phyag kyang nam yang mi bya ste/ /de dang longs spyod kyang ma yin/ /'di ni ro bsregs ①mgal dum bzhin/ /khyem pa sdom la gnas kyang ni/ /dge tshul rmi rjoni phyag mi bya/ /'dod can khyim gyi chos rnams larka/ /dge slong gis lta smos ci dgos/ /de bzhin khyim pa sdom ⑤ldan yang / /sdom brtson kun gyis rjophyag mi rung / /kun nas ma bsdams de dag la/ /phyag len dbang ni yod ma yin/ /srid pa tha ma pa la ni/ /rigs pas rnam dpyad mi 'thad de⑦/ /mi brtan 'khor bar 'khor bzhin pa'i/ /sems can rnams la snga ma bzhin/ /gzhan yang phyag bya min mang ste/ /spo dang bskrad pa la sogs pa'o/ /dge slong gis rtags phyag bya ba/ /sangs rgyas dang ni sdom pas rganaske/ /mi slob pa ni bdag por spyod/ /slob pa byen pa spyod pa ste/ /bsam gtan klog dang ldan pa ni/ /rjes gnang spyod pas nyes pa med/ /lhag ma le los bcom pa yi/ /bdag nyid rnams ni bu lon spyod/ /khrims 'chal rnams ni nang du yang / /gtsug lag khang sogs nyer spyod bkag /bshang khang dang ni nye ba ru/ /sna tshogs gtam ni mi bya ste/ /klog dang kha ton la sogs dang / /tshon gyi las kyang khyad par du'o/ /bshang khang dang ni gci ba'i gnas/ /tha dad du ni bya bar gsungs/ /chu 'dor tshe na gci khang du/ /93—14

sgra brda byas nas 'jug par bya/ /de yi khang par gros sogs min/ /dal bu dal bus sgra med par/ /rlung dang bshang ba gci ba rnams/ /dor byas nan gyis mi bsdam mo/ /sngon du 'jam po gang rung gis/ /'og gi sgo ni phyis nas kyang / /de nas lan gnyis lan gsum du/ /sa yis ①dag par bkru ②bar bya/ /lag pa g.yon par 'jam pa yi①/ /sa yi phung po bdun bya ste/ /gnyis kar yang ni bdun po nyid/ /so sor tha dad du ni bzhag /thog mar shā ri'i bu la 'di//bslab bcas gzhan du nyes byas 'gyur/ /de nas lag pa'ang 'bad pa yis④/ /chu mang pos ni rab tu bkru/ /lag ngar byen pa phyis nas ni/ /slar yang lag pa dag ni bkru/ /lag gdong ⑤rkang pa dag dang ni/ /phyi rol dag byar gsungs pa yin/ /dri yi byug pa spangs pa yi/ /gtsang sbra sems ni sbyang ba yin| /'di 'dra'i byug mchog yod pa la/ /stong phrag sa yis ci zhig bya/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis nang gi ni/ /gtsang sbra rjodon dam ⑦dag pa nyid/ /lus dang ngag dang yid dag gis/ /sdig pa spong bar gsungs pa yin/ /so shing byed dang bshang ba dang / /gci ba 'dor dang chu 'thung dang / /mtshams nang rten la phyag 'tshal ba/ /bla ma dag la zhu mi dgos/ /gang du skabs dang mthun pa yisde/ /ra ba rtsig pa rta babs nas/ /'dom ni bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i bar/ /nang gi mtshams su shes par bya/ /sdom pa lhag ma med gcod dang / /dge 'dun lhag mas de ldang dang / /de bzhin gang zag lhag ma can/ /lhung ba rnam pa gsum du grags/ /dang por phas pham gsungs pa ni//bzhi yin shin tu phyi ba'i phyir/ /'di dag gang rung byung na ni/ /dge slong rnam par nyams pa yin/ /ston ka'i chu bzhin dri med par/ /ston pa'i bstan 93—15

pa bcu gnyis lor/ /rtsang ba med par legs gnas te/ /khyon mongs spong bar byed pa yin/ /de nas bzang sbyin bu yi phyir/ /chung ma la ni 'khrig pa spyad/ /dge slong dgon ①pa pa yis kyang / /spra mo la zhugs kun mkhyen gyis/ /'di skad smad pa mdzad de khyed/ /'dod chags la sogs zhi bya'i phyir/ /nga yis chos rnams bstan pa la/ /'di ltar sdig pa'i las la chags/ /de nas phan yon bcu gzigs shing / /slob ma rnams la phan bzhed pas/ /bslab pa'i gzhi ni bca' ba dag /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can gyis mdzad/ /mchil ma gci dang bshang ba yi/ /lam du chags can zhugs na ni/ /gso byar mi rung bdug pa yi/ /phas pham sbrul gyis dge slong zin/ /kha shun so dang pags pa las—/ /nor bu 'das na phas pham ste/ /phyi rol char ni ci rigs ②par/ /sbom po'am dge 'dun lhag ma'o/ /gang phyir stobs kyis mnan nas kyang / /brtul zhugs can gyis grong chos kyi/ /bde bsten de yang phas pham gsungs/ /nyams pa dang ni rma yi sgor/ /rab zhugs sbom por shes par bya/ /mi shes byis pa chung ngu gang / /bsten mi bzod la spyad pa yang / /cung zad zin dang shas cher zin/ /skrangs dang rul te nyams pa'o/ /gang zhig gnyi ga rnal du gnas—/ /skyon med de ni ma nyams pa'o/ /thams cad du ni rma yi sgo/ /gsum po nyams pa la yang ni/ /gang zhig de la zhugs pa na/ /sbom po yin no mthar thug min①/ /nang du ma chud pa dang ni/ /las su mi rung bas kyang ni//'khrig pa spyod par byed pa la/ /sbom po nyid du grags pa yin/ /mo mtshan mtshams dang ma 'byor dudang / /'jigs pas bud med 'dor bzhin dang / /yang na ngo tsha yis kyang 'dor/ /mi 'dor gyur kyang nyams pa dang / /gang 93—16

yang byes pa 'dod pa yi/ /longs spyod mi shes mi rung la/ /de ltar bstan na ①thams cad du/ /sbom po'i kha na ma tho bcas/ /chung ngu 'bring sogs dbye ba yis / /'dus byas thams cad tha dad de/ /de yi rtsang ba nges pa yi/ /dbye ba grub par the tshom med/ /bu ga gzhan dang lus kyi ni/ /bu ga bral nas de dag tusde/ /lus skyes 'jug par byed na yang / /sdom brtson la ni sbom por brjod/ /byes pa chung la zhugs pa yi/ /dge slong pham par yong mi brtag /nu ma mchu dang sha mtshams bzhin/ /nyes spyod rgyas par mi 'gyur dman/ /mche ba rdo mangs gdug pa yi/ /sbrul gyi khar ni chud pa bla①/ /lus bde bstan pa'i rma la ni/ /lus skyes 'jug pa ji ltar rung / /sgrul gdug gis ni reg gyur kyang / /skye ba gcig nyid 'chi 'gyur gyi/ /khrims 'chal skye ba brgyud na ④ni/ /stong phrag sdug bsngal mi bzad 'thob/ /phyi dang shin tu byu ba nyid| /yang dang shin tu yang ba ste/ /phas pham pas ni bslang ⑤ba yi/ /sbom po rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /skrag par mi byed phyi ba ste/ /gzhan gyis de la 'bad pa yis/ /bzlog kyang mi nyan rab lcir shes/ /gzhan la khrel yod yang ba ste/ /rang nyid ngo tshas shin tu yang / /bsam pa'i dbye bas 'gyur ba yin//de bzhin dge 'dun lhag ma yis/ /kun bslang sbom po rnam pa bzhi/ /dge slong nyid dang de ma nyams/ /ma nyams pa yi lam dag tu/ /bcug reg ro ni myong ba dang / /gang phyir sems ni rang bzhin gnas/ /rang gi khang pa brtsig pa'i phyir/ /rgyal po ma skyes dgra yi shing / /dge slong nor can gyis brkus te/ /de brten 'di dag kun bslang bcas/ /ma 'khrul gnas nas spo byed cing / /gzhan nor brku sems mthu yis sam/ /'jab bu yis kyang de 93—17

la mthar/ /mi las ma sha lnga tshang brkus/ /ma sha ma ga dhwa ①pa ste/ /de las lhag pa mkhas pas shes/ /dngos po bskyod pas spom po ste/ /sbyor ba la ni nyes byas so/ /sa gzhi 'jam zhing mnyam pa la/ /bskyod kyang mthar ni mi 'gyur te/ /sa phyogs grum gas la sogs pa/ /mthon ②dman can la rab tu bskyedaske/ /zhe sdang gi ④ni rgya la sogs/ /chud son ④byed pa sbom po yin/ /sems can rnams ni dgrol don du/ /bsod nams 'dod pas bshags bya'o/ /gang gi yul ni de yi dus/ /gang gi tshad kyi 'gron ⑤bu ni/ /de yi bzhi cha brkus pa gang / /dge slong la ni pham par 'gyur/ /sa gzhi rtsod bcas rnam pa gnyis/ /rigs rjodang rgyal po'i rigs kyis te/ /gnyi ga la yang dge slong ni—/ /rgyal na rtsang ba sgom por brjod/ /khyem pas gal te sbyor btang na/ /gnyis kar yang ni phas pham nyid/ /phas pham me yis bsregs pa yidzee/ /shing tshig lta bur sdom brtson 'gyur/ /nor bu mu tig la sogs nor/ /sngags kyis bkug nas rku ba na/ /mthong ba tsam gyis de las ⑧'dir/ /thong ba'i mthar ni 'gyur ba yin/ /bdag gi lo tog phun tshogs bya/ /gzhan la min zhes sred pa yis/ /rang sar chu ni 'dren byed cing / /tshan gyis 'jig ⑨par byed kyang rung / /rang gi lo tog phun tshogs shing / /gzhan gyi lo tog nyams pa na/ /lo tog rin ni shes byas nas/ /sgom po'am phas pham ci rigs brtag⑩ /sdig pa kun las sdog phyir dang / /sems can rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /nam yang gzhan gyi 'tsho ba ni/ /dge slong gis ni dbrog mi bya/ /rkun pos slob ma phrogs pa'am/ /gser sogs stobs kyis mi bslang ste⑪/ /gzhung lugs ji bzhin ma bsgrubs na/ /ma rungs 1nga ba dag dang bcas/ /chos bshad pa 'am 93—18

phyed rin nam/ /rin ni tshang ba yis kyang rung / /blang bya rkun ma rgyal po la/ /phul na rtsang ba sbom por 'gyur/ /slob ma nyid phyir mthun btsal nas/ /dge tshul dge slong gis phrogs na/ /'khor dbye ba yi kun bslang phyir/ /sgom po'i blo can sbom pos reg /dge slong gis ①ni sho gam sogs/ /rang ngam gzhan gyi lag gis phrogs/ /dngos po ⑧brtag par bya ba ste/ /rtsang ba nges par bsten par 'gyur/ /rgyal po la sogs dbang ba yi/ /chu 'gram gru btsas las byung ba/ /ma byan snelam gang nas song na/ /rang ngam gzhan gyi lag nyid dukyis / /de ni de yi phrogs 'dra ste/ /ltung ba rnam par dpyad pa na/ /ma sha lnga yi rin gyis ni/ /mthar 'gyur gzhan du ma yin ⑤no/ /sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags tshogs sam/ /pha phyir gang zhig bsams pa yi/ /bsngags pa de la brjod pas sam/ /phyi ⑦nas brtul zhugs can gyis bgyir/ /mang po ri ba'i dngos po gcig /rung ba'i chos gos khyer ba bzhin/ /des — sba bar mi bya ste//nges par 1nga ba med par 'dod/ /gzhan yang sho gam la ⑦'da' bar/ /kha tshar bcad pa la sogs sam/ /chu yis bsnyugs nas kyang ni rung / /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can gyis gnang / /gang gis chos gos la sogs pa/ /'dod pas dang du len pa ni/ /'gyod pas btang yang de la ni/ /rtsang ba sbom por shes par bya/ /ri la 'dzeg gam gru brgal tshe/ /phan tshun so sor go byas nas//lhung bzed la sogs snod bskur te/ /bag yod rtag tu dran pa yis/ /'di ni bzung ngam btang ngo zhes/ /smras thos gal te brlag ⑧gyur na/ /de rin nges par sbyin pa la/ /'dir ni rnam dpyad mi dgos so/ /ci te ⑨ma bos zan za na/ /dge slong la ni nyes byas te/ /'di ni sde ldan lhag ma la'ang / /93—19

nyes byas nyid du rab tu grags/ /rgyal pos byin dang rkun pos byin/ /las byed dag gis ma dris byin/ /gzhan dang 'byel par 'du shes na/ /sbyin po de las mi blang ngo / /gzhan dang 'brel pa pham ①pa yin/ /ster bar rnam par shes na ni/ /'dod pa mi mthun mi blang ste/ /mi shes na ni nges pa med/ /sbyin bdag nges par rnam dpyad nas/ /de phyir gtso bo ma yin na/ /de las blang bar mi rigs te/ /de ni sbyin por mi 'dod do/ /gal te dge 'dun sogs kyi nor/ /rang gi gnyen nam gzhan gyis kyang / /ster na nor med nad pa yis/ /slar yang bsab par 'dod pas blang ②/ /gal te shi na nyes med de①/ /gson na gang yang rung ba ni/ /blangs nas kyang ni mi nus kyis/ /de yi dkor ni bsab par bya/ /ba lang la sogs longs spyod mchog /grong la sogs par longs spyod ④pa/ /'di dag dge 'dun la ni gnang / /gang zag la ni bkag pa yin/ /longs spyod zhing dang grang ⑤dang rta/ /ba lang ma te ra lug durnams/ /'dul bar longs spyod mchog nyid du/ /de nyid rig pas gsungs pa yin/ /dngos po rnam pa lnga po ni/ /shes rab can gyis mi bcang zhing / /mi gtsang dzeemi bgo thams cad du/ /de bzhin khas kyang mi blang ngo / /skyed mos tshal dang gtsug lag khang / /de yi dngos dang mal stan rnams/ /tshul ldan rnams kyis ⑧sbyin bdag gi/ /bsod nams spel phyir bsrung bar bya/ /lha khang skyed tshal kun dga' ra/ /gtsug lag khang ni gcig tu 'dod/ /de dag dngos po gnas khang yin/ /mal stan dag ni grags par zad/ /gtsug lag khang steng gnas pa yi/ /bsgo ba gang du gsal bar thos/ /bka' bsgo ba ni byed pa yis/ /de la nges par 'jug par bya/ /las kyi bya ba byed pa'i tshe//93—20

zas dang gos kyi ①rjes su bzung / /nad pa la ni rjes su gnang / /las ni mi nus pa la yang / /brdeg dang 'tshog dang skyo ②ba dag /'phags pa'i chos dang 'gal ba yin/ /bsad dang bcing dang nyon mongs byed/ /'phags pas de phyir rnam par spang ②/ /ci rigs mchog gis gsungs pa dang / /rigs kyi chos ldan gyis bstan pa'i/ /yul chos ldan pa'i chad pa ni/ /dge 'dun gyis ni dang du blang / /rgyal po la sogs yongs btang ba'i/ /rang skal bsod nams kyis rnyed na/ /yongs su longs spyod nyes med de/ /de dag sngar bstan bzhin du gnas/ / 'dren pas ④dngos po thams cad kyis⑤/ /tha snyad durang gis ⑦ma gsungs te/ /dge slong ma 'am dge tshul dag /nges pa'i zhal ta ba yis blta/ /ston pa'i chos las 'das nas ni/ /sred ldan gang zhig chad pas gcod/ /de ni bslab pa nyams pa ste/ /ma rig sgrib ⑧g.yogs kyis bskyed pa'o/ /yang dag lta dang gzhan thob kyi/ /log lta can dang tshul khrims med/ /de la rab tu byin na ni/ /dad pas byin pa'i 'bras bu med/ /gang yang 'tsho ba'i tshad tsam zhig /khengs las lhag dang brtul zhugs can/ /ston mo dag las len byed na/ /des ni rnam par nyams par byasarka/ /ji tsam gang gis ⑨chog gyur pa/ /de tsam ston mo las ⑩ni blang / /lhag ma kham gcig len byed kyang / /bsams ⑪bzhin yin na nyams pa nyid/ /pha ma'am nad pa la sogs la/ /sbyin par byed pa bkag pa med/ /sbyin bdag dag gis ma spags par/ /nam yang gzhan la sbyin mi bya/ /gang du 'chag pa la sogs tshe/ /gri khab la sogs rnyed gyur na/ /gtsug lag khang skyong dag la gtad/ /lung bzhin de yis ⑫go bar bya/ /dge 'dun dbus su 93—21

zhag gsum bar/ /de yis de dag bsten ①par bya/ /su yang ngo len med na ni/ /ci bde bar ni tshogs la dbul/ /dgos pa'i tshe na las rnams bya/ /bsod nams bsags dzeepas las bya yi/ /rnyed pa'i don du dge slong gis/ /las ni nam yang mi bya'o/ /yid ches gyur la rang gi blos/ /ji srid du ni nges pa yis/ /'jog pa la ni nyes med de/ /dbang po gzhan ni bzhag nas so/ /gang phyir dman dang 'bring dang mchog /grogs po gsum ni rnam dpyad snenas/ /yid ches brtan po nyid la bca'i/ /nges par sems mi brtan la min/ /shin tu mchog la mchog nyid de/ /'bring la 'bring po tha ma la/ /tha ma rjonyid de dman la chung / /yid ches rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /nad pa la ni dris nas smanaske/ /phan pa'i ched du sbyin bya ste/ /rang gi yid ches kyis kyang rung / /til snod dge slong ma bzhin min/ /mi dang gzhan nor rku sems kyis/ /sbyor ba gcig la tshang na ni/ /mdor na bslab pa nyams pa ste/ /phas pham pa yi rgyu yin no/ /dge slong mi gtsang yid byung gang / /ri dwags dbyug thogs zhes pas bsad/ /bsod nams thob dang lhung bzed sogs/ /'dod pa de bsten ༷bkag pa yin/ /yang dag bsam pa ma 'khrul pas/ /rang ngam gzhan gyis rjopha rol bsad/ /mi la 'chi ba'i bsngags pa dag /brjod grub des kyang mthar 'gyur ro/ /de 'chi'i thabs no tshig gis sam/ /sbyor ba rnams kyis mngon bsngags shing / /sems ni rjes su yi rang na/ /sbom po'o me yis ⑦nags bsreg dang / /mi yi yan lag gcod pa dang / /de yi sha ni za yang ngo / /nad pa la ni nad g.yog ④dag /phan phyir byis pa legs par bsgo//mkhas pa'am gnas brtan dag la yang / /sman ni yongs su dris nas su/ /93—22

nad pa dag la phan blos sbyin/ /gzhan du 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur/ /gang gi nad la ci 'dra ba'i/ /yo byad nad pa dag la gzhag /brtags ①pa za ba la sogs kyang / /rjes su brtse bas ②nyes pa med/ /dge 'dun kun gyi nad pa ni/ /blta phyir brtson byar bka' stsal te/ /thams cad du ni rim pa bzhin//'dug nas kyang ni blta bya ste/ /nad pa'i nad g.yog dag gis kyang / /'bad pas 'dug pa'i don du ni/ /gus pas rtag tu stan rnams ni/ /nges par nye bar bstab ①par bya/ /gal te nad pa nus med pas/ /skyo bar gyur pa de lta ④na/ /de la 'dir ni re mos kyis/ /yang dag bsgo bar brtag pa nyid—/ /nad pa'i mdun du gang zhig gis/ /thos ⑤sam tshor bar de yi sems /'chi ba'i 'dun pa skye 'gyur ba/ /de 'dra'i chos bshad mi bya'o/ /kye ma khyod kyis rjosbyin pa byin/ /tshul khrims kyang ni ma nyams bsrungs/ /dkon mchog gsum la gus byas te/ /mya ngan 'das pa mdun ⑦na gnas/ /khyod ni lus dang bral ma thag /lha yi khang bzangs ⑧thag mi ⑨ring / /srog dang bral na myur du ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa lag na gnas/ /de skad gang smra'i dge slong ni//mi zad ⑩ltung ba dag dang bcas/ /de bas khyod ni nang bral nas/ /yun ring chos spyod 'tsho bar shog /chos spyod ji srid gson na ni/ /de srid bsod nams tshogs chen po/ /rdzogs par 'gyur zhes brjod par bya/ /nad kyis gdungs la sman dag dang / /mkhas pas gdams ngag sbyin bya zhes/ /gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pas gsungs/ /skra can 'tshong na sbom po yin/ /lhung bzed sogs chags gzhan dag la/ /gdol pa bzhin ⑪du brtse med par/ /gang zhig 'dod sems skyed byed pa/ /de la nyes byas nyid du rig /bzhad 93—23

gad rgod bag ched du yang / /ga ga tshil ni mi bya ste/ / sngon ni ①gzhon nu bcu bdun sdes/ /dge slong g.ya' bsgags shi bas bcas/ /mchod rten la sogs las byed pas/ /khyim pa med tshe phyi ba'i khur/ /mi khyer mi gzhug shing mkhan ni/ /shing bteg shi ba la rten bkag /so phag gas po la sogs pa/ /brda ma sprad par sbyin mi bya/ /nyi ma zad par dge slong gis/ /gla mi bzhin du las mi bya/ /las kyi zhal ta blo ldan gyis/ /de dag la ni go byas nas/ /de rnams las dub spang ba'i phyir/ /khye sus ④bza' btung gis tshim bya/ /gtsug lag khang ni bsrung ba'i phyir/ /brtson par yang ni rjes su gnang / /sems can dag la ltos ④med par/ /ma bsams dbyug sogs mi 'phang ngo / /khru bcu'i nang rol spyod yul du/ /rdo ba la sogs dor bar rung / /bslab pa rjes dran bskyed pa yis/ /nang gi bdag nyid nyams mi 'gyur/ /gtsug lag khang gi las byed la/ /mtshan mo chos sgrogs ④gnas dag tu/ /sgo sogs bsdams par byas sam zhes/ /gnas brtan gyis ni dri bar bya/ /gtsug lag khang 'joms bzlog pa'i phyir/ /gang la bcing ba brtag bya bar/ /bcing ba sngar ni brjod pa yis/ /gtsug lag khang ni bsrung bar bya/ /'khrul gtan ⑤steng gzer 'og 'jug dang / /sgo lcags sde mig kyog po dang rjo/ /gtsug lag khang gnas de dag la/ /zhal ta ⑦pa yis ci rigs sbyin/ /gcig dang gnyis dang gsum sogs kyis/ /tha dad bcing ba gzhug byas te/ /thams cad gzhug par 'os na yang / /rtog pa po yis thams cad gzhug⑧ /ston pa'i bstan la gus pa yi⑨/ /dge slong lus dub thang chad dag /lam du dge slong rnams kyis ni/ /pha bzhin bsgrub par mi bya'o/ /sngon byung pha rgan dal 'gro la//93—24

dus yol gyur pa'i 'jigs pa yis①/ /bu yis phul bas lam du de/ /dub nas 'chi ba'i dus byas so/ /mu ge'i dus shig dge slong rnams/ /mi srid bla ma'i yon tan rnams/ /phan tshun bsgrags te go byas rgyus/ /'tsho ba byas tshe bkag pa mdzad/ /khyad par gyur pa'i rtogs pa rnams/ /ma thob par ni thob bo zhes/ /mngon pa'i nga rgyal med smra na/ /sdom brtson mtha' yi 1nga ba 'thob//mi chos bla ma'i yon tan 'dir/ /bsam gtan rnams dang gzugs med sogs//mthong ②zad phul phyin mya ngan 'das/ /'phags pa'i lam gyi thob smra'o/ /mkhas pas khyad par rtogs pa'i don/ / gang gsungs ①'bras bu bzhi po dang //sdug bsngal la sogs yul shes pa/ /bden pa bzhi po mthong zhes dang / /bsam gtan zhes brjod bzhi po yi/ /de la reg pas gnas pa dang / /sdug bsngal la sogs bdag gis shes/ /lha la sogs pa bdag gis mthong / /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za sogs/ /mthong ngo bdag gis gtam yang byas/ /de dag kyang ni bdag la smra/ /zhes smra dge slong mthar 'gyur ro/ /lha yi skad ni bdag gis thos/ /de ni mtshan mo bdag drung 'ongs④/ /de bzhin gnod sbyin sogs kyang ste/ /rang bzhin gyis ni pham par 'dod/ /de dag kun la shes bya ba/ /sbom po sha za mthong sogs tesde/ /'di na gang zhig lha sogs dag /mthong ba yod ces smra na yang / /rnam rnags dhimi rtag 'du shes sogs/ /'bras bu mngon shes rab ston na/ /mi 'dod na yang mtha' yi ni/ /mtshon chas mgo bcad thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'di na dge slong gang / /rdul ⑦khrod sha za mthong ba yod/ /bdag ces smra bar mi byed kyang / /de skad brjod na nyes byas so/ /rtsang ba ⑧'chab dang reg pa dang / /lus bkan bag med 93—25

phyogs byed nyid/ /de bzhin dge slong phas pham bzhis/ /dge slong ma yi rtsa ba 'jig /rgyal dang pham dang de bzhin du/ /char 'bab mtshan ni 'gyur ba sogs—/ /dgongs su gsol zhes brjod bya ste/ /gzhan du 'gal tshabs ①can du 'gyur/ /dge slong ser skyas 'od srungs kyi②/ /bstan la ngag rtsub brdzun snesmras pas/ /chu srin bco brgyad gdong skyes bcas/ /nyon mongs dgra pham khas blangs nas/ /nyon mongs dag gis bupham byas na/ /de phyir phas pham gyur pa ste/ /khrims dral ⑤zhes ni nges par brjod/ /phas pham pa yi chos dag tu/ /gang gsungs ma lus brjod nas ni/ /rim pa ji bzhin dge 'dun gyi—/ /lhag ma rnams ni brjod par bya/ /rma sgo gsum ni ma gtogs par/ /shes lus rang bzhin yan lag gis/ /bsams bzhin khu ba 'byin pa ni/ /dge 'dun gyi rjoni lhag mas reg /sla dang ska ⑦ba nyid dang dmar/ /ser po dang ni sngon po ste/ /khya ba rnam pa lngar ⑧bstan pa/ /phyi ma 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyis⑨/ /de yi bu ni sngon po ste/ /de yi 'og tu ser po yin/ /dmar po de yi blon po ste/ /ska ba dbang po smin pa nyid/ /bud med kyis dub dbang po dag /ma smin pa yi sla ⑩bar shes/ /thams cad du yang dge 'dun gyis/ /dag bya lhag ma'i rtsang ba nyid/ /shes bzhin rtsig khung bum pa yi/ / sbubs sogs du ba 'byen pa ni/ /⑪sbom po yis ni bcom pa ste/ /pha bong sbom pos snad pa bzhin/ /brtsams te khu ba ma phyin nam/ /chags pas dbang po 'jal byed dam/ /gar bsgyur mkha' la bskyed pas sam/ /mnye bshud kyis ni phyung ⑫na yang / /rdzi ldog chu rgyun bzlog phyogs su/ /gtod pa la yang de bzhin 'dodaske/ /rdzi phyogs rgyun phyogs mthun gtod pas/ /nyes byas 'gyur bar 93—26

gsungs pa yin/ /chu bste ba ni mthong sogs la/ /chags pa'i sems dang ldan yang ngo / /chags pas don nyams rtsa ba ste/ /de bas rtag tu spang bar bya/ /je ta'i shing sogs reg pas sam/ /brla sogs dag la bshud pa la/ /der ni khu ba byung yang ste/ /rmi lam na ni nyes med cha'o/ /dge slong tshogs la chos lhag par/ /rgyas par yang dag bshad pa rnams/ /dge tshul la ni thams cad duske/ /nyes byas nges par shes par bya/ /mtha' las byung ba'i nyon mongs ngan//kun slong ①nges par bshags bya ste/ /sbom po lci ba tshogs pa la/ /yang ba'i ming can bzhir brjod do/ /dge 'dun lhag ma las byung ba'i/ /phyi ba lnga la yang ba bzhis/ /dge 'dun lhag ma tshogs la ste/ /lhag ma gang zag gcig la'ang rung / /sngar ni thong ba byung ba yis/ /ltung ba mthun snang la mi 'dod//dri mas dri ma rnam dag pa/ /gang du yang ni rung ma yin/ /gang la dge 'dun lhag mas gos/ /ji srid nges par 'chab byed pa/ /de ②srid de ni dag bya'i phyirarka/ /sgo ba dag la nges par bzhag /dge 'dun lhag ma gang byung ba/ /ji srid de ni rjes bzung min/ /de srid de la spo ba yi①/ /cho ga yongs su dag phyir bya/ /mtshan mo dang ni sems sbyor las/ /'chab pa yang ni rnam pa gnyis//shin tu mi rung 'dir sems pasadu/ /sems kyi ming du shes par bya/ /'dir ni spo ba la gnas te/ /gal te nyon mongs kyis pham pas/ /rmongs pas beer yang lhung spyod na/ /slar yang dngos gzhi'i spo ba ni/ /gzhan dag kyang ni sbyin bya ste/ /'dul ba legs shes gang dag gis/ /lan gsum bar du de la sbyin—/ /snying rje'i zhing ni de 'dra la/ /nyon mongs dbang gis ⑤'jug shes pas| /ngo tsha'i khur ni chen po yis/ /brgya lam zhig na 'dud par 'gyur/ /93—27

de lta na yang mi dge las/ /gal te mi ldog pa nyid na/ /de ni mdo bzhin dor bya ste/ /ji srid skyo bar gyur gyi bar/ /yid ni yang dag skyo gyur cing / /phyir bcos don du gnyer ba na/ /tshogs kyis dbyung bar 'dod pa yis/ /mgu ba spyod pa de la sbyin/ /mgu ba'i chu yis rnam ①bkrus nas/ /dri ma lhag ma dag bya'i phyir/ /gang du dge slong nyi shu yis/ /de ni nges par dbyung bar bya—/ /de la dge 'dun gtso bo ste/ /bsam pa mkhyen pa'i dge 'dun yin/ /dge 'dun gyis ni rjes gnang na/ /las kyi bya ba byed par rung / /dge 'dun nang du de yi las/ /bya phyir de yi rigs pa yis/ /tshogs las ldang ngo de yi phyir/ /dge 'dun lhag ma zhes byar brjod/ /gal te byin rlabs mgu bas kyang / /gnas pa'i tshe na shi gyur na/ /dbyung ba ma byas na yang ni/ /nges sdepar mtho ris dag tu skye/ /rang gi ①las kyis duco dris pas/ /ngan 'gro dag tu mi skye mod/ /'on kyang snying rje'i bdag can gyis/ /btang snyoms mi bya rjes su bzung / /gang zhig ming ni grags chen dang / /mdo sde la sogs mang du thos/ /de dag gcig gi mdun du yang / /bshags pas dag par nges par rung / /bsam pa yang ni che ba dang / /de bzhin ngo tshas bcabs pa yang / /de yi spo ⑤bar yongs brtags byed/ /de yi sgo nas cho ga bzhinaske/ /de ni mthol ba lan gsum yin/ /nad kyis rjochad pa nyid dang ni/ /gos kyis dkris dang nyams pa'i sgor/ /byed na rtsang ba che spangs nas/ /sbom po'i rtsang bas 'joms par 'gyur/ /rkang pa nas ni spyi bo'i bar/ /chags bcas bud med yan lag la/ /gos kyis ma chod reg na rtsang / /chod ⑦pa la reg sbom po nyid/ /shing rta gru sogs la 'jug dang / /'phul ba dang ni 93—28

'then pa dang / /bar bcas bar med pa la ni/ /reg pa bdag ①byed sngar bzhin des/ /bud med kyis tshur dge slong la/ /reg cing chags sems bdag byed na/ /'dir yang sngar bzhin thams cad du/ /'dren pa la sogs byed kyang ngo / /'khrig pa'i bsam pas 'di dag la/ /gnyen po stobs chung byed na ni/ /de la phas pham gyis bslang ba'i/ /sbom po yi ni rtsang bar 'gyur//'di dag bud med bsten bzod de/ /gzhan du sbom po'i ming can yin/ /skyes pa'am ma ning la sogs sam/ /dud 'gro mo la nyes byas yin/ /dge slong gang zhig bud med la/ /rtse phyir yang ni smad tshig smra/ /dge slong gzugs brnyan sdenyid yin te/ /de yang dge 'dun lhag ma yin/ /'ga' zhig rma yi sgo gsum po/ /legs par 'dod ①la shin tu 'jam/ /yang na de dag legs par ni/ /ma dod dga' ba mi skyed gnasarjo/ /'di dang 'di ni khyod la sbyin/ /gang khyod khyo ni nor ldan te/ /gang 'dir khyod dang lhan cig tu / /bde myong de ni rnyed pa che/ /de la sogs pa'i 'khrig ⑤tshig dag /gang brjod dag 0'dun lhag ma'o/ /'khrig dngos sgra ni mi brjod na/ /sbom po yi ni rtsang bar gsungs/ /bud med ngo tsha las 'das tshig /tshul smra'ang de la ci rigs nyid/ /gang zhig 'khrig pa'i tshig gyur pa/ /de ni smra bar mi bya'o//smyos pa dang ni sems 'khrugs dang / /smra mi shes dang las dang po/ /tshor bas gzir la brjod ngan gyi/ /ltung ba dag ni mi 'byung ngo // //bam po gnyis pa/ rang nyid bsngags pa'i bye brag dag /'khrig pa don gnyer bud med kyi/ /mdun du rang nyid kyis bsngags na/ /lhag ma'o dge 'dun gyi ⑦zad byed/ /longs spyod 'di yis nyer gnas na/ /mchog 93—29

dang phul sogs nges bstan pa/ /sring mo bsnyen bkur mchog tshig smra/ /gsol ba la sogs las kyis ni/ /tshul khrims ldan par gang bshad pa/ /tshul khrims phung por yang dag ldan/ /dge ba'i chos can nyid kyis na/ /ting 'dzin phung por yang dag ldan/ /tshangs par spyod pa nges brjod pas/ /shes rab phung por yang dag ldan/ /'khrig pa'i tshig ces bya ba 'dir/ /gnyis kyis gnyis sprad sbyor ba yin/ /'di dag nang nas tshig gcig kyang / /sdom brtson chags pa'i sems kyis ni/ /brda sprad bud med la smra na/ /rtsang ba yin la dpyad mi dgos/ /'khrig pa gsal bar byed pa'i tshig /gal te bud med kyang ni smra/ /gang 'dir tshangs par spyod rnams la/ /'khrig pa longs spyod mchog ces dang / /khyed lta'i tshul khrims ldan pa ni/ /rtag tu dge ba'i chos can de①/ /yon gnas khyad par 'phags pa dag /rtsod pa'i dus na rnyed ①par dka'/ /de la sogs brjod dge slong gang / /dga' bas dang du len byed cing / /lan gyi tshig kyang smra byed na/ /dge 'dun lhag mar gsungs pa yin/ /nga lta bu dang 'khrig spyad na/ /bud med rnams kyang 'bras bu che/ /'khrig pas ①dngos ni mi brjod kyang / /gang de sbom po'i ming can no/ /de bzhin 'khrig pa'i chos kyis ni/ /dag rjoslong zhes sogs snga ma bzhin/ /nga lta bu zhes mi brjod na/ /'di yang sgom po nyid du gsungs/ /bud med kyis kyang de bzhin du/ /'khrig pa'i tshig dngos dor gnas ⑤kyang / /khyed lta bu zhes mi brjod na/ /de bzhin gnyi ga dusbom po yin/ /bsten mi shes la 'khrig tshig dngos/ /brjod na sbom ④po las ni dman④/ /de lta bu zhes bya ba'i sgra/ /med pa la yang nyes byas 'dod/ /thams cad du yang sdom brtson ni/ /93—30

chags can la ni rtsang bar 'gyur/ /'dir ni chags can zhes gsungs gang / /sems ni chags pa dang 'brel nyid/ /gang bsten bzod la rtsang ba ste/ /bsten mi bzod la sbom po yin/ /skyes pa ma ning la sogs dang / /dud 'gro mo la nyes byas nyid/ /rang ngam gzhan byed 'jug kyang rung / /bud med skyes pa phrad na ni/ /dge 'dun lhag ma'i ral gri yis/ /rang gi mgo ni gcod par byed/ /chu tshigs byin sogs mdor bsdu na/ /chung ma rnam ①pa bdun du brjod/ /mdza' na mo bcu de dag gi/ /mtshan nyid yang dag bshad par bya/ /chu yis ⑤rab tu byin pa yi/ /don la de ming rab tu btags/ /bud med gang zhig nor gyis nyos/ /rin chas nyos zhes de la rig④ /rgyal po'i ④rgyal mtshan dang ni mgos/ /phrogs pa btsan phrogs zhes su brjod/ /ngas khyod nye gnas bya'o zhes/ /zer ba dang sam ⑤'dus pa yin/ /zas dang gos kyi rgyu mtshan gyis/ /zhugs pa gos zas kyis 'tsho yin/ /gang khyod nor dang nga yi nor/ /de yi mnyam srog 'tsho bya zhes/ /de skad brjod nas zhugs pa gang / /kha dum pa zhes bya ba'o/ /skad cig tsam zhig rtag tu min/ /de la thang 'ga' 'phrad rjoces bya/ /rnam pa bdun po 'di dag ni/ /slar yang so so'i dbye bar 'dod/ /'thabs ⑦pa'i mdo dang 'thabs ⑧pa'i 'og /dum pa bcad pa rnam pa gsum/ /rde'u ⑨gsum ni gtor ba dang / /chung ⑩ma ma yin par ni bsgrags/ /cho ga rab tu gtang ⑪ba dang / /de bzhin dril ⑫bu bsgrags pa'o/ /dang po rnam pa gsum po la/ /bye ba nye bar sdum ⑫byed na/ /gcig gnyis gsum la rim pa bzhin/ /nyes byas sogs par 'gyur ba yin/ /bzhi pa dang ni lnga pa gnyis/ /drug ste gsum la sbom po yin/ /bdun pa 93—31

bsdums byas brtul zhugs can/ /dge 'dun gye ni lhag ma thob/ /'di ru mdza' mor 'dod pa ni/ /khro ni shi 'am gzhan song tshe/ /ma yi 'bad pas bsrungs tshopa ni/ /ma yis thubasrungs zhes brjod pa yin/ /de bzhin pha dang gyos sgyug dang / /pha dang ma yi rang rig sgoskyes/ /des bsrungs de ni sbar yang ni/ /nye dus bsrungs zhes brjod pa yin/ /pha dang khyo ni med pa na/ /ming pos yongs su bsrungs pa 'am/ /phu mo nu mo yis kyang bsrungs/ /spun zlas bsrungs zhes brjod pa yin/ /bram ze mo 'am rje rigs mos/ /bsrungs pa rigs kyis bsrungs pa byeyin/ /bad sa la 'am ko sa la'i/ /rgyud kyis bsrungs pa rus 6chags bsrungs/ /chos spyod brtul zhugs can dag gi bye / /'khrug med mar ni shes bya ste/ /rnam pa bcu po 'di dag ni/ /mdza' na mo zhes shes par bya/ /gang 'dir mdza' na mor gsungs dang / /bzhi pa la sogs chung ma rnams/ /thams cad du ni sdum 8byed pa/ /dge 'dun lhag mar nges par bstan/ /khye'u 'am ni 9bu mo 'di/ /ci yi phyir na khyim mi byed/ /de skad la sogs smra ba yi/ /dge slong gis ni nyes byas 'thob/ /rang gi don du khang pa ni/ /gsol ba la sogs las kyi 1 ni/ /ched sogs yon tan ldan par bya/ /gzhan du dge 'dun lhag mar 'gyur/ /gang du nyam nga khumed spyod pa / /spyod lam rnam bzhi rung ba ni/ /'dug dang 'chag dang nyal bar grags / /bzhi pa langs pa nyid yin no/ /chur ni bde bar gshegs pa yi/ /mtho ni bcu dang gnyis yin no/ /zheng du de nyid bdun yin te/ /de dag de yi tshad du gsungs/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho yi tshad/ /gang gsungs mkhas pas shes par bya/ /'bring tshad mi yi khru dag ni/ /phyed dang gnyis ni 93—32

yod pa yin/ /'bring tshad skyes bu yi ni khru/ /bco brgyad chur ni yod pa yin//zheng du phyed dang bcu gcig ni/ /khang pa'i tshad du gsungs pa yin/ /sbrul dang sdig pa tre ①bu ka /tre la ta sogs kyis mi rung / /rtsod bcas lam dang shing drung dang / /lha rten rgyal po'i pho brang mtha'/ /chu dang g.yang sa khron pa'i drung / /brtsam du rung ba ma yin no/ /skyon ni 'di dag med pa ru/ /rigs pa yi ②ni khang pa ①bya/ /bka' yis ma gnang ba dag dang / /gzhi mi rung dang brtsam mi rung / /ma brtan rjortsod pa dang bcas su/ /byed na dge slong sbom rtsang thob/ /skyon kun gyis ni rab smad par/ /dge 'dun lhag mar gyur pa ste/ /skyon rnams kun dang bral ba yi/ /sa gzhir rjes su bsngags pa nyid / /las dang po dang de bzhin spyos⑤/ /'khrugs dang nad kyis gdungs pa yis/ /byed kyang 'di las 'byung rjob yi/ /thong ba yod pa ma yin no/ /gtsug lag khang ni bdag bcas la'ang/ /tshad dang cho ga 'di nyid de/ /chen po nyid kyi tshad du ni/ /nor byus 'dir ni shes par bya/ /gzhi med pa 'am bag tsam gyis/ /sdom brtson nyams par 'dod phyir ni/ /phas pham pa yis dzeesmad na ni/ /gnyis ka dge 'dun lhag mar shes/ /gang zhig cung zad bden par smra/ /'di ni bag tsam yang dag grags/ /rgyu mtshan med pa gzhi med yin/ /bag tsam nyid rab bstan pa ni/ /rab dang blo ldan dge slong ma/ /utpal mdog can zhes bya byung / /rdzing bu rab zhi zhes pa'i 'gram/ /gyad nor can yong nye bar 'ongs/ /de dang ha cang mi ring bar/ /sa las skyes dang mdza' bo gnas/ /der ni chu 'thungs 'ongs pa yi/ /ri dwags ri dwags mo ④spyod mthong / /de mthong sa las skyes kyis ni/ /mdza' bos mdza' bshes ⑨la dris 93—33

pa—/ /mi tshangs spyod dang dge slong dang / /dge slong ma yang mthong ngam ci/ /de yis ①mthong ngo zhes smras te/ /bag tsam 'di tsam las byung bas②/ /gyad nor bdag gis brlag bya zhes/ /de yis khros nas smras ①par zad/ /de la sogs pas kun bslang ba'i/ /bag tsam gyis duni bye brag dag /yid gcugs dman pa dag gis ni/ /dran par bya phyir gsungs pa yin/ /bzhams te bsgo sogs cho ga yis/ /lan gsum bar du bzlog na yang / /mi nyan dge 'dun mthun 'byed na/ /dge 'dun gyi ni lhag ma thob/ /gsol ba ma gtogs bzlog pa'i tshig /bzhams te bsgo ba zhes bya ste/ /tshe ldan khyod 'dir mchog gcig la/ /'di ma byed ces rgyas par ni/ /gzhams ⑤te bsgo bas mi gtong na—/ /las kyis de la bka' bsgo bya/ /de nas gsol dang bzhi las te/ /byis gang de yi dhigrogs byed pa/ /mchog gcig bsam pa gcig pa las⑦ /dbye ba rnam pa gnyis su gnas/ /tha dad dbye ba yang ni 'dir/ /rnam pa bcu bzhi dag tu bzhed/ /chos la chos ma yin brjod dang / /chos min la yang ④chos su brjod/ /'dul ba dang ni 'dul min nyid/ /bzhi po de la sogs pa brjod/ /'di ⑨la dbang byed mkhas pa yis/ /'gyed pa dang ni mi gdams dang / /ltung ba dang ni bya ba ste/ /rnam pa bzhir ni shes par bya/ /sna tshogs rtsod dang tshogs pa med/ /dge 'dun bsam pa tha dad pa'i/ /rkyen la sogs pas 'byung ba ste/ /rtsod pa yi ni dbang byas brjod/ /kun nas nyon mongs pas ltung ba/ /phan tshun du ni mi gdams pa/ /de ni ⑩rtsod pa las byung ba/ /mi gdams pa zhes bya bar grags/ /lus dang ngag yid kyis phye ⑪ba/ /de ltar tha dad gcig dang ni/ /rnam pa gnyis dang rnam pa gsum/ /93—34

ltung ba phyogs tsam brjod pa yin/ /khyem gcig dge slong bud med dang / /gal te mi shes lhan cig nyal/ /nub gsum bsnyen par ma rdzogs dang / /gnas gcig 'di ni lus kyi 'o/ /bud med dag la rkang ①pa ni/ /lnga 'am drug gis ②chos ston na/ /ma bsams par ni lhag pa'i tshig /smras pa la ni ngag gir brjod/ /gso sbyong dus tshe dris ①na yang / /skyon yod smra bar mi byed na/ /de la yid kyi rtsang ba ni/ /nyes byas nyid du mkhas pas rtogs/ /lus dang yid gnyis 'byel pa ni④/ /yang dag bsams nas srog gcod dang / /ma byen len dang chang 'thung sogs/ /brten pa nyid la'ang 'dod pa yin/ /yang dag bsams nas lnga dang ni/ /drug tsam smras pa lhag par brjod/ /ngag dang yid las gyur pa de/ /brdzun ⑤smra sogs la'ang 'dod pa yin/ /brdeg ces kun nas bsams nas ni/ /brjod de lus can la brdeg na/ /'di ni lus dang ngag yid kyidu/ /bya ba rnam pa gsum pa can/ /dge slong la ni mi dge bas/ /ltung bar 'gyur gyi sems dag ⑦na/ /mchod rten sku la skyes pa yi//rtswa sngon gcod par byed bzhin du/ /ji ltar dge ba'i sems kyis ni/ /ston pa la ni mchod 'dod pas/ /me tog phreng ba spel ba'i phyir/ /'thog pa de la de tsam min/ /ma bsams thub pa'i bslab pa 'am/ /dge 'dun nang khrims dral gyur na/ /lung ma bstan par gsungs pa ste/ /rtsang med dge ba nam yang min/ /yang dag bsams nas 'das na ni/ /mi dge ba nyid kho nar 'gyur—/ /'di ni rjes su ma gnang yang / /skabs 'ongs zhar la brjod pa yin—/ /de ltar rnam pa du ma yi/ /rtsang ba ⑧so so'i sgo nas 'dir/ /rtsod pa'i dbang du byas pa yi/ /rtsang ba 'di ni mkhas pas gsungs/ /gsol ba 93—35

la sogs las 'di dag /rung ba min zhes smra ba rnams/ /rtsod pa dang ni 'thab mo yang / /bya ba'i yang ni rgyu ru 'dod/ /dge 'dun 'byed par gang brtson pa'i/ /blo chung gis ni nyes byas thob/ /bzhams te bsgos kyang mi gtong na/ /nyes byas nyid du rnam par gzhag① /dang po nyid du gsol ba'i las / /brjod tshe mi gtong spom po nyid/ /brjod pa gnyis la'ang de yin te//mthar ni dge 'dun lhag ma nyid/ /snga ma'i brjod pa gnyis la ②ni/ /sbom po'o de rjes de la ni/ /gsum pa dge 'dun lhag ma ste/ /de ltar 'di ni legs par brtag /gang yang de rjes 'brang ba yi/ /dge slong sdig to can rnams kyang / /bzhams te bsgo sogs cho ga yi/ /sngar bzhin 'di dag kun la'ang 'gyur/ /khyim sun 'byen pa yis ni gzhan/ /sun 'byin pa ni rnam gnyis gsungs/ /gcig ni 'grogs pas yin te gzhan/ /gnyis pa yang ni longs spyod kyis/ /'grogs pa bud med lhan cig tu/ /rtse 'jo 'phyar g.yeng ①la sogs bsten④/ /longs spyod me tog 'bras bu dang / /bza' btung la sogs lhan cig byed/ /mig rna yid sogs shes pa yi/ /mthong ba la sogs rnam gsum 'dod/ /bzhams bsgo la sogs rim byas kyang / /mi gtong sngar bzhin nyes sogs lta/ /bka' blo mi bde bas kyang ni/ /dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung bar bstan/ /bka' blo mi bde phan rnams la/ /brjod rung ma yin tshig smra'o⑤—/ /phas pham la sogs gang zhig bslab/ /de ni bslab pa'i gzhi zhes bya/ /nyar ⑦bstan 'dul bar gang gsungs pa/ /'di la chos ldan dge slong rnams/ /gang zhig ston pa'i bka' la gtogs/ /chos mthun rnams kyis ⑦nges par bsgo/ /bzhams te bsgo ba la sogs la/ /mi gtong sngar bzhin nyes bya sogasaske/ /93—36

bcu gsum 'di dag dge 'dun las/ /ldang phyir dge 'dun lhag ma'o/ /phyi ma bzhi ni gsum gyis te/ /snga ma dgu ni cig car du/ /mtshon pa tsam du sbyar ba yis/ /dge 'dun lhag mar nges par bstan/ /ma nges pa yi chos gnyis ni//'dul ba las gsungs rab tu brjod/ /dge slong 'char kas sbeng ①ma dang / /lhan cig nyer gnas reg pa las/ /mgon pos dge 'dun tshogs dbus su/ /ma nges dang po'i chos bcas mdzad/ /dben gnas dge slong gcig pu zhig /bud med gcig dang 'dug byed na/ /'dod bsten rung ngam mi rung yang / /ma nges gnyis po'i ②chos su brjod/ /gang du gzhan med 'di dben te/ /skyabs yod kyis kyang sdernam pa ni/ /rtsig pa rib ma mun pa dang / /yol ba thibs ④po zhes bya lnga/ /gnas su 'gro dang 'dug pa 'am/ /nyal ba la sogs gang byas kyang / /dad pa can gyis tshig gis ni/ /dge slong de ni ldang bar 'os—/ /yang na de dag 'gro la sogs/ /cung zad tsam yang ma gtogs na/ /de yi ngo bo shes bya'i phyir/ /gsol ba'i cho ga sngon 'gros byin/ /rab tu byung dang bsnyen rdzogs dang / /de yis gzhan la nam yang ni/ /gnas bca' ba yang ⑤mi sbyin te/ /gzhan dang lhan cig 'chag pa'ang min/ /'dug stan la sogs gcig mi bya/ /de la chang 'di ma shi'i bar/ /btung ba yongs su ma chod phyir/ /'di dag ma nges chos zhes brjod/ /de ltar ma nges chos gsungs nas| /de las ji ltar ldang ba dang / /gang zag lhag ma mang po yi/ /mdun du rab gnas mchog gis so/ /zhag bcu 'das par dge slong gis/ /chos gos ma brtags 'chang na ni/ /spang ba'i rtsang byed sa rdul rjogyis/ /mgo bo g.yogs ⑦par byed pa yin/ /chos gos drubs dang tshon bsgyur ba/ /chos 93—37

gos zin par gyur pa na/ /chos gos 'dzin par khas len pa/ /'dir ni blo yis khas blang ngo / /mu bzhi can la 'dir brtag pa/ /sra brkyang dbyung ba byas nas ni/ /chos gos ma zin par ni min/ /de la sogs pas rnam par gzhag① /bal gos sha na nyi 'og dang / /ras gos dang ni zar ma dang / /ko tam pa dang du gu la/ /chos gos rgyu ni rnam pa bdun/ /spang bar 'os pa mi spong dang / /ltung ba bshags par mi byed na②/ /gal te phran tshegs de 'dra yang / /nub gcig bral bar mi byed pa/ /rigs tshigs gsum po 'di las ni/ /gcig ma tshang bar ma yin te/ /'di dag ma lus byas na ni/ /rtsang ba med par gsungs pa yin/ /gang yang lhung bzed dra ba sogs/ /nye bar bsags snenas der yang ni/ /de tshe gzhan skyel bshags mi byed/ /spang bya'i bultung ba nyid du 'gyur/ /gang 'dir zad byed ltung ba ni/ /nges par spangs nas bshags bya ste/ /gang phyir gang gis ngan song du/ /ltung phyir rtsang ba'i ming du btags/ /chos gos gsum gyi gnas bya ste/ /phyi rol 'di dag med par min/ /gzhan du dge slong nyes byas 'gyur/ /dge 'dun gyis gnas ⑤ma gtogs so/ /gnas gcig gnyis dang mang po yis/ /grong ni 'obs kyis bskor ba dang / /rtsig pa rib ma'i khongs su chud/ /nyer spyod gcig dang tha dad pa'o/ /nyer spyod sgong ba rjoskyed mos tshal/ /lha yi gnas la sogs pa'o/ /'di la thun mong gcig nyid de/ /tha dad sna tshogs nyer spyod nyid/ /rgyun srang gcig ni btod pa dag /gnas gcig pa zhes brjod bya ste/ /gdol pa ri khrod pa la sogs/ /rigs gcig pa yi gnas bzhin no/ /rigs gnyis gang du bram ze dang / /gdol pa gnas pa gnas gnyis brjod/ /93—38

sna tshogs rgyun srang btod ①pa la/ /mang po bar ni rab tu grags/ /nyer spyod nang gi ma lus dang / /de yi phyi rol 'dom gang yin/ /khyim bya 'phur chags tsam dag gam/ /gang du 'thag 'tshed ②la sogs tshad①/ /rigs dang tshong khang tshong 'dus dang / /khang thog g.yul sa mu stegs gnas/ /gru dang shing ljon shing rta dang / /kun dga' ra gcig sna tshogs spyod/ /spun rnams ma phye ba dang ni/ /skyes bu gcig gi yang ni rung / /ji ltar rigs par gsungs nyid kyis / /de yi nyer spyod gcig pa yin/ /'di yi nyer spyod snga ma ltar/ /nyer spyod sna tshogs pa yang ni/ /gang du 'di dag gi ni sgo/ /tha dad pa'am thun mong brjod/ /mang po yang ni rigs bzhin du/ /tshong khang la sogs 'dod pa yin/ /nyer spyod tshul ni ma lus pa/ /gcig dang sna tshogs dag tu dbye / /nyer spyod gcig dang sna tshogs su/ /mu stegs lta bas phye ba ste/ /gang du phyi rol spyod pa yis/ /gnas pa g.yang gzhi can la sogs/ /'khor los spyod pa la sogs khyim/ /thun mong sngags kyi rjokhyim kun te/ /gang du phyi rol rnga zlum dang / /gling bu la sogs 'grems pa'o/ /phan tshun yal ga ma bral na/ /shing sdong kun spyod gcig yin te/ /phyi rol nye 'khor byed grib bam//gang du thigs pas slebs pa'o/ /gang ⑤du nyer spyod gcig pa der/ /chos gos gsum ni nyer bzhag nas/ /gzhan du dge slong nyal gyur kyang / /rtsang ba bskyed par 'gyur ma yin/ /lha rten dag la sogs pa yi/ /thun mong sgo drug rjodag tu gos/ /sbas nas gzhan du 'dug na yang / /zad byed rtsang bar dzeeldan ma yin/ /'dom ni bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i bar/ /chos gos gsum dang bzhi gcig tu/ /nyer spyod dag tu song ba na/ /'dug 'greng 'bral ba ma yin no/ /93—39

chos gos yang dag yod na yang / /gzhan dag bsgrub par 'dod pa yis/ /byin gyis ma brlabs ①ma brtags par/ /zla ba las lhag gzhan ②mi bya/ /smin drug nas ni khra yi bar/ /dus kyi gos ni rnam par spyad/ /de las gang lhag dus min te/ /nye du sogs la yid brtan bya/ /dur khrod pa dang mi shes snedang / /shes pa nyid kyis rjochos gos dang / /song dang song ba ma yin ⑤dang / /phyag dar khrod ni lnga pa yin/ /dur khrod pa ni dur khrod spyod/ /sbyin po mi shes shes pa nyid/ /song ba ro yi gos la sogs/ /phyag dar khrod ni bor ba'o/ /rdul gyis 0sbags dang dgon pa dang / /srang bor me yis tshig pa dang / /mi gtsang gis gos phyag dar khrod/ /rnam pa lngar ni shes par bya/ /me yis tshig dang chu la bor/ /de bzhin pha ④mas byen pa nyid/ /byi ba'i so yis 'chos pa dang / /de bzhin be'us zos pa'o/ /gsar pa dang ni longs spyod ⑧bzod/ /chos gos rnam pa gnyis su 'dod/ /de yi cho ga ji skad bshad/ /de bzhin 'dir ni mngon par brjod/ /gsar pa'i gos la 'di bya ste/ /thog mar snam sbyar nyis ⑨rim drub/ /de bzhin du ni gding ba ste/ /chos gos gzhan la nam yang min/ /zla ba bzhi ⑩sogs longs spyad pa'i/ /gos de sdom brtson gyis rtogs ⑪na/ /snam sbyar la ni bzhi rim ste/ /gzhan dag la ni nyis rim bya/ /de las lhag pa mi sbyar te/ /rim pa de la sbyar bya yang / /bzo 'phror grur te bzhag pa ni/ /zhag bcu'i bar du rung ba yin/ /snam sbyar rnams kyi tshal bu ni// snral zhi ⑫bya'o dgu tshogs ⑫dgu/ /snam phran nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar/ /de dag dbye ba nges par bstan/ /glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa gsum/ /gsum ni glegs bu phyed dang bzhi/ /tha ma gsum gsum ④glegs bu ni/ /phyed dang lnga 93—40

par bya ba yin/ /sde tshan gsum po 'di dag gis/ /snam sbyar zhes byar gsungs pa ste/ /de dag tshad ni nges bstan pa/ /dang po khru ni lnga dang gsum//tha ma phyed dang gsum dang lnga/ /de gnyis bar ni bar ma yin/ /de bzhin bla gos nyid nga ①ste/ /lnga dang gsum par gsungs pa yin/ /gnyis lnga gnyis ni bzhi pa dang / /lnga pa yang ni mthang ②gos yin/ /gal te de dag ma 'byor na//rjes bzung don du 'khor gsum khebs/ /spyir na rang bzhin tshad ①rnams la/ /khru yi tshad du gzhag 0pa yin/ /shin tu ring dang thung ba la/ /lus kyi tshad du 'dod pa yin/ /dang po tha ma dag dang dbus/ /tshal bu'i sgo ni gsum du brjod//de yi sor ni bzhi dang gnyis/ /de yi bar ma rim pa bzhin/ /khru yi tshad las chung ba la/ /byin rlabs ⑤yid brtan 0mi dgos so/ /spu can la yang de bzhin te/ /de gyon grong du 'jug mi bya/ /dge 'dun lhan cig zan mi za/ /mchod rten la yang phyag mi bya/ /'di ni sbyin bdag gi'o zhes/ /yongs su brtags nas bcad par bya/ /ma dras chos gos gyon nas ni/ /grong du 'jug par mi bya ste/ /'jug na nges par dge slong dag /nyes byas 'gyur te med ma gtogs/ /mi mthun byed dang 'khrug long can/ /mu cor smra dang gtum po dang / /'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba la/ /mkhas pas yid brtan phyir mi gzhag⑦ /gal te yid ches dge slong zhig /chu yi pha rol gnas na yang / /de phyir de la chos gos kyi/ /yid brtan bya bar gsungs pa yin/ /gzhan der gnas pa'i dge slong dag /shi bar shes na ⑧chos gos ni/ /slar yang dge slong gzhan zhig gi⑨/ /ming gi yid brtan ⑩bya ba yin/ /chos gos yid brtan ⑪bya ba 'dir/ /mi rtag ⑫la min mngon sum min/ /de bzhin dge 93—41

tshul rnams la yang / /chos gos yid brtan bya ba min/ /gang dag gzhan gyis gtad nas ni/ /chos gos byen gyis brlab ①pa na/ /da chashi na yang dge slong des—/ /dge 'dun la ni dbul bar bya/ /chos gos gang brtags de yi mthar—/ /snag tsha la sogs thig le bya/ /bye brag bdag gi ①mtshan ma yang /khyad par rtogs par bya ba nyid/ /bar ma las ni yo byad drug /de nyid nad g.yog la byen nas/ /shi ba'i yo byad lhag ma ni/ /dge 'dun bsod nams 'grub phyir bgo/ /chos gos dras pa gsum dang ni/ /rngul gzan sham thabs gnyis gnyis te/ /g.yan pa dgab dang gding ba dang / /ras chen dang ni skra bzed dang / /gdong dang lag pa phyi ba ste/ /'di dag bcu gsum dbye bar 'dod/ /chos gos lhag sogs yo byad rnams/ /'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum po/ /dge slong chos gos rnams la ni/ /'chang ba'i tshul ni 'di yin te//nges par byen gyis brlab ④pa dang / /de las gzhan pa yid brtan bya/ /rngul gzan dumathang gos med par ni/ /chos gos chen po longs mi spyodadu/ /gang phyir longs spyod shes pa yis/ /phal pa yang ni bgo bar bya/ /kha bsgyur 'os pa kha bsgyur zhing / /drub par 'os pa drub pa dang / /byin rlabs 'os pa byin gyis brlab/ /brtag par 'os pa yid brtan bya/ /sngon po btsag dang ngur smrig rtsi⑦/ /'di dag rung ba'i tshon ④gsum ste/ /tshon ⑨chen dag gi chos gos ni/ /kha bsgyur byed pa bkag pa yin/ /rgya skyegs le brgan rtsi dang btsod//rma shing rtsi dang mthing shing mtshal/ /sind+ra ⑩ra dang gur gum ste/ /'di dag tshon chen brgyad du 'dod/ /seng ba phrug ⑪dang phying pa dang / /la ba shin tu mthug ⑫po dag /'di dag chos gos 'dod pa yis/ /dra bar bya ba ma yin no//93—42

sru can rnam par spangs ①nas ni/ /brtul zhugs can gyi nang shun bya/ /gding ba la ni dra mi dgos/ /rtag tu 'bral ba yang ni med/ /snam sbyar nges par dras te bcang / /gzhan dag ①ma nges gang gi phyir/ /'dod chung rang gi ①chos gos kyi/ /las kyis ④skyo ba skyed phyir ro/ /lnga pa sham thabs gyon nas ni/ /bya ba mtha' dag byed par rung / /bla gos sa phyogs gtsang mar ni/ /las yongs byed na ⑤bkag pa med/ /snam dusbyar dge slong 'dus pa dang / /zas dang mchod rten phyag byed dang / /grong sogs 'jug la bgo bya yi/ /gzhan dag tu ni bkag pa yin/ /la ba phrug dang phying ba dang / /rnga mo'i la ba dag dang ni/ /chos gos nyis ⑦rim gyon pa ni/ /mi gtsang phyogs su bkag pa yin/ /ma g.yogs gnas mal mi rung phyir/ /gzhan med bla gos bzhi bltab tu/ /byas te bting nas dran ldan pas/ /ldang pa yang ⑧zhing nyal bar bya/ /gzhan du chos gos ma khyer bar/ /gnas na gzhan gyi dkar po 'am/ /dras pa ma yin na yang rung / /byin gyis brlab par bya ba nyid/ /zas la nad pa ma gtogs par/ /gos gcig pa ni bkag pa yin/ /sdom brtson bgo ba med par ni/ /khrus byed bkag go med na ⑨rung / /mang pos blangs na la ba sogs/ /gcig rnyed pa ni kun gyis ⑩spyad/ /rjes su gnang ba ma gtogs par/ /gcig pus bdag gir mi bya'o/ /kha ma bsgyur bar nyin mo ni/ /phyi rol ngur sprig nges par g.yogs⑪/ /dge 'dun gos ni dran bzhin du/ /gnyis ka nas g.yogs spyad par bya/ /la ba'i spu ni phyir bstan nas/ /gyon te bcag ⑫par mi bya'o/ /srin sogs 'jigs pas 'dug pa dang / /nyal ba rjes su gnang ba nyid/ /dge 'dun rnams la be'u phrug re⑫/ /rjes su gnang ngo gang 93—43

zag la'ang / /par seg la ba dge 'dun la/ /la ba gzhan ni gang zag la'ang / /rjes gnang kun kyang la ba ste/ /'on kyang par sig yul nas byung //de ni par sig la ba'o/ /smad g.yogs bsdams ①pa'i don du ni/ /ska rags kyang ni rung ba yin/ /lteb ②ma dang ni shur bu nyid/ /gsum pa shur bu phre'u nyid—/ /rang gi bzang po gang gyur pa/ /thams cad dge 'dun nyid phyir spyad—/ /gding g.yogs dag ni med par yang / /nam yang mal stan longs mi spyad/ /dag par bya phyir sham thabs ni/ /btso blag snemakhan la 'khrur mi gzhug /brtse ldan rang ngam gzhan gyis kyang / /snod kyi nang du dal bus bkru/ /btso blag ④mkhan gyis ⑤brtse med par/ /gos dag drag tu sprugs brdabs narjo/ /tshags sran zad par byed pa'i phyir/ /bstan bcos las ni rab tu bkag /tshul ldan ji srid legs par ni/ /chos gos la sogs longs spyod pa/ /de srid rgyun mi 'chad par ni/ /sbyin bdag rnams kyi bsod nams 'phel/ /bsrung ba'i don du skra bzed ni/ /zheng du khru ni phyed dang gnyis/ /srid du khru ni gsum yin te/ /lhag pa brtag par mi bya'o/ /gal te chos gos 'tsher bag can/ /gzhan las dge slong gis rnyed na/ /'tsher bag chu yis nyams byas nas/ /yongs su spyad do gzhan du min/ /'tsher bag dang bcas 'jam po yi/ /chos gos bcang bar mi bya ste/ /'chang bar byed na de dag la/ /nges par 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur/ /mjes mas chos gos 'tsher bag can/ /mdzes dga' la ni nan gyis byen/ /de la kun nas chags skyes pas/ /de phyir bstan bcos che las bkag /gang des yongs su longs spyad par/ /bzod pa'i gos gzhan yod min na/ /rngul gyis 'jigs pas snam ⑦sbyar la/ /93—44

rngul gzan bltabs ①nas bcang bya ste/ /zheng du mtho gang srid du khru/ /phyed dang do las lhag mi bya/ /snam sbyar yongs su srung ②byed pa/ /btsag yug ①rnams kyis kha bsgyur bya/ /khyad par du yang bla gos kyi/ /tha ma yongs su zegs pa na/ / sgyung tshems rjol sogs yang dag sgrub/ /khab kyi las kyang rjes su gnang / /phyag dar khrod la dga' ches pas/ /bsams nas dral bar mi bya ste/ /nam yang chos gos don du yang / /rma med ro las mi blang ngo / /srin bu sogs kyis ⑤rma gtod kyang / /rang gnas zhag bdun bzhag nas ni/ /dur khrod pa yi dge slong gis/ /bkrus te kha bsgyur bcang bar bya/ /dge 'dun gyi ni mal cha dang / /stan ni de la bkag pa yin/ /dge slong khyem du mi 'jug ste/ /sgo drung bsod snyems blang bar bya/ /stan sogs 'dug par 'bod pa na/ /dur khrod pa zhes go byas nas/ /gnang phyir khyim du zhugs nas ni/ /stan la 'dug pa la sogs bya/ /mchod rten dag la phyag byed tshe/ /'dom gang nang du dor byas te/ /nya dang sha sogs mi bza' duzhing / /der ni gnas khang brtsig mi bya/ /kha ma bsgyur dang kha tshar can/ /be'u ras sogs dge 'dun rung / /tshon can rgyal byed tshal phul bas/ /des na be'u ras sogs bkag /spang bar bya ba'i dngos gang rung / /de ni dge 'dun la min te/ /gang gzhan phyis ni ster ba yi/ /gzhung lugs shes ⑦pa dag la spang ⑧/ /mi shes bzhin du chags bcas gang / /spangs nas zlog par mi byed cing / /legs bsgo ⑨byas kyang mi ster na/ /de la stobs kyis dbog ⑩par bya/ /'char ka'i khu ba'i thigs ⑪pa gang / /gos la babs mthong sbed ma yi/ /chags khyer bu yi rgyur gyur pas/ /de yis kun bslang 'di rab bcas/ /dge 93—45

slong gang zhig nye du min/ /dge slong ma la gos 'khru dang / /'tshed dang 'chag par byed pa ni/ /nges par ltung ba dang ni ldan/ /'khru ba la sogs byed 'jug na/ /gcig gis kyang ni nye bar 'joms/ /the tshom za na nye du la'ang / /nyes byas dri mar yongs su bsgrags/ /pha dang ma dang ma yi pha /nye bar bzung ste bdun brgyud ni/ /mkhyen chen gyis ni nye dur gsungs/ /de las gzhan ni gnyen mi ①nyid/ /tshos khu dngas ma la sogs pa/ /re re la yang 'og gzhi gding / /bslab pa'i gzhi ni nyams byed pas/ /dge slong la ni rtsang bar 'gyur/ /dge slong gang zhig nye du min/ /dge slong ma las bsams bzhin du/ /chos gos gang rung len byed na/ /de yi bslab gzhi nyams par byas/ /'di la slar sbyin ②dbrog mi bya/ /brje ba la ni nyes pa med / /ji ①ste brje na mnyam dhipos sam/ /dge slong ma yi 'dod pa bzhin/ /rgya chen nor ldan dge slong mas/ /gal te 'bul na nyes pa med/ /de bzhin legs gsungs bsnyen rdzogs byed/ /bor rlag gyur dang dbus ⑤yang ngo /dge slong chos gos gsum yod pas/ /nye du ma yin khyem bdag dang / /de yi bdag mo las kyang rung / /chos gos nam yang mi blang ngo / /kun du skyes pa khyem bdag ste/ /de yi bdag mor bud med brjod/ /bor rlag byung sogs slong ba ni/ /'di la nyes pa med par brjod/ /dbul po la ni bslangs pa yis/ /kha tshar la sogs thob pa dang / /gar mkhan la sogs pa yi gos/ /bzang po la yang nyes pa med/ /chos gos phrogs pa la sogs kyisarjo/ /mang po rnyed par gyur na yang / /dran pas stod g.yogs smad g.yogs las/ /lhag par blang bar mi bya'o/ /khru ni bcu gnyis stod g.yogs gos/ /smad g.yogs yang ni 93—46

bdun dang gnyis/ /re zhig 'di ni 'jig rten pa'i/ /stod g.yogs smad g.yogs zhes su gsungs/ /khru ni lnga gsum snam ①sbyar te/ /nyis rim ④stod g.yogs dag kyang ngo / /khru ni lnga dang gnyis po dag /re zhig bstan pa'i smad g.yogs so/ /bslangs nas dngos po lhag pa dag /gal te ga shed nas ni rnyed/ /de ni go byas bzlog byas te/ /rjes su gnang na blang bar bya/ /khyim bdag mo 'am khyim bdag gis/ /gos kyi rin ni spags na der/ /dge slong rnam par rtog ①bzhin du/ /slong na de ni ltung dang bcas/ /sngar bzhin nye du min zhes bya/ /chos gos rnam pa bdun po dag /yongs su spyad par bzod ④pa yis/ /gos de rung ba zhes bya'o/ /rin spags pa zhes bya ba ni/ /gser la sogs pa ma smos shing / /mgron du ma bos zhes pa ⑤ste/ / brtag btung 0dran par brjod pa'o/ /lnga dang bcu pa'i rin dag gis/ /nyos la byin zhes rjod ⑦byed cing / /sngon po sogs kyi kha dog ste/ /khru yi tshad kyis ⑧khru nyid do/ /rin la sogs pa gsum dag gis/ /slong ba'i tshe na nyes byas te//thob na spang ba'i ltung bar 'gyur/ /ma bslangs na ni ma yin no/ /chos gos phrogs pa la sogs pas/ /gang yang rung ba blang bya ste/ /dge slong rtags kyis lus la 'dir/ /ma g.yogs nam ⑨yang mjes ma yin/ /so sor dpag ⑩pa la yang ni/ /thams cad sngar bzhin kho na ste/ /ji ltar byas pas rtsang ba dang / /ltung ba med pa yang ni grags/ /bdag cag mi rung gnas brjod nas//pho nya las ni rin mi blang / /legs sbyin chos gos bdag cag rung / /zhal ta pho nya de la brjod/ /de yis gang tshe chos gos rin/ /zhal ta byed la gtad pa na//dge slong chos gos don gnyer des/ /lan drug bar du dran par bya/ /der 93—47

ni mngon par grub na ni/ /der ni blang bar rung ba nyid/ /de las lhag par brtson byed na/ /lhung ba'i tshang tshing nang du rtsang / /'di la lan drug bskul nas ni/ /rang nyid 'ongs nas ster byed na/ /dge slong gis ni 'di skad brjod—/ /bdag gis ①'di spangs dgos pa med/ /de lta na yang gal te de/ /shin tu phyag sogs sngon 'gro bas/ /ster na dge slong len pa la/ /rtsang ba med par gsungs pa yin/ /bud med dang ni rgyal srid la/ /dbang bskur gyur tam bram ze'am/ /rgyal po'i gnang chen pa la gtogs/ /blon po'am dmag dpon la sogs 'dod/ /'dug sa tshong khang chu gnas dang / /'bod gnas dang ni khyem gnas so/ /tshong khang gang du nyo tshong byed/ /chu gnas chu snod sbed pa'i sa/ /'bod gnas 'byeg mkhan dag dang ni/ /rdza mkhan la sogs ming ②can gyi'o/ /khyem gnas khyem du rab brjod pa/ /'di dag 'bod gnas bzhir gsungs so/ /tshur spyon legs par byon nam khyod/ /gdan 'di la yang bzhugs nas ni/ /phyag zhabs legs par bkra ba skedang / /bza' dang btung ba dgyes bzhin gsol/ /lan drug bskul pa'i sgo der yang //ma thogs par ni rjod byed na/ /rtsang med thogs nas rjod byed pa/ /lhung bar 'gyur ba kho na'o/ /gal te pho nya mi ma yin/ /sbyin bdag dang ni gnyis ༷pa'ang / /sdom brtson nyer ⑤byas gsum gyi ni/ /dbyug pa rnams kyis mgo bo 'joms—/ /sbyin bdag mi yin pho nya dang / /zhal ta pa ni mi min na/ /nyes byas gnyis so zhal ta tsam/ /mi ma yin na nyes byas gcig /gang du sbyin bdag pho nya dang / /zhal ta pa yang mi yin na/ /de ni nges par lhung byed bskyed/ /khrims ldan ngan song gsum du 'phenadu/ /dge slong gang zhig 93—48
