nams 'bras bu yin/ /ma lus pa yi mi rnams dang / /rin chen bdun sogs phun tshogs pa'i/ /'khor los sgyur la spyod pa gang / /de ni bsod nams 'bras bu yin/ /phun tshogs ①sum cu rtsa dbang 'dra/ /thob nas gang zhig spyod pa dang / /thags zangs ris sogs lha min rnams/ /de ni bsod nams 'bras bu yin/ /'jig rten skyong ba bzhi rnams kyis/ /nor gyes gzhi yi ⑤'byor pa la/ /dga' bas sna tshogs longs spyod gang / /de ni bsod nams 'bras bu yin/ /dga' ba'i tshal la sogs pa ⑦ni/ /lha mo rnams dang ldan chocig tu/ /'byor ldan lha rnams spyod pa gang / /de ni bsod nams 'bras bu yin/ /sna tshogs lha yi rgyal srid sogs/ /phun sum tshogs la lha dbang ni/ /rtag tu dga' bas spyod pa gang / /de ni bsod nams 'bras bu yin / /gzhal yas khang gnas lha rnams ni/ /ji ltar mngon 'dod lha rnams kyis/ /longs spyod la ni longs spyod gang / /de ni bsod nams 'bras bu yin/ /gang su gnas ni bcu po yi'u / /tshe dang mdog la sogs pa yis⑥/ /lha rnams las kyang lhag pa'i lha/ /de ni bsod nams 'bras bu yin/ /'dod khams mchog gyur sna tshogs pa'i/ /lha yi longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /'dod khams dbang phyug la spyod gang / /de ni bsod nams 'bras bu yin/ /lha rnams dang ni mi rnams su/ /ji ltar dga' ba'i 'dod pa ni/ /'bad pa med pa thob gyur gang / /de ni bsod nams 'bras bu yin/ /gang yang tshangs pa lha sogs lha/ /bsam gtan sa pa bsam gtan gyikye/ /bde ba'i dam pa thob gyur pa/ /de ni bsod nams 'bras bu yin/ /bsam gtan bsam gtan las byung dang / /sred pa zad pa'i bde ba gang / /zhi ba'i bde 93—1296

ba thob gyur pa/ /de ni bsod nams 'bras bu yin/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang nyan thos gang / /yon tan mchog dang ldan gyur cing / /rdzu 'phrul che zhing bdag nyid che/ /de ni bsod nams 'bras bu yin/ /gang yang bskal pa brgya 'das nas/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub ni/ /bdag nyid che ba thob gyur pa//de ni bsod nams 'bras bu yin/ /tshad med pa dang dpe med pa'i/ /yon tan gyis ni legs brgyan pa'i/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su gyur pa gang / /de ni bsod nams 'bras bu yin/ /gzugs dang lang tsho bsngags par 'os/ /skyes bu rigs kyi rgyun gyur dang / /rang dang rjes mthun yid 'phrog pa'i/ /bud med bsod nams bdag gis 'thob/ /bsod nams kyis ni mtho ris 'thob//lha yi bu mo'ang bsod nams kyis/ /'dod pa kun yang yang tshodag 'byor/ /mngon 'dod bsod nams rnams kyang 'thob/ /bsod nams kyis ni blo rno dang //de bzhin blo gros dri med 'thob/ /bsod nams kyis ni gnas la dad/ /bsod nams kyis ni drang gsal 'thob/ /sdug pa nyid dang sgra mkhas dang / /dbyangs snyan grags ldan bsod nams kyis/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'byor pa rnams / /thams cad bsod nams dag gis 'thob/ /bsod nams kyis ni mi 'thob pa'i/ /bde ba rmye 'jig rten dag na med/ /de bas bde ba 'dod rnams kyis/ /rtag tu bsod nams bsags par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam khrugazigs la/ /bsod nams nyung lkuzad ngas byas pas/ /'bras bu shin tu rgya che ba/ /ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa 'thob④/ /'dod khams lha tshogs drug po ru/ /rgyal srid dbang phyug rgyabadag po ni/ /skye ba stong phrag bye ba ru/ /nga yis dubade lo yang dag spyad/ /dpag med 'gran zla med pa dang / /de 93—1297

bzhin mi yi dam pa yi/ /'khor lo bsgyur rmye tshogs gyur pa yi bye sna nga yis longs spyod phun tshogs spyad/ /bsod nams de yi bdag nyid che/ /nga ni gang dang gar skyes pa/ /de dang der ni mthu che ba'i/ /bde dang bdag ni ldan par gyur/ /gzugs ldan thos pa phun sum tshogs/ /kha nas utpal (ṭwādri byung zhing / /sdug cing tshig ni gzung pya'os dang / /shin tu yid 'ong dbyangs snyan ldan / /da lta'ang bsod nams de nyid kyis/ /nga yi gzugs sogs yon tan ni/ /phun sum tshogs shing yid 'ong ba/ /mngon par 'dod pa 'di la ltos / /nor rdzas longs spyod che ba yi/ /rgyal chen rigs su skyes pa dang / /'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser 'dra ba'i/ /gos kyis lus la bkab /snyepa yin/ /nga'i lus yan lag thams cad las/ /tsan dan lta bu'i dri byung zhing / /kha nas utpal sngon po yi/ /dri nyid 'byung bar gyur pa yin/ /gos dang rin chen la sogs pa'i/ /phun tshogs gang zhig mngon 'dod na/ /de yang bsams pa tsam gyes ni/ /thams cad nga ni 'byor par gyur/ /shākya seng ge'i bstan pa las/ /rab tu byung ba ngas rnyed nas/ /dgra bcom nyid ni ngas thob ste/ /nga ni bsil gyur mya ngan 'das/ /'di nga'i skye ba tha ma ste/ /yang srid bdag la yod ma yin/ /gnas med mya ngan 'das nas ni/ /slar yang nga ni 'ong mi 'gyur/ /rnam smin 'bras bu rgya che ba'i/ /las gang bsgrub par gyur pa ni/ /da ltar 'di ltar yod zin kyang / /de yi mthar thug byum gtogs so/ /de ltar de las rmad du byung ba dang / dpag tu med pa dang /bsam gyis nami khyab pa'i bsod nams kyi kyeche ba'i bdag nyid thob pas srog chags brgya stong bye ba dpag tu med pa mchog tu dad pas brlan pa'i sems kyi 93—1298

rgyud dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la bsnyen bkur bya ba la rgyab kyis phyogs pa rnams kyang sbyin pa ni gtong ①bsod nams dag ni byed cing smon lam 'debs par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa gser mdog gis skye bo'i tshogs mang po de ltar rnam pa du mar bsod nams la gus pa bskyed hūṃpar bya ba'i phyir bsod nams kyi bdag nyid che ba rab tu bshad nas/ steng gi nam mkha' de nyid nas rdzu 'phrul gyis rngudur khrod chen por song pyaste/ gnas brtan kun dga' bo la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun ⑤la rim bzhin du phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgras blon po rab gtum phrag dog gi ⑪rang bzhin can gyis bu mo ka shi mdzes dga' mo sdug bsngal 'di dang 'di byas la gzhon nu gser mdog la skur pa btab ste/ nyes pa med pa nyid du gsad ⑦pa'i phyir yongs su spangs so zhes ji ltar grags pa thos so/ /thos nas kyang shin tu khros shepas 'khrugs pa'i mig gis nang 'khor rnams la smras pa/shes ldan dag ci'i phyir 'di lta bu'i skyes bu ngan pa 'dis las su bya ba'i tha snyad bya—/ blon po rab gtum ni ngas rnam pa thams cad du spangs so/ /blon po rab gtum yang de nyid du 'dus par gyur to/ /kye de nas blon po rab gtum gyis rgyal po'i tshig de thos pa dang / 'chi bas 'jigs skrag cing yi mug la rmongs pa'i mig gis yan lag thams cad rab tu 'dar bzhin du myur bar langs te rings par 'bros par brtsams pa dang / der skye bo'i tshogs mang po'i nang du zhugs te gnas pas de'i phyi nas srog chags brgya stong du ma zhig gis bdas te/ skye bo'i tshogs mang pos kun nas bskor nas gzung ⑪ngo / /bzung nas kyang thal lcag dang rdog shā4pa la sogs pas bsnun pa la zhugs te/93—1299

de brdegs bzhin du shin tu sdug bsngal drag po'i shugs kyis nyam thag cing cho nges 'debs pa la zhugs te/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo yongs su skyobs shig /bdag ni mgon med pa/ skyob ①pa med pa/ skyabs byumed pa/ snang ba med pa lags kyi sdug pa'i srog gis bskyab ṅkutu gsol/ gnas brtan kun dga' bos kyang skye bo'i tshogs mang po la smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed rnams kyis 'di cem bsad cig⑤ /ngas rgyal po ma skyes dgra la shes par bya'o/ /de nas skye bo mang po'i tshogs de rnams kyis gnas brtan kun dga' bo'i tshig thos nas de 6btang ngo / /gnas brtan kun dga' bos kyang rgyal bo la gzigs pa dang /rgyal pos gsol pa/ ci zhig gsung / gnas brtan kun dga' bos smras pa/rgyal po chen po 'di thong shig(rngu /rgyal pos gsol pa/ dam zhig bcas la gtang zubar bgyi ste/ gal te legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung nas ji srid 'tsho'i ⑨bar du gnas brtan gyi bsnyen bkur bgyid na gtang skyebar bgyi'o/ /gnas brtan kun dga' bos smras pa/ de bzhin du bya'o/ /de yang skye bo'i tshogs de rnams kyis brtse ba med par brdegs par sdug bsngal drag po'i tshor bas bcom nas brgyal te 'dug pa dang / gnas brtan kun dga' bos tshe dang ldan pa /1gser mdog la gsungs pa/ bden 8pa'i byin gye rlabs kyis 11blon po rab gtum gyi lus la sdug bsngal gye tshor ba rab tu sol cig/de nas tshe dang ldan pa gser mdog sems can thams cad la phan pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pas rab tu zhugs pa'i sems dang / bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs byed pa la zhugs te/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis blon po rab gtum 'di ltar shin tu gnod pa byed pa yin yang bdag gis tha na khong khro ba phran tshegs 93—1300

kyang mabaskyed pa'i bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des kye'adi'i lus la sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba med de slar sos par gyur cig /bden pa'i byin gyi rkashebarlabs byas pa'i mod kho na la blon po rab gtum gyi lus sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba dang bral te/lus bde bar gyur nas langs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la shin tu dad par gyur nas gnas brtan kun dga' bo'i lkugan du song ste/ zhabs gnyis la phyag byas nas smras pa/ gnas brtan kun dga' bo bdag ni legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung dnghaste bsnyen par sdogs shing dge slong gi dngos po thob par bgyis la/ bdag gnas brtan kun dga' bo'i thad du tshangs par spyod pa (snyespyad par bgyi bar 'tshal lo/ /de nas gnas brtan kun dga' bos kyang rab tu phyung ste/ ji ltar des skad cig ma de nyid la bron mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid thob pa de ltar rjes su bstan byupa mdzad pa dang / des kyang dgra bcom pa nyid thob pa dang / de nam mkha'i dkyil du 'phags te/ cho 'phrul rnam pa pesna tshogs pas skye bo'i tshogs mang po yid tshim par byas nas nam mkha'i dkyil nas babs te/ gnas brtan kun dga' bo la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams la rim bzhin du phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas rmad du byung ba de snyedang / gnas brtan kun dga' bo'i bdag nyid che ba mthong nas 'khor de rnams gnas brtan kun dga' bo la rab tu dad par gyur to/ /de nas 'khor de rnams de ltar mngon par dad pa la gzigs nas gnas brtan kun dga' bos gang zhig thos pas srog chags brgya stong dpag tu med pa rnams kyis khyad par chen po thob par gyur pa de ltar chos bstan ⑨par mdzad de/ la la ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 93—1301

'bras bu thob pa nas/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon du byas pa'i bar dang / la la ni nyan thos kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed rmyepa nas la la ni sangs rgyas la gzhol ba dang / chos la 'bab ldupa dang / dge 'dun la bab 1pa'i bar la rnam par bkod do/ /ded dpon nyi ma chung ma dang bcas pas kyang bden pa mthong bar gyur to/ /de nas lha brgya stong dpag tu med pa rab tu dang ba'i yid dang ldan pa rnams kyis lha'i gos kyi gechar phab byecing lha'i rol mo rnams kyang brdungs par 6gyur pa dang / lha'i me tog utpa la dang / padma dang / ku mu ta kyedang / puṇḍa rī reka dang / man dā ḍar ba la sogs pa me tog pus mo nub pa tsam rnam pa sna tshogs pas dur khrod chen bo der chal bar bkram mo/ /de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgras lha dang mi rnams shin tu 'dun par byed pa'i cho 'phrul rmad du byung ba rkade mthong ba dang / mchog tu dad pas sems kyi rgyud dga' bar gyur nas ched du brjod pa ched du brjod de/ e ma'o ngo mtshar che ba e ma'o rmad du byung ba/ e ma'o 'phags pa kun dga' bo rang gi yon tan gyi bdag nyid chen po rab tu bstan te/ e ma'o de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i bdag nyid che ba gsal bar mdzad pa/ e ma'o gang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen zhing hūṃgazigs pa de dang / gnas brtan 'od srungs chen pos 'di la bstan khu pa rnam par gtad pa de ni 'bras bu yod par mdzad do/ /e ma'o de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyi ma nub par gyur nas 'phags pa kun dga' bo'i nyi ma rang gi yon tan gyi 'od zer gyi dra bas phyogs thams cad du khyab par mdzad do/ /e ma'o de bzhin gshegs pa'i zla ba mi rtog ⑫ pa'i lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan 93—1302

gyis lkuzin nas/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo'i zla bas rang gi bla gos snyekyi 'od zer rnam par bkye bas gdul bya'i ku mu ta'i —nags rab tu rgyas par mdzad do/ /e ma'o de bzhin gshegs pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal tsha ba rtsub pa'i nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis kun du gdungs pa gnas brtan kun dga' bo'i sprin chen pos rang gi bdud rtsi'i char gyis 'jig rten rnams tshim par mdzad do/ /e ma'o de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs la dgongs pa yang dag par sdogs par mdzad do/ /e ma'o de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i grub pa nyid bstan pa mdzad do/ /e ma'o de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa gces zhipar 'dzin pa nyid gsal bar mdzad do/ /e ma'o nyan thos kyi mchog nyid 'bras bu yod par mdzad do/ /shin tu rmad du byung ba 'di dang rang gi yon tan gyi 6che ba'i stobs dang /mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams ④rdzogs par mdzad pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan gyi bdag nyid che ba rab tu mdzad do/ /e ma'o bdag nyid chen po 'dis bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de'i bka' drin la lan glan pa'i blo gros ston par mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas rgyal po de gnas brtan kun dga' bo la rab tu dad pa'i shugs kyi bsngas 87pa'i sems kyi rgyud kyi/gnas brtan kun dga' bo'i gan du song ste/ lus thams cad kyis kyeganas brtan kun dga' bo'i zhabs gnyis la phyag byas te/ langs nas pus mo gnyis sa la btsugs ⑩te/ rab tu dad pas ba spu langs par te1rtsub par byas pa'i lus dang lag pa thal mo sbyar te gnas brtan kun dga' bo la mngon par bstod par rtsom pa/ skyes bu'i mchog 15la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thos pa'i rgya mtsho phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa gces 'dzin pa/ /rmad byung bsam yas ⑫93—1303

phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas bstan stipa yi/ /bdag nyid che ba yang dag bstanakye/ /rmad byung bsam gyis ① mi khyab pa'i/ /'gro la phan de khyod kyis mdzad/ /gang de bcom ldan 'das dang ni/ /'phags pa 'od srungs blo ldan pas/ /khyod la bstan pa rnams gtad pa/ /deng de 'bras bu bcas par mdzad / /rmad byung bsam kyis mi khyab pa'i/ /'gro ba'i don chen mdzad pa 'di / /kun mkhyen yon tan bdag nyid che/ /de ring khyed la gzugs brnyan gyur/ /gal te rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /de ltar 'gro don mdzad gyur kyang / /'di ni kun mkhyen thams cad gzigs/ /thugs rje ldan pas mtshar mi che/ /khyed ni nyan thos nyid 'gyur zhing / /thugs rje che ldan de bzhin du/ /sems can don chen gang mdzad pa/ /'di ni shin tu ngo mtshar che//e ma'o 'di ltar bag med pa/ /ma ga dhwa byeyi skye bo 'dis/ /khyed 'dra phan la brtson mdzad pa/ /rnyed pa legs par rnyed pa yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas 'di ni/ /bstan pa khyed la gtad gyur pa/ /gang gis der ni bde 5gshegs bzhin/ /rmad byung shin tu chen po mdzad/ /de nas hūṃganas brtan kun dga' bo'i yon tan gyi bdag nyid chen po'i ngo mtshar gyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rjes su dran nas rtag tu phyag 'tshal ba/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog /gang khyed nyan thos 'di lta bur/ /rtag tu 'gro la phan brtson pa/ /dpa' bo chen po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag nyid che/ /mthong ba nyid du yang dag bstan/ /ji ltar 'gro tshogs 'di khyed kyisathu/ /stong pa min pa snyam du sems/ /de nas rgyal pos gnas brtan kun dga' bo la zhus pa/ gnas brtan ded dpon nyi ma 93—1304

chung ma dang bcas pas sug las ci zhig bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas phyug pa dang / nor che ba dang / longs spyod che bar gyur pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la bden pa mthong bar gyur/ dge slong ka shi mdzes dga' bo dang / dge slong rab gtum gyis las ci zhig bgyis 7snan/ las de'i rnam par smin pas phyug pa dang / nor che ba dang / longs spyod che bar skyes shing bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas —snanyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis/ dge slong gser mdog gis khulas ci zhig bgyes na las de'i rnam par smin pas phyug cing nor che ba dang longs spyod che ba'i rigs su skyes shing 'di ltar gzugs bzang ba chodang /blta na sdug pa dang / mdzes pa dang / yan lag dang / nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa dang / gser btso ma'i mdog gi kha dog shin tu rgyas pa dang /ldan pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi yid dang mig 'phrog 5pa dang / gser gyi mdog can gyi gos kyis hūṃlus dkris pa dang / 'di'i yan lag thams cad nas tsan dan gyi phyudri 'byung ba dang 'di'i kha nas utpa la'i dri 'byung ba dang /de skyes pa tsam gyis khyem der gos kyi char byedang / me tog kar ni ka ra'i khya char 'bab par gyur cing gos de dag kyang gser gyi mdog can nyid du gyur pa dang / 'di ltar shin tu rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑪ bstan pa la rab tu byung nas/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis lags/ gnas brtan kun dga' bos gsungs pa/ rgyal po chen po 'di rnams nyid kyis sngon gyi shā7skye ba gzhan du las gang zhig byas shing bsags pas/ 'di rnams nyid kyis nyu5las byas shing 93—1305

bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis ①so sor myong bar 'gyur/ rgyal po chen po las byas shing khyabasags pa dag ni sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/ rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyi—/ 'di ltar las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung bo dang / khams dang skye ①mched rnams la rnam par smin par 'gyur te / las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za zhing tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed nas lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /rgyal po chen po sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus hūṃbaskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ⑤'jig rten du byung ste/ de mnyan skyeldan zhes bya ba'i rgyal po'i pho brang nas byung ste/mnyan pyaldan gyi tshal lkuzhes bya ba na bzhugs so/ /yang de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po'i pho brang mnyen posnaldan na rna can zhes bya ba'i ded dpon phyug pa/ nor mang ba—/ langs lkuspyod che ba/ yongs su bzung ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi ⑪bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi ⑫bu la nor gyis 'gran pa rgyal po'i pho brang mnyen lte5 ldan na skyes bu'i mchog tu gyur pa zhig gnas pa dang /der rigs 6mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed dga' bar byed dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /de ltar rtse zhing dag dkul dga' mgur spyod pas chung ma sems can dang ldan par gyur pa nas/ ji srid 93—1306

ded dpon rna can tshong pa lnga brgyas bskor te/ rgya mtsho chen por zhugs kyi bar du sbyar ro/ /de yang mngal du ji ltar skye 17bar gyur pa de ltar ded dpon rna can gyi tshong sar gtogs pa dang / zhing du gtogs pa dang / yul gzhan du gtogs pa'i nor gyi rigs las der la la ni mes tshig /la la ni rkun mas khyer/la la ni mi rnams kyis khyer te bros par gyur to/ /ji tsam na ded dbon rna can gyi chung ma zla ba tshang pa dang bu skyes par gyur te/ pags 37pa nag po/ shin tu gzugs mi sdug pa/ mi sdug pa'i mtshan ma bco brgyad kyis lus smad par byas pa/ de'i kha dang de'i lus las gang zhig bsnams na khyem na gnas pa'i 'khor shin tu yang gdong rgyab kyis phyogs par gyur pa de lta bu'i shin tu dri mi zhim par gyur to/ /khye'u de skyes pa tsam gyis gang gi rnyikhyem der rdzas hūṃm lus par tshig par gyur pa ⑪ de lta bu'i me byung ba dang / ded dpon gyi chung ma nyam thag pas khye'u de thogs te khyim de las byung ngo / /gang gi tshe yang me des ༄ byekhyem de dang rdzas ma lus par bsregs nas rang nyid zhi bar gyur pa de'i tshe ded dpon gye chung ma gnas ngan pa phyed tshig pa'i zhig ral can zhig tu zhugs nas gos phyed sa la bting ⑦ste byis pa bsnyal byenas tsha ba'i dbugs ring po phyung ste/ ded dpon rjes su dran zhing ngu ba la zhugs so/ /kyi hud 'di lta bu'i phyin ci log kun du gnas pa ni sdug bsngal lo/ /ded dpon rna can gyi bran pho pedang /bran mo dang / las byed pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis tergud pa gang yin pa de mthong ba dang / yu bu cag kun kyang brlag ⑪par 'gyur gyi/ 'deng ⑫zhes smras te/skrag ⑫pas ded dpon gyi chung ma spangs nas thams cad bros par gyur to/ /der mngag gzhug pa'i bu mo gcig gis rmyebasams pa/ ngas ni ded dpon rna 93—1307

can gyi khyem phun sum tshogs pa du ma la kun du longs spyad nas/ da ded dpon gye chung rmyem gnas skabs 'di lta bur gyur pa na gcig pu spangs nas 'bros pa gang yin pa ni bdag gi tshul dzudang mthun pa ma yin no snyam nas/ de gcig sno pu ded dpon rna can gyi chung ma'i gan na rgya 'dug go/ /ded dpon gye chung ma de'i nor thams cad mes bsregs pas nyi ma gcig ⑤gi bza' ba yang med par gyur to/ /de nas bu mo mngag gzhug de ded dbon rna can gyi mdza' bo dang 'byel pa dang / gnyen rnams gang yin pa de rnams kyi gan du song ste smras pa/bzhin bzangs dag ded dpon rna can gyi chung ma gnas skabs 'di lta bu la gnas na de gso zhing bskyang bar mdzod cig dang zhes khyasmras pa dang / de nas de rnams de gso zhing bskyang shaṃb la zhugs pa de nyid kyi tshe de rnams kyi rigs la yang sdug bsngal brgya phrag byung bar gyur pa dang / de rnams kyis bsams pa ded dpon rna can gyi bu 'di shin tu bkra mi shis pa zhig ste/ 'di'i bsod nams ma yin pa'i stobs kyis ded dpon rna can gyi khyem gye 'byor ba shin tu rgya che ba rnam par 'jig par 'gyur la/ de gal te yu bu cag rnams kyis gsos shing bskyab 8na yu bu cag rnams kyi khyim du yang 'di lta bu'i gnas skabs 'byung bar 'gyur gyi9sna/ 'di ltar yang rnam pa thams cad du ming tsam yang gzung bar rigs pa ma yin no snyam nas/ bu mo mngag gzhug pa shā snade la smras pa/khyed phyin nas kyang nged kyi khyim du 'jug par yang ma byed cig /bu mo de ltar bar bcad pa dang bsams pa/ da ni ded dbon gyi chung ma rnam pa thams cad nas thams cad du smra ba kyemed par gyur na de ji ltar bsgrub par bya/ gzhan du na ngas ni khur 'di blangs pa yin kyi/ shin tu 'bad pa nyid kyis da bdag gis 93—1308

ded dpon gyi chung ma bskyang bar bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas gzhan gyi khyem du song nas gla ba'i las byed pa la zhugs nas der gla gang dag rnyed pa des ded dpon gye chung ma ①bdag nyid dang / khye'u gso ba la zhugs so/ /khye'u de ni shin tu yang mi sdug pas mi sdug pa zhes ming btags so/ /bu mo mngag gzhug 4snamo de yang las kyi dbang gis nyi ma re re zhing gla'i rnyed pa thob par gyur to/ /de nas de srog chags gsum po shin tu nyam nga bas gso bar rtsom byepa dang / ded dpon gyi chung mas bsams pa/ nga ni bran pho chodang / bran mo dang / las byed pa'i mi dang / mdza' bshes dang / nye du rnams kyis yongs su spangs nas gang bdag cung zad 'tsho ba 'di ni bu mo mngag gzhug ma 'di'i yon tan yin pas 'di ni nga'i ma dang 'dra bar brtse ba yin mod kyi/ de dus ji srid cig cho/tu gcig pus las byed mi nus te yongs su skyo bar 'gyur la/ gla ji tsam rnyed pa des kyang 'tsho ba thumi nus kyis/ des na ngas kyang rang gi nyes pa nyams su myong bar bya zhing gla mi'i las bya'o zhes rnam par bsams nas/ bu mo mngag gzhug ma de dang lhan cig gzhan gyi khyim du zhugs te gla mi'i las byed par brtsams pyapa dang / de shin tu yang gzhon sha can yin pas bkres pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis yongs su gzir zhing las pa na yang dang yang du brgyal bar gyur to/ /de nas yongs su skyo bas dbugs tsha ba ring po byung nas ded dpon rna can rjes su dran zhing ngu ba la zhugs te/ kyi hud 'di lta bu'i phyin ci log kun du gnas pa ni sdug bsngal lo/ /gang grong khyer ma lus pa'i mchog du gyur cing / dpal gyi phun sum tshogs pa nyams su myong nas kyang tshe 'di 2/la grong khyer thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur nas/ da ltar gzhan gyi khyem du gla mi'i las 93—1309

byed pa'i sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde ba rjes su myong bar gyur to/ /de de stiltar sdug bsngal gyis dāyongs su gzir zhing ngu ba la bltas nas bu mo mngag gzhug ma de cho nges 'debs khupa la zhugs te/ kyi hud tshe 'di nyid la ded dpon rna can gyi chung ma ras ka shi pa la sogs pa gos sna tshogs gyon pa dang /lus la dri zhim pa'i me tog gi phreng ba du mas brgyan pa dang / khur thub la rdzas dri zhim po du ma sbyar ba'i dri zhim pos bsgos ⑩ pa dang / lha'i bu mo bzhin du dga' 'uba'i tshal gye skyed mos tshal du song nas bran po pedang / bran mo dang /las byed pa'i mi dang / mdza' bshes dang / nye du rnams dang / zas dang skom dang / gos dang / rgyan la sogs pa ci rigs par 'ged bye 7 pa yin narngu//da ni tshe 'di nyid du skra sbags (rte shing lus la dri ma'i tshogs kyis gos pa dang /bkres pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis ⑪lus dang / yan lag la sogs pa thams cad yongs su skams pa/ ras rnyings shing dengs la shin tu dri ma can kyi dum bu ras rnying snyezhig brgya stong gi gnas su gyur pas rked pa'i phyogs bkab pa/grong khyer ba thams cad kyi tha chad du gyur nas gzhan gyi khyim du gla ⑫mi'i las byed pas sdug bsngal dang / yid mi bde ba chen po nyams su stsong bar 'gyur ro/ /kye ma'o skal ba'i ⑫phyin ci ⑫log /kye ma'o longs spyod rnams kyis shin tu g.yo ba—/ kye ma'o las rnams kyi rnam pa sna tshogs pa yang smras pa/ dar gyi gos sogs rab gyon zhing / /rgyan rnams kun gyis ⑫rab brgyan te/ /sngon chad lha yi bu mo 'dra/ /da ltar lam po che na 'khyams7/ /skal ba de nyid zad gyur pas / /lus la dri mas gos gyur cing 'u/ / /ras rnying dri nga'i dum bu gyon/ /da lta 'di 'dra gyur pa yin/ /sngon ni lha yi bu mo ltar/ /skyes pa'i mig gi 93—1310

bdud rtsir gyuralku/ /da ltar yi dwags mo 'dra bar/ /mthong nas de nyid yid kyang skyo/ /sngon ni nor gyis khyaphun sum tshogs/ /grong khyer pa yi mchog gyur gang / /de ni da ltar phongs pa bas/ /shin tu phongs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /sngon gyi phun tshogs chen po la/ /dga' bas yongs su longs spyod pa/ /mya ngan sdug bsngal ldan pa yi/ /gnas skabs de 'dis thob rngo —par gyur/ /kye ma'o 'khor ba'i bdag nyid ngan/ /kye ma'o phun tshogs mi rtag nyid/ /gang zhig de ltar bder gyur nyid/ /sdug bsngal snod can nyid du gyur/ /de nas ded dpon kyi chung ma mngag gzhug pa'i bu mo dang lhan cig tu rim pa de nyid kyis gzhan gyi khyim du gla mi'i las byed pa la zhugs pa na krugazhon nu gzugs ngan gyi bsod nams kyi dbang gis nyin re zhing gla rnyed pa 'gribs par gyur to/ /ji tsam na dus gzhan zhig gi tshe nyi ma ma nub bar du nyin mo las byed du bcug kyang ci yang rnyed par ma gyur pa khyanas/ ji srid las kyang sus kyang byed du ma (tsabacug pa dang / ji tsam na ded dpon gyi chung ma mngag gzhug ma'i bu mo de dang lhan cig kun du smra ba rtsom pa/ yang da pa)ni las kyang byed du ma bcug gis rnam pa thams cad du slong snyemo spyad par bya'o zhes bgros te/ de slong posnaphor thogs nas slong ⑩mo spyad pa la zhugs so/ /gang gi tshe gzhon nu mi sdug pa 'gro nus pa de'i tshe de la mas bu da ni khyod rang nyid slong mo spyod du song la longs spyod cig ces smras nas/ des de la slong phor byin pa dang / de slong phor de thogs nas tshong 'dus su zhugs pa dang / de yang pags pa'i mdog shin tu gnag pa/ gzugs shin tu mi sdug pa/ mtshan ma ngan pa bco brgyad dang ldan pas lus smad par 'os pa mthong ba dang / 'jig rten pa rnams shin tu 93—1311

yang rgyab kyis phyogs par gyur nas thur du lta zhing 'gro'o/ /de gang gi khyim gyi sgor song ba der de'i lus las dri shin tu mi zhim pa 'byung ba dang / mod kho na la sna khung gnyis bkag nas shing dang rdo ba dang gyo mo la sogs pas brdegs te 'di nas myur du song shig ces grong khyer gyi mi gtsang ba 'dam rdzab 'gro shes pa lta bur lta zhing sgod par byed de/ gang dang gang du song ba de dang der shing dang rdo dang gyo mo la sogs pa rnams kyis brdegs nas skyod par byed do/ /des slong rmyemo gcig kyang rnyed par ma gyur cing shing dang rdo dang gyo mo la sogs pa rnams kyis brdegs pas slong khyephor yang chag rngupar gyur nas/ smre sngags 'don bzhin du ma'i drung du phyin te/ shin tu yang zhum par gyur pas cho nges 'debs pa la zhugs so/ /de nas de mthong ba dang brang brdungs te/ smras pa/kyi hud bu khyod sdug bsngal te/ /su la'ang gnod pa ma byas par/ /snying rje spangs pa gang zhig gis/ /'di ltar brdegs pas khyod sdug bsngal/ /de nas gzhon nu mi sdug pas sgra dang bcas par rab tu ngus te smras pa/ gang dang gang gi khyem sgor ni/ /slong pyamo spyad phyir bdag 'gro ba/ /de dang der ni gyo mo rdo//shing la sogs pa bdag la rdega'u /de thos pa dang ded dpon gyi chung mas gzhon nu mi sdug pa'i mgul nas 'khyud de/ sgra dang bcas pas ngus te smras pa/nyes pa med kyang shin tu ni/ /gang dag gzhan gyis brdegs gyur pas/ /skye dub gzhan du bu khyod kyis/ /sdig pa mi bzad byas par nges/ /kyi hud khyod ni sdug bsngal lo/ /bde ba kun dang rnam bral ba/ /shin tu mi sdug gyur pa 'di//dman pa ci tsam mthong na go/ /sems ldan snying rje cis mi skyephyu/ /kyi hud bcom zhing nyams pa bdag /bu khyod kyi ni slong (shemo snod/ /bcom pas lus 93—1312

kyang bcom yin te/ /slong mo tsam gyis 'tsho ba yin/ /pha dang ma dang bral ba dang / /khyim gyi rten ni med gyur la/ /gang gis snying rje spangs nas ni/ /khyod kyi slong hūṃsdod de bcag gyur/ /rigs rgyud thams cad nyams gyur cing / /bshes dang gnyen byis rnam spangs pas/ /bla ma mdza' bo rtemagon gyur nyid/ /slong snod su yis bcag par gyur/ /kyi hud bu snyug dman pa mthong nas ni/ /khyod la su yis dpal krutshul bstan par gyur/ /kyi hud sngon gyi rang gi las kyis gyeni—/ /bu sdug khyod ni gnod pas bcom par gyur/ /kyi hud dman pa'i bu la dpa' ba ni/ /gang gi snying la brtse ba mi sems pas/ /rdo dang so phag rtsub pa lta bu yi/ /sems can gang yin de ring khyod kyis smros/ /kyi hud sgo brgyas bcom pa yi ༄snye/ /sdug bsngal gyis gdungs slong 5mo rgyu/ /ji ltar khrod la gzhan rdeg dzapar/ /'jig rten yid ni spro bar gyur/ /bkres dang skom pas yongs dub cing hūṃ/ /phun tshogs kun gyis rnam spangs pa/ /nad dang sdug bsngal rnams kyis gdungs/ /khyed la su zhig brdeg par brtson/ /nyam thag dman pa'i bzhin gyis ni/ /ngu zhing bkres pas rab gzir ba/ / sgog ma skam khyapa mthong na deng / /khyod la su yis brtse ma tshubyas/ /deng ni nad kyis zil mnan cing / /sdug bsngal ldan pa brtse spangs te/ /rigs snyems dregs pas dkrugs pa ni/ /gang gis bu khyod ji ltar rdegs11/ /kyi hud gang gis khyed bkres gzir/ /slong mos nyes 15bsags gyur pa yis/ /bza' ba chung ngu de yang deng / /khye dang wa yang spyod par byed/ /kyi hud bu sdug skal 15ngan pa/ /dwa go da ni ji ltar byed/ /sngon byas sdig pa byed pa po/ /mi sdug las kyis bcom par gyur/ /de ltar de rnam pa du mas mya ngan byed bzhin du 'chag cing 93—1313

grugs pa'i gnas kyi bum tshobu'i mdun du khrag gi rgyun gyis yan lag gos pa'i bu la 'khyud nas/ phyag dar dang / gyo mo mi gtsang zub dang/ tsher ma la sogs pas khyab pa'i sar bsnyal 1te/ dal bu lgodal bus lag pas mnye bar brtsams pa dang / ji tsam na srang bar de na tshong dpon gyi bu dang / ded dpon gye bu dang / gzhan yang mtho zhing mtho ba'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams 3ka shi ka'i ras dang / ba ku la'i ras dang / ko tam (thupa'i ras dang /dar dang mon dar dang / ras phra zhing rin che ba sna tshogs gyon pa dang /mgul gdub dang / gdu bu dang / dpung rgyan dang / rna hūṃcha dang / do shal dang / se mo do sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / dri zhim pa'i me tog gi tshogs kha bye ba rnam pa sna tshogs kyis lus la spud pa 'gro ba mthong ba dang /de bdag nyid shin tu sdug bsngal ba'i gnas skabs la bltas shing / bu mi sdug pa de yang de bzhin du bzhin rsha dman pa la bltas nas dbugs tsha ba ring po phyung ste / mchi ma dang bcas pas shin tu dman pa'i tshig gsang mthon pos smras pa/phun tshogs du ma brgyas khyab pa/ /rin chen gyes ni rgya mtsho bzhin/ /rgyas pa'i ris su gyur nas kyang / /bde ba'i mchog la rjes su spyad/ /rgud pa'i cha las byung bas na/ /phyag dar khrod kyi seb /gnas shing / /zas ma rnyed pas bkres ⑩pa dang / /shin tu nyam /7ngas 'tsho bar gyur/ /mya ngan rgya mtsho sdug bsngal chu rlabs 'jigs/ /gdung ba'i chu srin mi zad 8brgya yis khyab/ /dbul ba'i chu klung rgya mtshor zhugs gyur nas/ /kye 6hud bcom zhes sgra ni rnam par sgogasathu/ /rgud pa'i chu srin brgya yis kun du dkrugs/ /phongs kyepa'i rba rlabs 'jigs pa rab tu g.yo/ /nad ces 'jigs pa mi bzad nub pa yis/ /93—1314

dbu ba'i rang bzhin chu bor zhugs par gyur/ /sdug bsngal rdo khrod nad ni rtsub pas khyab/ /gdung ba'i seng ge'i sgra yis gang ba'i yul17/ /mya ngan bya ni brgya phrag lhags gyur pa/ /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal gnas ni thob par gyur/ /bag med 'khrul pa dag gis bsams pas sngon/ /dam pa rnams la sbyin pa ma byin pas / /da lta 'di nas skal ngan dman pa yis/ /dregs ldan gdong la rtag tu lta bar byed/ /dman dang skal ba dang bral rmongs dang ni/ /slong rngo mo la spyod slong snyemo'ang mang du ma byin pas/ /gang des gnas khang tsam yang 'byor par ma gyur pa'i/ /dman zhing phongs pa'i mi bzad dag tu zhugs par gyur/ /nges par sa byesteng kun gyis bkur ba'i bla ma dang / /yang dag phrad ldukyang brnyas shing bsnyen bkur ma byas pa/ /gang des de ltar yu bu skyebarnyas par gyur pa dang / /de ⑦ltar 'gro ba'i rmongs pa'i snod du gyur pa yin/ /gang gis rdo dang bong pa yis/ /'gro 'di bye bdag cag brdegs gyur pa/ /sngon gyi skye bar legs bsdams pa/ /mang bo nges par brdegs pa yin/ /gang gis 'jig rten pa rnams ni/ /kun nas yongs su snod gyur pa/ /sngon ni bla ma'i skye bo la/ /yongs su spyos par gyur par nges/ /gang 'dis brnyas pa'i snyug bsngal ni/ /shin tu mi bzad rjes thob pa/ /sngon chad bla ma'i skye bo la/ /yongs su brnyas par gyur par nges/ /yu bus sngon gyi skye bo la/ /glo bur lhags la gos dag ni/ /ma byen pa ni gang yin pas/ /da ltar yu bu gos med gyur/ /gang gis gnyen bshes dang bral te/ /yu bu sdug bsngal yun ring du/ /skye bo mang po ngu ba yiky-i7//nga ro 'don du bcug pa yin/ /gang gis gseg ma rdos khyab pa'i/ /sa gzhir yu bu kye nyal gyur pa/ /sna tshogs gos ni ⑫bkab pa yis⑩/ /mal stan kye93—1315

sngon ma byin pa yin/ /stan ni rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /dam pa rnams ni ma byin pas / /gang gi 1tsher ma mang po yis bye 7/ /khyab pa'i sa yi gzhi la gnas/ /gang gi — —tsher mas khyab pa yigye / /sa gzhir yu bu ‘rkyernam rgyu ba/ /sngon chad lham dang bzhon pa ni/ /bde ba skyed pa ma byin yin/ /nyi ma'i 'od tshogs rnams kyis dbus kyi cha snang thubyas/ /phyag dar phung po gang gis 'di ni yu bu gnas/ /slong ba'i 'gro la khang pa'i gnas tsam phal cher ni/ /gnas kyi ser snas nges par ma byin gyur pa yin/ /gang gis da ltar yu bu shin tu kha skams la/ /mgrin par skams shing kha dang 'gram pa yongs ⑦skams pa/ /yid la chu 'dod snyekun du bltas nas sngon chad ni/ /de la bsil gyur chu ni sbyin pa ma byin (lkuzhing / /slong 1 snadang snyug phongs pa la zas ma byin pa dang / /gnyen dang mdza' bshes la min rtsa lag tshogs la'ang min/ /legs par spyad nas thams cad las kyis longs spyod pa/ /des na 'dir ni zas bral yu bu yongs su 'khyams11/ /srid pa gzhan du rnam pa mang por nges par nyu1ni/ /gzhan gyi don sgrub mkhas pa rnams la mtshang 'dru bas/ /gang gis 'di na dzud ltar 'jig rten dman pa'i yang / /shin tu mtshang 'dru'i gnas su yu bu nye bar gyur/ /yu bus nyes pa rnam rngumang du/ /rigs kyis khengs shing dregs brten thul/ /yon tan ldan pa'ang brdegs pas na/ /gang gis da ltar mi bzad skyed/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di nyid du/ /nad rnams thams cad sel byed pa'i/ /sman ni sngon chad ma byin pas/ /gang gis nad kyis mngon gdungs yin/ /pha la khrus ma byas shing ma dang bshes la'ang min/ /bla ma tshim par ma byas 'jig rten mgon la'ang min/ /gang gis khrus dang gdung ⑫bral byas pas skyes gyur cing / /93—1316

'di ni sdug bsngal brgya yis skal bcom mgon med gyur/ /bkres dang skom pas yongs dub cing / /bza' dang bgo ba rnam bral ba/ /nad dang sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa/ /yu bu su zhig skyong bar gyur/ /'jig rten du ni rnyed dka' ba'i/ /gang gis de ni srog stor hūṃzhing / /yu bus gang gi bran dang ni/ /de ring su yi las byed bya/ /kye ma'o dbul ba sdug bsngal te/ /kye ma'o bsod nams ma byas nyid/ /'di ltar rgyas pa'i grong khyer du'ang / /mgon med yu bu ji bzhin no/ /'di dang gzhan dag yang ded dpon gyi chung ma bkres pas yongs su gdungs pa'i yid dang bdag nyid smre sngags 'don zhing 1gnas so/ /ded dpon rna can yang rgya mtsho chen por gru zhig pa dang / stes dbang gis byis pa gcig dang lhan cig spang leb la 'jus gte chu'i gnas nas rgal ④nas shin tu nyam thag pa chen pos slong 5mo rgyu zhing rgyal po'i pho brang mnyan bye ldan du phyin pa dang / de der phyi rol gyi zhing gcig tu mtshan mo gnas par gyur pa na 7/ der yang zho shas 'tsho ba'i skyes bu gzhan zhig gnas pa des de shes pa dang / de 'di snyam du sems te/ ded dpon 'di shin tu ring ba dang / bdog pa'i zurdzas thams cad nyams pa dang / khye'u gcig dang lhan cig 'ongs na de la khyim kyi lo rgyus ji ltar brjod par bya/ yang na rang nyid kyis shes par 'gyur gyi byesnyam nas des de la lag pa bkru ba'i chu byen te/ ma sha'i sgrum khur gnyis byen no/ /de nas ded dpon rna can lag pa stong pas khyim du 'jug par mi bya'o snyam nas/ ma sha'i sgrum khur gcig bzhag nas khye'u'i ⑩ lag tu gtad cing / gcig phyed phyed du bgos te bza' ba'i don du khye'u de dang lhan cig zos so/ /de nas nyi ma gnyis pa la ma sha'i snum khur de thogs ⑪ 93—1317

nas shin tu rtsub cing lus nyam chung ba dang / shin tu dri ma dang bcas pa'i ras gcig tsam zhig gyon nas rgyal po'i pho brang mnyan rmyeldan du zhugs te/rang gi khyim du chas so/ /gzhon nu mi sdug pa'am nam langs pa'i dus nyid na bkres pa dang / skom pas yongs su nyam chung ba bzhin du dang / skal ba ngan pa bdag nyid 27'di na gnas pas ci zhig bya/ srog kyang dgos pa med kyis song la bdag nyid gsod par bya'o snyam nas/ des ma la smras pa/ ma bdag ni pha'i skyed 1mos tshal du mchi zhes smras te/ skyed pyamos tshal der chas so/ /ded dpon rna can yang rang gi khyim dang nye bar phyin pa dang / ci tsam zhig nas ring po ma lon par dur khror gyi grumadog can gyi sa'i tshogs tsam lhag mar lus pa mthong nas bltas te/ 'di ci zhig yin zhes bsams nas/ gnas zhig pa'i phyed dum der phyin pa dang / gnas zhig pa'i phyed dum de na chung ma bran mo zhig dang lhan cig gnas la/ shin tu dman pas nyam chung ba'i bzhin dang / ras kyi dum bu dri ma can gyis sked 'upa'i phyogs bkab pa dri ma'i tshogs lus la gos pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang kyi hud 'di ci zhig yin zhes smras te / brgyal nas sa la 'gyel ba dang / rlung grang mos phog pas yun ring mo zhig nas dran pa rnyed de/ de chung ma'i thad du phyin pa dang 'di ci zhig yin zhes smras te/ gsang mthon pos cho nges 'debs pa la zhugs so/ /de nas chung ma las ji ltar gyur pa thos pa dang / dbugs tsha ba ring po phyung ste smras pa/ngas ni nges par sbyin pa'i zhing la bya ba ma byas pa gang gis 'di ltar rgud par gyur na/ da 'di la ji ltar bsgrub par bya/ gang la skyabs su 'gro bar bya/su'i bzhin la blta bar bya/ 'jig rten dman ⑦zhing zhan pa la thugs brtse ba 93—1318

ni su zhig yin/ su zhig 'ongs nas nga dbul ba'i rgya mtsho 'di las brgal bar bya—/ su zhig 'ongs nas rgud pa'i 'dam 'di lta bu bkru bar bya/ su zhig 'ongs nas sdug bsngal gyi chu bo 'di las brgal bar bya/ su zhig 'ongs nas dbul ba'i dgra 'di las rgyal bar bya/ su zhig 'ongs nas sbug bsngal thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i shing dbyung bar bya/ su zhig 'ongs nas sdug bsngal gyi shing 'di rtsa ba nas gdon par bya/ su zhig 'ongs nas bkres pa dang skom 3pa'i mche ba gcigs mepa'i kha nas ha ha zhes 'jigs pa'i sgra can 1gyi dbul ba'i srin po chen po med par bya/ su zhig 'ongs nas dbul ba'i gyad 'di las rgyal bar bya/su zhig 'ongs nas bkres pa dang skom pa la sogs pas rab tu 'bar ba'i me 'di gsad krupar bya/ su zhig 'ongs nas rgud pa gso ba'i glang po che 'di 5/gdul bar bya/ su zhig 'ongs nas nga'i sdug bsngal dpag tu rnged pa'i dug gi mche ba dang ldan pa'i ⑥sbrul chen 'di'i dug 'di dug med par bya/ su zhig 'ongs nas nga'i thams cad 'phrog pa'i dbul ba'i dpa' bo bzlog par bya/ su zhig 'ongs nas nga'i snyug bsngal thams cad kyis bsdams pa'i bdag nyid can gyi dbul ba'i lcags sgog 'di gcad 3par bya/ su zhig 'ongs nas nga'i dbul ba'i btson sher 'di las brgal bar bya/ su zhig 'ongs nas nga'i dbul ba'i sgo glegs 'di dbye bar bya/ su zhig 'ongs nas nga'i dbul ba'i gshin rje 'di mi snang bar bya/ su zhig 'ongs nas nga'i sred pa'i rgya mtsho 'di las brgal bar bya—/ su zhig 'ongs nas nga'i dbul ba'i 'brog dgon pa 'di las thar par bya zhes bya ba la sogs pa snying rje zhing dman pa la dmigs pa'i tshig rnam pa du ma brjod cing cho nges 'debs par gyur to/ /gnas skabs der sangs rgyas bcom 93—1319

ldan 'das rnams la ni mi mkhyen pa'am/ mi gzigs pa'am rmye/ thugs su ma 3 chud pa'am/ rnam par mi rig lkupa ci yang mi mnga' ba ni ches thu nyid yin pas/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ston ka'i nyi ma rgya 'char ka ltar 'od zer dmar ser 'gyed pa dang / nor bu rang gi yon tan gyis yongs su spras pas/ kun nas dmar ser du snang ba dang / nyi ma 'char kas phye ba'i padma'i ge sar ma lus pa'i tshogs dang / utpa la dang / margad dang / 'ja' tshon dang / dri ma med pa'i glog 'khyil pa dang / mar gyi rgyun blugs 'upa'i me'i tshogs ltar shin tu 'bar ba'i 'od kyi tshogs bkra shis pa'i 'od zer gyi tshogs kyis rab rib dpag tu med pa'i tshogs rnam par 'jig cing / rga shi srid pa'i gzeb 'dzin par mdzad pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dpag tu med pa la mnyam par gzhag ⑦pa stobs su gyur pas ku mu ta 5dang / dung dang / kunda dang / dri ma med pa'i dngul dang / mu tig dang / kha ba dang / padma'i rtsa ba dang / dri ma med pa'i glang po che'i so bcag rngupa dang / 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi phung po'i rtse na gnas pa'i mig stong ldan gyi gzhu lta bu'i 'od zer 'khyil pa'i snang ba dang / nam mkha'i 6mtha' med par zla ba brgya stong 'char ba ltar dkar zhing 'jam la/ snum zhing g.yas su 'khyil ba'i 'od 'dom gang ba dang / smin ma mdzes pa'i bar nas byung ba'i smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu /—1rnam par mdzes pa dang /padma kha bye ma thag lta bu'i zhal mnga' ba/ bskal pa nyu5grangs med pa gsum du phyag dang / zhabs dang / spyan dang / yan lag mchog dbu dang / nyid kyi sha dang / rkang dang / padma gzhon nu lta bu'i rang bzhin dang ldan pa'i sras dang btsun mo dang / glang po dang / rta dang / shing rta dang / rgyan 93—1320

dang / gos dang / stan dang / mal stan dang / nor bu dang / gser dang / dngul dang / dngos po thams cad dang / rgyal srid la sogs pa yongs su gtong bas bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi tshogs yongs su 'phel bar mdzad pa/ chags pa mi mnga' bas 7bdud kyi stobs rnams rab tu bcom par mdzad pas ston ka'i zla ba dri ma med pa ltar shin tu dkar zhing gsal ba'i grags pa'i tshogs stong gi phreng bas bskor ba ri bo la 'char ka'i zla ba'i 'od zer gyi tshogs kyi lcug ma'i ral pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od zer gyi tshogs dang / sprin gyi tshogs las byung ba'i glog 5brgya stong dang / brgya byin gyi glang po che'i mche ba mdung gis bsgyel ba dang / sa 'og 'khrugs pa dang /'o ma'i rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs gyes pa dang / dbang bo'i gzhu'i 'od kyi rtse ma dudang /nor bu mar gad bcag pa dang / zla ba rgyas pa dang / padma'i 'dab ma dang /klu'i dbang po'i gtsug gi nor bu dang / bai ḍūrya'i byerdo leb dang / tsam pa ka rgyas pa rma med pa lta bu'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis snosku la bskor bar gyur pa/nyid kyi thugs su chud pa'i ye shes kyis mes zhwanyon mongs pa'i tshang tshing sreg par mdzad pa/ lha brgya stong gis nazhabs la btud cing cod pan kyis shegatugs pas nor bu dang / gser gyi 'od zer gyis shin tu mdzes shing brgyan pa'i zhabs kyi padma dang ldan pa/ glang po che gzhon nu'i dkan dang / rgya skyegs khya/kyi khu ba dang / padma dang / ston ka'i mtshams kyi sprin gyi rmyetshogs dang / a sho ka dang / le brgan rtsi'i me tog gi ⑪chun po dang / zangs kyi mdog can gyi zhabs dang ldan pa/ sen mo srab cing zangs ltar dmar ba'i zla tshes dgod 4 pa lta bu ⑫ med pa'i zhabs kyi 6padma dang ldan pa/ sred pa'i khri nyu5shing bton pa/93—1321

gti mug gi mun pa ma lus pa rnam par bsal ba/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i gnyen du gyur pa/ dgos pa med par gzhan la mnyes gshin zhupar gyur pa/ ye shes kyi spyod yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ 'dod chags chen po'i dug rnam par bsal ba/ dga' ba brgya stong gis bsnyel byeba'i yon tan ⑪ gyi tshogs dang ldan pa / bsod nams kyi tshogs nye bar bsags shing shes rab kyis spras pas nyon mongs pa ma lus pa'i shing rtsa nas 'don par mdzad pabye/ tshangs pa dang /dbang po dang / nye dbang dang / me dang / gshin rje dang / bden bral dang / chu lha dang / rlung lha dang / lus ngan po dang / dbang ldan la sogs pas bstan pa mngon par bstod pa/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/'jig rten la phan par zhugs pa/ srung ba gcig pu ba/ nyag gcig dpa' ba / zla med pa/ gnyis su mi gsung ba/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong la gnas par mdzad pa/ 'dul ba'i bsdus pa gsum gyi ⑤ gzhi la mkhas pa/ chu bo bzhi las rgal 'ub/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i zhabs legs par gnas pa/bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la yun ring po nas goms pa/ yan lag lnga spangs pa/yan lag lnga las yang dag par 'das pa/ yan lag drug dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su sdogs pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi ⑦me tog gis byugs pa/ yan lag brgyad pa'i lam ston par mdzad pa/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i stoms par 'jug pa dgu la mkhas pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/ phyogs bcur snyan pas yang dag par rgyas pa/ brgya phrag bcur dbang sgyur 'asnab la khyad tsusnapar du 'phags pa rnams ni nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis ⑩'jig rten la rnam par gzigs nas su ni 93—1322

'phel—/ su ni 'grib/ su ni gnod par gyur/ su ni nyam nga bar 'gyurarmye/su ni sdug bsngal bar gyur/ su ni ngan song la gzhol(5/ su ni ngan song la 'bab—/ su ni sgo'akhor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las nye bar 'don ④par bya/ su ni deng ngas 'khor ba'i srin pos rnam par gtses srepa las thar bar bya/ su ni deng ngas dbul ba'i sbrul gyes bdas pa las yongs su bskyab par bya/ su ni deng ngas zhe sdang gi mes lus kun nas bsregs pa las ⑥dam pa'i chos kyi char gyis dbang bskur bar bya/ su ni deng ngas gti mug gi mun nag gi kyenang du zhugs pa la rab rib med pa'i snang ba bla na med pa'i ting nge 'dzin mchog gi rtse mo la bskyon par bya/ su ni deng ngas sbug bsngal thams cad zad par byed pa'i lam kyi mchog yan lag brgyad pa bstan par bya/ su ni deng ngas dbul ba'i sgo glegs mtha' med par gzhig par bya87/ su ni deng ngas mi shes pa'i rab rib kyis mig mdongs pa la ye shes kyi mig sman rjes su sbyin par bya/ su ni deng ngas lcags sgog chen pos bcings pa las thar par bya zhes mkhyen pa'i gzigs pa 'jug go/ /yang smras pa/ rgya mtsho chu srin rnams kyi gnas/ /dus rlabs yol bar 'gyur yang srid/ /gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las yol ba med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs/ 'jig rten ma lus pa 'di dag la gzigs par gyur pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi po ded dpon rna can dbul ba'i snyug bsngal gyi 'dam rdzab tu kyi shin tu nub cing bdag nyid shin tu mya ngan gyis ⑫smre zhing gnas par gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang thugs rje chen pos yang dag par skul rkye ba'i thugs kyis lhung bzed bsnams shing chos gos mnabs ⑫93—1323

te / mnyan dūldan gyi skyed mos tshal nas mngon par byung nas mnyan lkuldan du gshegs snyeso/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs rgyal po'i pho brang mnyan 'uldan du bsod snyoms la gshegs pa dang / de mthong nas/rgyal po dang/ blon po dang / tshong dpon dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag dang / grong khyer gyi skye snyebo rnams dang / ded dpon rnams yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs 'dir bsod snyoms la byon gyi⑥/bcom ldan 'das 'di'i bsod stoms ngas dgang bar bya'o snyam nas srog chags brgya stong dpag tu med pa 6bza' ba dang bca' ba rnams thogs te gnas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs ded dpon rna can la rjes su thugs brtse bas tshong 'dus kyi dbus na thugs rab tu zhi zhing sku la nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od pas lhag pa'i 'od kyis 'bar ba lta bu ston ka'i zla ba rgyas pa'i mtshams kyi sprin gyis bskor ky-ib lta bu dang / lha'i skyed spumos tshal gyi dpag bsam gyi shing lta bu dang / gser gyi mchod sdong bdud rtsi'i byi ru'i shing gi yal gas brgyan pa lta bu dang / gser gyi gzhong pa'i steng du til mar gyi mar me bltams mipa lta bu dang / rin po che'i ri bo rin po che ⑪phra mo sna tshogs kyis spras pa lta bu dang / ngang pa'i rgyal po gser gyi padma'i rdul gyis gos pa lta bu dang / sa srung dal gyis 'bab pa'i padma'i rdul gyis brgyan pa lta bu dang / seng ge sdong ros kyis byugs ⑪pa lta bu dang / sa thams cad kyi dpal gyi tshogs lta bu dang / sku shin tu 'bar ba lta bu dang / zhabs kyi mthil gnyis shin tu legs par byas pa'i shing rta'i 'khor lo nor bus spras pa'i 'od dang ldan pa lta bu dang / zhabs kyi mthil rab tu gsar pa'i padma'i kha rgyas 93—1324

pa ltar shin tu mnyen shing nyugazhon sha chags pa dang / zhabs kyi mthil dpal be'u dang / g.yung drung dang / dga' ba 'khyel pa dang / nya dang sdong ros kyis brgyan pa dang / zhabs gnyis la zla ba rgyas pa'i dbyibs lta bu la zangs shin tu sbyangs pa lta bu'i mdangs dang / 'od dang ldan pa'i sen mo shin tu dri ma med pa gcig tu gsal ba/ legs par khye skyes pa/ blta na sdug cing mtho ba'i sen mo dag dang zhabs kyi sen mo'i sha 7thig le'i phreng bas spras shing nyams cho pa med pa dang / legs par skyes pa dang / ring zhing zlum pa khya yangs pa'i sen mo dang / 'jam zhing shin tu mnyen la shing bal ltar reg na bde ba'i rting 'u pa gnyis dang / dpal gyis 'bar ba'i nyi ma nam mkha'i dkyil na 'dug pa lta bur phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad ma lus par kun du snang bar mdzad cing / ded dpon rna can gyi 7gnas zhig pa'i phyed dum der byon to/ /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyis/gser btso ma bzhin du sbyangs pa'i 'od 'phro ba lta bu dang / mar gye rgyun gyis dublugs pa'i me'i tshogs lta bu dang / shin tu kha rgyas pa'i king shu kyeka dang a sho skyeka dang / atpa la dmar po dang / un ran da shwe/ ka dmar po dang / ka ra bī ra dang / tsam pa ka 8dang / le brgan rtsi'i 6khu ba dang / mtshams kyi sprin dang / glang po che'i dkan dang / padma dmar po dang / glog brgya stong bas lhag pa'i 'od zer yang dag par 'gyed par mdzad cing / gang gis de'i mod kho na la gnas zhig pa'i phyed dum phyi dang nang du bcas pa gser zhun ma ltar snang bar gyur pa de ltar mdzad do/ /de mthong nas ded dpon rna can gyis 'di ci zhig yin snyam te langs 6pa dang / bcom ldan 'das yang dag par 93—1325

rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs mtshan sum bcu 1rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa / chos zhes bya ba lus dang ldan pa lta bu dang / mar gyi 37sbyin drugs blugs pa'i rjes thogs kyi me lta bu dang / gser bzhu ba'i khu ba'i mdangs dang / kar ni bye 7ka ra dang / gur gum dang / le brgan rtsi krudang / ldong tre7ros dang / ba bla dang / atpa la dmar po dang / ston gyi mtshams kyi sprin dang /rma bya'i sgog (spema'i mdangs dang / gser dang / mthing shing ⑦dang /mtshal dang / a ti mug ta snyedang / ku ran da ka lta bu'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis sku la bskor ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang ded dpon rna can de 'u/shin tu dad pa chen po skyes nas ngas bcom ldan 'das la ci zhig dbul bar bya snyam du sems te/ bdag nyid kyi 'byor pa la bltas lho 7pa dang / ma sha'i ⑪ snum khyar gcig po yod par mthong nas des de blangs te chung ma la smras pa/bzang mos shā5ngas ni lag pa stong pas nga'i khyim du 'jug par mi bya'o snyam nas/ma sha'i snum khur cig /8khyer te 'ongs te/ bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs 'di yang yon gnas kyi dam pa/dman pa dang zhan pa rnams la rjes su thugs brtse ba yin la/ 'di la sbyin pa'i sa bon nyung zad tsam zhig btab pas kyang dbul ba'i sdug bsngal rtsa nas 'byen par mdzad pa yin na/ bcom ldan 'das de la ngas ma sha'i snum khur 'di dbul bar bya'am/ des smras pa/ rje'i rngusras legs kyis de ltar mdzod cig/'di tsam gyi dge ba'i rtsa bas kyang 'khor ba na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / ded dpon gyis bsams pa/ ma sha'i snum khur 'di ni shin tu zhan pa yin la/ da ni grong khyer 'di nyid du de lta bu zhig tu gyur nas 93—1326

nga 'di lta bu'i ngan pa rgyal po dang / blon po dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag dang / grong khyer kyi skye bo dang / ded dpon rnams kyis mi mthong ba ji ltar ni rmyebacom ldan 'das la dbul bar bya/ gzhan du na lo mas dkris la dbul bar bya ste/ de ltar ma byas na ni 'di rnams kyis 27shes par 'gyur ro snyam nas/ rang gi gnas zhig pa'i phyed kyi nang du zhugs te/ lo ma btsal bar sems pa dang ci 1yang ma rnyed par gyur to/ /de nas ded dpon de shin tu yang yi mug par gyur te/ kyi hud 'di lta bu'i skal ba zhan pa ni sdug bsngal lo zhes dbugs tsha ba ring po phyung nas/ de'i mod la gnas zhig pa'i phyed 4snadum de nas byung ste/ dad pa chen po'i shugs kyis ma sha'i snum khur de yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi lhung bzed du phul lo/ /phul nas kyang zhabs gnyis la phyag byas te/ smon lam byed par brtsams pa/bcom ldan 'das sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis skye ba 'di nyid nas gzung ⑤ste/ nyin zhag gcig tsam yang dbul por nam yang ma gyur cing / shin tu phyug pa dang / nor dang longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das yang dag par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi zhabs la/ ded dbon rna can gyes 'ubatud pa tsam de nyid kyi rjes thogs kho na la shin tu zhan cing rid pa de mi snang bar gyur nas/ sngon kyi mdog mdangs lta bu dang ldan par gyur to/ /de nas ded dpon rna can gyis smon lam btab nas langs pa dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs slar bzhud de/ mnyan gyeldan gyi skyed mos tshal du gshegs so/ /de nas ded dpon rna can mnyan 8ldan gyi tshong dpon 93—1327

dang / ded dpon rnams kyis lkungo shes par gyur to/ /de nas ded dpon zhig gis grong khyer pa de rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /nga dang khyed rnams kyi ded dpon rna can rgud par gyur pa la/ btang snyoms su 'jog pa ni rigs pa ma yin no/ /de nas ras gcig bting snyeste yang smras pa/ grogs po dag mang pos ni gcig legs par gdon nus kyi/ gcig gis ni mang po ma yin pas / de la gang gis 'dir yongs su btang ba de ras 'di'i steng du zhog shig ces smras pa dang / du ma zhig gis mgul gdub dang / gdu bu dang /dpung rgyan dang / do shal dang / se mo do dang / lag gdub la sogs pa rgyan thubargya stong dpag tu med pa zhig byin pa dang / ka shi'i ras dang / du ku la'i ras dang / ko tam pa'i ras dang / dar dang mon dar la sogs pa shin tu phra zhing rin che ba sna tshogs pa'i gos zung brgya stong dpag tu med pa byin te / de la skad cig ma de nyid du gos dang rgyan gyi phung po zhig tu gyur to/ /de nas ded dpon rna can gyis bye'abyor pa de la bltas nas chung ma la smras pa/bzang mo zhing gshin 'upa la sbyin pa'i sa bon btab pa'i myu gu 'thon pa la ltos/de yang dga' ba dang mgu ba skyes te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs de la phyag byas nas rgyan dang gos de rnams gnas zhig pa'i phyed dum der gzhug par brtsams so/ /khye'u mi sdug pa de ⑦yang pha'i skyed mos tshal der zhugs nas bkres pas gdungs pa'i yid dang / rang nyid mchog tu gzugs ngan pas 'di ltar yang dang yang du mya ngan byed cing bsams pa/shin tu sdeg pa'i las byed pa/ mchog tu sdug bsngal ba'i skal ba can shin tu gzugs ngan pa/ mthong na bkra mi shis pa nga gson pas kyang dgos pa lduci 93—1328

zhig yod de/ bdag nyid kyi srog dang 'bral bar bya'o snyam nas sgyid lug pa'i yid kyis mod kho na la pa la'i sti shing gi yal ga'i rtser ༄ 27mor 'dzegs pa dang /shing gi yal ga chag nas/ shing gi yal ga dang lhan cig tu lhung ste/ tshor ba nyams shing 'dug go/ /bar skabs der sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la ni mi mkhyen pa'am/ mi gzigs pa'am/ thugs su mi chud pa'am/ rnam par mi rig kyepa ci yang mi mnga' —bas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyis yesangs rgyas kyi lha'i spyan rnam par dag pa/ mi'i las 'das pas khye'u mi sdug pa de ltar sdug bsngal ba gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang thugs rje chen pos yang dag par bskul 6te/ skyed mos tshal der rdzu 'phrul gyis gshegs nas nyid kyi sku las 'od zer 'gyed par dzwamadzad de/ bkres pa dang skom pa'i sdug bsngal de yang rgyun chad par gyur nas de'i mod la langs pa dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs bskal pa bye ba brgya stong dpag tu med pa mthong ba shin tu rnyed par dka' ba dang / mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi snang bas 'bar bar byas pa'i sgu dang ldan pa mthong ngo / /de mthong ba'i mod la bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs la dad pa chen po skyes te/ des kyang yung bas btsos pa'i gos kyi dum bu khru gang gyon te 'dug pa las/ des dad pa'i shugs kyis lus las phud de/de dang kar ni ka'i me tog cig tsadad pa'i shugs chen pos 'phral du bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs kyi sgu la gsol lo/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis zhuji ltar gos kyi dum bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgu tshad dang ldan pa tsam du gyur nas 93—1329

sku la gsol pa dang / me tog kar ni ka yang ①dbu'i steng du shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam du gyur nas gdugs ltar gnas pa de ltar byin gyis brlabs so/ /de mthong ba dang khye'u mi sdug pa shin tu yang dad pa chen po skyes nas/ de dad pa chen po'i shugs kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi zhabs gnyis la phyag byas te/ sgra gsang chen pos smon lam byed par brtsams pa/rkang gnyis mchog gyur sbyin pa 'di/ /'di yis 'di nas gzugs byengan nyid/ /de 1las brtsams te legs spangs nas/ /bdag nyid ce gzugs bzang nyid thob shog /gser gye gdong byecan gos rnams ni/ /gser sbyangs lta bu gyon pa dang / /bdag gis (khyelus dang kha nas kyang / /tsan dan utpal dri ltar shog/gser gyi mdog ltar snang gyur cing / /'jig rten kun gye yid du 'ong / /nad kun las ni rnam thar cing / /bstan bcos kun du pha rol phyin/ /kun du'ang nor dang yang dag ldan/ /sdug bsngal thams cad rnam spangs ⑦pa/ /kun mchog kun gyis lta bar 'os/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam brgyan (sheshog /rdzogs sangs rgyas don kun grub cing / /sems can rnams la mnyes gshin ⑨shog /dri med yon tan dpal ldan lha/ /bde zhing rdzas kun ldan par shog /des smon lam 'di byas pa dang dus mnyam pa nyid la khye'u mi sdug pa 'phral ⑩du mi snang bar gyur cing / mdzes pa lta na sdug pa/ lus kyi pags pa'i mdog gser gyi mdog can gyi gzugs bzang bar gyur to/ /'phral du de la nam mkha' las gser gyi mdog can gye nyu1gos byung bas lus la bkab cing rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang / rna cha la sogs pa'i rgyan kyi khyad par rnams byung bas brgyan to/ /lha rnams kyis kyang me tog kar ni ka dang / utpa la dang /93—1330

tsam pa ka dang / padma dang / ku mu ta rmyedang / man dā 3snar ba la sogs pa me tog gi char chen po phab pa dang / lha'i tsan dan dang / a ka ru dang /gur gum dang / ta ma la'i lo ma'i phye ma'i char phab cing 'di skad ces kyang smras so/ /e ma'o de bzhin gshegs pa la bskrun /1pa'i sbyin pa'i sa bon khyad par can gyi myu gu yang dag par zhi'abyung ba yin no/ /lha'i me tog dang / phye ma'i char yang pus mo nub pa tsam du skyed mos tshal de thams cad du bab nas gnas so/ /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs skyed mos tshal de nas mngon par phyung ste mnyan thuldan gyi skyed mos tshal du gshegs so/ /ded dpon rna can gyis kyechung ma la smras pa/ bzang mo gang zhig skyes nas de las 'di lta bu'i kyergud pa byung bar gyur pa'i bu de gar song /des smras pa/ des kyeskyed mos tshal du 'gro'o zhes zer ro/ /des smras pa/des lku de nyid du yi mug pas bdag nyid gsod par 'gyur gye 11de myur du bzhud cig /ded dpon rna can gyes smras pa/ yu bu'i bu'i ming ni ci/ /gzugs ni ci lta bu zhig yod/ /des smras pa/ rje'i sras shin tu blta na skyemi sdug pas mi sdug pa zhes bgyi'o/ /de nas ded dpon rna can nyu de shin tu myur ba'i gom stabs kyis skyed mos tshal der song ba dang / gzhon nu mi sdug pa lus gser gyi mdog can rin po che'i gos ser bo phra ba lus la gyon pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mthong na yid 'phrog pa/ lha'i bu gzhon nu bzhin du dpal gyi mchog tu 'bar ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang e ma'o gang la 'di lta bu'i bu yod pa de ni skyes bu skal ba dang ldan pa'o zhes zer zhing gzhon nu la smras pa/khye'u khyod su'i bu yin/ des smras pa/ rna can zhes bya ba'i rnguded dpon zhig 93—1331

yod de/ nga ni de'i bu yin no/ /ded dpon rna can gyis bsams pa lakhye/gzhon nu 'dis ni nga la bstengs so snyam du sems shing / shin tu ltad mo skyes te/mig mi 'dzums pya par lta zhing gzhon nu de la yang smras pa/ kye gzhon nu ①su'i bu yin pa bden par sgos shig /mi sdug pas smras pa/ 'dir ci zhig brtag par bya ste/ nga ni bden pa nyid du ded dpon rna can gyi bu yin no/ /des smras pa/ e ma'o gzhon nu 'dis ni nga la shin tu yang bstengs so snyam nas smras pa / gzhon nu ngas ni shin tu mi sdug go zhes thos na/ khyed ni gzugs bzang na/ de thabs gang gis gzugs bzang bar gyur/ gzhon nu mi sdug pas dga' bas mig gdangs te sgra gsang chen pos smras pa/ deng ni dbul ba'i sdug bsngal mes/ /sems ni yongs su gdungs pas na/ /shing gi yal ga'i rtser 'dzegs te/ /bdag gis rang nyid ltung bar byas/ /lhung bas yan lag cesnad pas gzir/ /bdag ni brgyal sheb nyid du gyur/ /sems ni dbugs med ma thon par/ /skad cig tsam zhig 'urnam par gnas/ /de nas rnam gzigs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse ba/ /mgon po bdag la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /skyed mos tshal ni 'dir byon to/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang zhing / /pags ⑦pa gser ni sbyangs pa 'dra/ /btso ma'i gser 'dra'i 'od rnams kyis/ /phyogs bcu dag ni 'gengs par mdzad / /de sku'i 'od zer rab bsel bas/ /bdag la reg pa tsam gyis na//mnyam med bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis ni/ /'di dag thams cad tshim par mdzad/ /bkres skom ltung ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /ma lus bdag gi 3bkra mi shis/ /de yi mod la zhi gyur cing / /bdag ni sems can ⑨ rnyed par gyur/ /'di 93—1332

ci yin zhes spro bcas par/ /bdag langs de tshe thub pa yi she/ /shin tu mdangs bzangs 'gro ba yi/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas gyur mthong / /bdag ⑤gis blta bya'i rin chen de/ /mgon po dpal gyi mchog gis ni/ /phyogs rnams rgyas par gsal mdzad pa/ /mthong nas bdag sngar dad par gyur//de nas rab dga'i sems kyis su/ /bdag gis 1gos kyi dum bu ni/ / yung bas ④ btsos pa de nyid la/ /mchog tu dga' bas phul bar gyur/ /kar ni ka yi me tog gcig /bdag gis brtul zhugs bzang de la/ /gtor ba de yang thub pa yi⑤ / /steng du gdugs bzhin gnas par gyur/ /des na dga' zhing mgu ba yis/ /zhabs gnyis la ni rab btud de/ /shin tu dang ba bskyed pa yis⑥/ /bdag gis ⑦smon lam 'di byas so/ /mgon po sbyin pa 'di yis ni/ /de nyid bdag ni gzugs ngan pa/ /yongs su spangs shing gzugs bzang ba'ang / /srid pa'i rgya mtsho thob par shog /gser gyi mdog can gos rnams kyang / /gser sbyangs lta bu gyon pa dang / /bdag gi ldulus dang kha dog kyang / /tsan dan utpal dri ldan shog /bdag gi smon lam de dag ni/ /'dis ni byas par gyur pa na/ /gzugs dang kha dog 'di 'dra ba/ /yid du 'ong ba byung bar gyur/ /gos ni rin thang cher gyur pa/ /ser zhing shin tu 'jam pa dang / /bdag gi lus la 'phral du ni/ /skad cig de nyid dag las byung / /nam mkha'i ⑨ ngos nas lha rnams kyis/ /me tog dang ni tsan dan dang / /a ga ru dang ta ma la/ /a ga ru sogs char 'di phab⑩ / /ca co rnam pa chen bo dang / /yid 'phrog pa yi rnga brdung zhing / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan phyag 'tshal zhes/ /bya ba'i sgra ni smra bar gyur/ /deng ni dge ba 93—1333

'di byas pas/ /bdag gi gzugs ni 'di dag dang / /gser 'dra'i mdog ni yid 'ong ba/ /'di ni byung lku/bar gyur pa yin/ /de nas ded dpon rna can gyis de skad thos pa dang / 'phral du dad pa'i shugs kyis ba spu'i bu ga thams cad ldang bar gyur cing de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs la yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal zhing mchog tu yid dga' ba skyes pa dang / bu gzugs bzang ba la mig mi 'dzums 5pas bltas te smras pa/ bu tshur shog yu bu 'dengasakyi / de nas gzhon nu gzugs bzang kyis bdag ni pha 'di las skyes pa yin no snyam nas shin tu gus pa dang bcas pas pha'i rkang pa la phyag byas nas yab legs par byon tam zhes smras te/ pha dang lhan cig khyim du chas so/ /de'i tshe lha'i dbang po brgya byin lha'i shes pas 'og tu 'jug par 'gyur ba yin pas de 'di snyam du sems te/ ded dpon rna can 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la lhag par bya ba pyabyas pa yin no/ /de rtswa 5khyem na gnas pa ni rigs pa ma yin no snyam nas lha'i bu las sna tshogs pa la smras pa/ las sna tshogs pa song la ded dpon rna can gye khang pa rin po che sna bzhi las gru bzhi pa'i rnam pa gyis shig /de nas las rnam pa sna tshogs pas brgya byin gyi ⑥tshig smras te/skad cig de nyid la rgyal po'i pho brang mnyan ④ldan du 'ongs nas rin po che sna bzhi'i pha gu las brtsigs shing ka bas bteg pa/ khyams mtho zhing mdzes pa dang / skar khung dang / sgo khang dang / ngos na lcog ④gis legs par bkod pa'i yan lag can dang / gdung phran la spang leb legs par bkod pa/shin tu mtho ba'i khang pa zur bzhi pa/ shin tu yid du 'ong ba'i rta babs kyis sgo nye bar mdzes pa dang / ston ka'i sprin mdzes pa dang / gangs kyi phung po 93—1334

dang / zla ba'i 'od zer dang / padma'i rtsa ba ltar dkar ba/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng ba dang / mu tig gi chun 'phyang dang gos kyi chun 'phyang gi tshogs btags pa/ grong khyer gyi mchog ma lus pa nye bar mdzes par byed pa'i gnas su gyur pa/ shin tu 'bar ba'i gser gyi rang bzhin can gsar ① du mngon par 'byung ba'i a nu'i rgyan byas shing yan lag brgyad pa'i chus yongs su gang ba'i bum pa brgyad kyis khusgo nye bar gnas par byas pa/ dpag tu med pa'i dngul dang / bee ḍūrya dang / shel dang /spug dang / mthon ka dang / mthon ka chen po la sogs pa'i rin po che rnams kyis yongs su skor ba/ gter du mas yongs su khengs pa/ rin po che'i rdzing dang / yo byad kyis yongs su gang ba'i khang pa'i mchog cig byas so/ /de nas ded dpon rna can gyis chakhyem du 'ongs pa dang / de'i chung ma dga' zhing mgu la rangs pas/ gser gyi ril ba las chu byin te smras pa/ rje'i sras khyed kyi bsod nams kyi mthus 'ga' zhig gis 'di lta bu'i khang pa'i mchog byas so—/ /de nas ded dpon rna can gzhal yas khang de la mngon par lta zhing /mchog tu dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas/snye/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la shin tu yang dad pa skyes te/ ba spu ldang ba dang thal mo spyi bor sbyar te/ de bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsam kyis mi khyab pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che bsod nams kyi khyezhing bla na med pa la phyag 'tshal lo zhes smras te phyag byas nas rab tu dga' bas rgyas pa'i bzhin dang bas smras pa/ e ma'o yon tan rang bzhin zhi/ /nyes pa thams cad rab spangs pasakhye/ /gang du bdag gis ⑦sa bon btab/ /93—1335

'bras bu de nyid sprul bar mdzad/ /sbyin pa ngan ngon de tsam ni/ /legs ①par sbyar ba kun bral gang / /nyams dga' mthong ba'i gser dang ni/ /rin chen rang bzhin khyem 'di gang / /rtsig pa'i lhag ma lus pa tsam/ /bdag khyem mya ngan 'phel byed pa'i/ /sprin dang nges par bral ba yi/ /zla ba'i 'od ltar dkar 'di gang / /bye ba 'bus rtol bu ga yi/ /skar khung ldan pa'i khyem yang gang / /rin chen rab mchog du ma yi/ /skar khung ldan pa'i khyim 'di gang / /khros pa'i khyim khyab tsher ma dang / /mi gtsang tshogs kyis gzings de gang / /khyim 'di sngon chad de 'dra las/ /rin chen bsags 'di gang yin mtsharazu / /sbrul gyis zubor ba'i lpags rnying 'di/ /'phyang ba'i gos kyis khyab de gang / /phra ba'i gos ni phun tshogs bkra/ /rnga yab 'phyang ba 'di ni gang / /khyi rmyemos bsdus pa'i rus gong ni⑤/ /dkar pos gcal bkram khyim de gang / dri zhim me tog bzang po 'di/ /sel mas nye bar mdzes 'di gang //mya ngan 'chi ma'i rgyun gyis ni/ /rtag tu brlan pa'i khyim de gang / /dri zhim gla bu rtsi tsan dan gyi/ / chu yis chag ⑦chag btab 'di gang / /me lces dutshig cing khā rnams kyis/ /mi rnams ⑨rta babs can de gang / /gser dang rin chen mu tig mchog /phreng bas nye bar mdzes 'di gang / /spang leb chag pa'i sgo yis ni/ /bsgribs kyepa yi ni khyem 'di gang / /shel las bsgrubs ⑫pa'i sgo glegs ni/ /sgo 'phar ldan pa 'di ni gang / /nga ni yun ring ⑫nyams pa yi/ /'jig dum phyed pa'i khyim 'di ⑫gang / /nor bu'i rang bzhin ka ba dang / /sgo gang gis ni brgyan 'di gang / /smre sngags sgra yis kun du ni/ /khyab pa'i bzhi mdo de ni gang / /rol mo'i sgra dang gling bu yi/ /skad dang yang dag ldan ni 93—1336

gang / /sngon ni thod pa'i tshogs dang ni/ /phyag dar phung pos khems gyo te gang / /rin chen phung pos mdzes pa gang / /gang du bsags pa 'di ni gang / /lhog ④dang gdung phran bkod pa rnams/ /ma lus lhag kyepar gyur te rngogang / /nang na mthon ka ⑤chen po dang / /shel ni chen po bzhag 'di gang / /stan dang bral ba'i so phag ni/ /gcig la brten par gyur de gang / /sna tshogs gos g.yogs nang tshangs can/ /brgya phrag dang ni ldan de gang / /sngon ni gsegs mas du khyab gyur pa'i/ /sa yi cha yi mal de gang / /rgya chen dang ldan dpal gyi khri/ /nyams su dga' ba 'di ni gang / /rtswas g.yogs pa yi mal stan ni/ /bdag la rab tu rtsub ste ⑦gang / /shing bal yang zhing 'jam pa'i stan//deng rab yid du 'ong ba gang / /khyem nas rkyekhyi yis rmyegang gyur pas/ /shin tu dri mi zhim de gang / /gzhal yas khang na yid 'ong bkye/ /dri zhim dam pas bsgos ⑪'di gang / /sngon chad khang pa'i phyi nang na/ /gos dengs snal ⑪mas khyab de gang / /sna tshogs rin chen mchog gyur pas/ /rnam spras nyams dga' 'di ni gang / /khra yis mi gtsang ri mo yisakye/ /dkar po brgya rab 'chang de gang / /rgyan rnams sna tshogs mu tig gis/ /dra bas nye bar mdzes 'di gang //sdug bsngal tshig smre lag pa dag /bsgreng rnguba'i khang pa de ni gang / /dri med gdugs dang ba dan dag /bsgrengs pas brgyan par gyur 'di gang / /skyob pa bsod nams zhing gyur pa/ /gang zhig byon pas bdag deng ⑫ nyid/ /dbul ba'i rgya mtsho las sgol ba/ /mgon po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig byon ⑩pas bdag de nyid/ /phun tshogs 'di 'dra thob 'gyur ba⑩/ /thams cad mkhyen pa rnam par gzigs/ /'jig rten mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /93—1337

rnam par rgyal bzhin bsam yas pa'i/ /yon tan dpag med rnams kyis brgyan//yang dag byon nas de lhabadag ni/ /gzhal yas khang mchog thob par mdzad/ /ston pa de ni legs rnyed pas/ /nyi se'i rtse mo bsgrengs pa lta'i/ /ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba'i/ /gzhal yas khang mtho thob par gyur/ /de nyid grong khyer 'di mgon med/ /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal can gyur nas/ /de nyid kun rmi mchog gyur cing / /nor che ba dang ldan par gyur/ /sa bon de nyid btab tsam gyis/ /'bras bu 'phral du stsol ba po/ /'jig rten mchog gyur khyab bdag de/ /su zhig gis ni mchog 'os min/ /de nas ded dpon rna can dad pa'i shugs drag pos sems kyi rgyud brlan pa dang bsams ②pa bcom ldan 'das byon nas/ nga la 'byor pa 'di lta bu thob par mdzad pa yin pas/da yang ngas dang po nyid du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs khang pa 'dir spyan drangs la/ nyan thos kyi tshogs dang bcas pa la bshos gtsang dbul bar bya'o snyam nas/ gus pa chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ khang pa'i nang du spyan drangs te/ zhal zas ro brgya pa nyin zhag bdun gyi bar byedrangs nas zhabs gnyis la phyag byas te/ ji srid 'tsho'i thubar du yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byas par gyur to/ /de nas nyi ma gzhan zhig la zhing bsrung ba'i skyes bu zho shas 'tsho ༄srib zhig la/ rje bos 'bras chan spyogye thum bu zhig byin pa dang / de thogs te zhing las la chas ⑦pa dang / lam gyi bar zhig tu zho shas 'tsho khyaba'i skyes bu des dge bsnyen gzhan zhig la/ ded dpon rna can gyis ma sha'i snum khur gcig sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la phul bas/ 'byor pa 'di 93—1338

lta bu thob ces thos so/ /thos nas kyang / skyes bu des dge bsnyen de la smras pa—/ kye bzhin bzangs bcom ldan 'das de che ba'i yon tan de ji lta bu zhig yod—/ des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs bcom ldan 'das de'i yon tan de'i khyad par smra bar ga la nus/ 'on kyang mdor bsdus pa'i don 'di nyon cig/bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de ni skyes bu/ rab mchog mtshan gyis brgyan pas/ gser gye ri ltar snang bas/ nyi ma dang zla ba bas lhag pa'i 'od gcig pu la/ dul ba/ brtul zhugs bzang ba/ thugs dul ba/ gsung snyan pa/ cha lugs bzang ba/ sku mdzes pa/ zhal mdzes pa—/ spyan mdzes pa/ phrin stilas bzang ba/ chos bzang ba/ bzod pa dang ldan pa/ spobs pa dang ldan pa/ des pa shin tu 'dren pa dul ba mkhyen paske/ zhi ba mkhyen pa/ spyan yangs pa/ byas pa mkhyen pa/ dbang po rab tu zhi ba/ dbang po'i rta shin tu dul ba/ dbang po shin tu zhi ba/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po/ sems can gyi snying po chen po/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po chen po—/ ye shes kyi ①tog chen po/ smra ba'i dpa' bo chen po/ bsod nams kyi mdzod chen po/ chos kyi gru chen po/ ded dpon chen po/ sbyin gnas chen poske/ gru ba chen po chos kyi sbyin bdag chen po/ sred pa rnams gcod par mdzad pa/ rmongs pa nges par 'jig par mdzad pa/1 khro ba zhi bar mdzad pa—/ thar pa buston par mdzad pa/ chos yang dag par mdzad pa/ ⑤ngan pa las 'pho bar mdzad pa/ lam bzang po ston par mdzad pa/ the tshom gcod par mdzad pa/ bden pa yang dag par ston par mdzad pa/ bron mongs pa zhi bar mdzad pa/ bdud 'joms par mdzad pa/ 'jig rten 93—1339

rnams sgrol bar mdzad pa/ tshangs pas mchod 17pa/ brgya byin gyis yang dag par bkur ba/ 'jig rten thams cad pas lhag pa/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi 3 mdzes pa/ sems can thams cad kyi mchog /sdug bsngal thams cad gcod par mdzad pa/ thams cad rig pa/ tshul dang dul ba la mkhas pa/ zag pa thams cad las 'das pa/ smra ba'i gtso bo zil kyis ma mnan pa/ nyes pa thams cad zil gyis ma g.yengs pa/ don thams cad la mngon par brtson pa/gzugs dang ldan pa/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ bsam gtan dang ldan pa/brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/ ye shes dang ldan pa/ re ba mi mnga' ba/ sgyu snyemi mnga' ba/ nan mi mnga' ba/ spros pa mi mnga' ba/ skyon med par zhugs pa/ 'jug pa dang zad pa'i stobs nye bar ston par mdzad pa/sems can thams cad la byams pa'i dgongs pa can/ sdig pa rnams las grol ba/ lhag par mos pa dang ldan pa/ bla na med pa/ gtso bo/ ston pa po / nyon mongs pa'i nad kyis 4gdungs pa rnams kyi sman pa chen po/ rang byung 5khyab bdag yang dag par sdom pa'i bdag nyid can/ mthu tshad med pa / mdzad pa nyung ba/ cho ga mkhyen pa dang ldan pa/ dus dang ldan pa/ye shes dang ldan pa/ nyon mongs pa'i dgra las nges par rgyal ba/ me rab tu zhi ba/ mi bskyod pa'i chos dang ldan pa/ mchog tu sdug bsngal ba'i 'jig rten ma rig pa'i 'dam la nub pa la gzigs shing de la nyid kyis yang dag par 'don par spyod la3/ nyid kyi mthu'i bdag nyid sems can thams cad la mtshungs par yod par bzhed pa'i thugs rje chen pos don mdzad pa'i blo gros kyi tsumachog gis 'di las 'gro ba 'don par mdzad pa/ ji ltar sdug bsngal rnams 93—1340

gnon par bya/ ji ltar skrag pa rnams dbugs dbyung bar bya/ ji ltar na 'khor bar nub pa rnams gdon shesna par bya/ ji ltar na bkres 2pa rnams tshim par bya zhes de lta bu'i brtan po yang dag par bskyed de/ brtson 'grus mchog rtsom par mdzad cing / sku tshe bye ba brgya stong du snga ma bzhin du zas dang /skom dang gnas dang / lham dang / bza' ba dang / gdugs dang /bzhon pa dang / stan la sogs pa yid du 'ong ba dang / glang bo che dang /rta dang chung ma dang bu dang / bran pho dang / bran mo dang / mgo dang /mig dang / bdag gi sha dron po —bcad nas brgya byin khra'i 4gzugs can la sogs pa dang / sems can thams cad la thabs thams cad kyis phan par dgongs pa/ dus thams cad du yang rgas pa dang / na ba dang / phongs pa dang / kun du rmongs pa dang / kun du 'khrul pa dang / 'khrugs pa dang /mi bde bar gnas pa rnams la gzigs nas thams cad 5dbugs phyung ste/yod dam med pa la yang spyod pa ji lta bas brtan par mdzad pa/ sbyin pa dang /tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab la sogs pa'i yon tan sku tshe brgya stong du mar bsags pas zhi ba'i byang chub kyi mchog bla na med pa brnyes pa'o/ /gzhan yang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags pas khyab pa/ dbugs 'byin pa'i chos thugs rje ston par mdzad pa ye shes yongs su rdzogs pa/ brtson 'grus che ba/ dam bcas pa thams cad mthar phyin par mdzad pa'o/ /nyes pa thams cad las nye bar grol ba rmongs pa rnams nye bar bsal ba/ dul ba dang / zhi ba dang /dbang po'i yul thams cad la ma chags pa/ thams cad kyi dbang phyug /93—1341

lus kyi tha ma brnyes pa/ tshad med pa'i mthu'i 'od kyis brgyan pa'i ye shes kyi mdzod / zla ba rgyas pa bas lhag pa'i 'od dang ldan pa'i zhal mnga' ba/lha'i dbang po dang / lha ma yin kyi ①dbang po dang / klu'i dbang po rnams kyis mos pas rab tu dang ba dang / rtag tu phyag byas pa/ gzi brjid rab tu 'bar ba/ bsod nams dang grags pa dang ldan pa/ drang srong chen po byung ba/ gser shin tu sbyangs pa/ chos kyi dbang phyug mchog gi chos kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ sems can gyi mchog /cang shes pa grol ba/ dpa' ba/lha'i yang lha/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ de'i yon tan ma lus par ston pa su zhig gis nus/ gzhan yang / gzugs dang mdangs bzang du thams cad kyi/ /phun sum tshogs pas legs brgyan pa/ /sgur ldan ①sangs rgyas ma gtogs pa④/ /'di 'dra'i mchog gzhan yod ma yin/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i blo bzang med/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i rtogs pa med/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i thub pa med/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i snod med de/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i bde ldan med/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i dul ba med/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i gtso bo med/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i smra ba med/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i pha med de/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i gnyen 'dun med/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i bshes med do/ /bdag gi med cing dregs pa med/ /'jigs pa med cing nyes pa med/ /srid pa'i dgon pa nges rgal kruzhing / /'gran zla med cing skyon mi mnga'/ /mdzes dul zhi zhing gtsang ba dang / /dran ldan stobs ldan dbang dang ldan/ /sems can kun la phan mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba gzhan med do/ /mdor na yon tan 93—1342

dam pa ni/ /khyad par sna tshogs ldan pas na/ /khams gsum na ni sangs rgyas dang / /mnyam pa med par gzung bar gyis/ /de thos pa dang zho shas 'tsho ba'i skyes bu de dad pas ba spu ldang zhing shin tu rnyed par dka' ba'i spobs pa 'phral du skyes te/ des smras pa/ ded dpon rna can gyi sred pas de lta bu'i sbyin gnas dam pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs la ma sha'i snum khur cig ①phul nas/ skad byug de nyid la ded dpon de dbul ba med par gyur cig ces de ltar sems kyi nor bu rin po cher gyur pa de bzhin gshegs pa las rnyed de/ shin tu zhan pa la longs spyod kyi rgyur gyur pa'i smon lam btab pa yin la/ nga yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bskal pa bye ba brgya stong dpag tu med par yang mi mthong ba/ shin tu blta zhubar 'os pa/ bla na med pa bskal pa brgya stong dpag tu med par sems can thams cad kyi don la zhugs par bsags pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs mnga' ba kyethugs rje chen po las mi ldog pa/'khor ba du ma'i nyon mongs pa'i dug can gyi sbrul chen pos zin pa'i dman pa rnams la rjes su thugs brtse ba/ rnam par ltung ba'i 'gro ba rnams la khyad par du mnyen gshin pa rjes su mi spong ba'i nye du yin la/ ngas ni dus dpag tu med par longs spyod ma bsgrubs ④pa yin ⑤te/ ngas zhing las kyis bsgrubs pa'i 'bras chan ⑥gyi slong mo shin tu zhan pa rnyed pa 'di yul la mnyes par bya ste/de'i tshe gang gis sems can thams cad kyi mchog tu 'gyur ba de lta bu'i smon lam gdab par bya'o snyam pa'i yid la brjod pa'i rjes ⑦/thogs nyid la bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyis sems dang 93—1343

sems kyi rtogs 1pa mkhyen nas rdzu 'phrul gyis zhugashegs te de'i mdun du bzhugs so/ /las byed pa'i skyes bu des de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs sku blta bas chog mi shes pa/ gser shin tu sbyangs pa ltar mngon par mdzes pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa'i lha'i ri'i rtse mo la nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od zer rnam par 'byung bas mtshams kyesnang bar byas pas shin tu gsal bar byas pa lta bu'i sku la 'od dang ldan pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang mchog tu dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas dad pa'i shugs chen pos 'bras chan byathum bu blangs te/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi lhung bzed du phul te/ dad pa'i shugs chen bos zhabs gnyis la phyag byas te smon lam byed par brtsams pa/ mgon po'i bsod nams 'di yis ni/ /skye ba 'di nas bzung nas su/ /sems can kun la phan sems shing / /snying rje'i bdag nyid can gyur cig /ji ltar khyod ni mtshan ldan zhing / /bla med byang chub brnyes gyur pa/ /de bzhin bdag kyang rdzogs byang chub/ /dri med yang dag thob gyur cig /ji ltar khyed ni kun mkhyen zhing musna/ /chos rnams ji ltar ston mdzad pa/ /brnyes pa de bzhin bdag kyang ni/ /kun mkhyen nyid ni thob par shog /ji ltar khyed bdud las rgyal zhing / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad pa/ /de bzhin bdag kyang nges rgyal nas/ /chos kyis ⑪'khor lo bskor gyur cig /ji ltar mgon pos 'khor ba yi/ /rgya mtsho'i ngogs su sgol mdzad bzhin/ /thub pa'i dam pa de ltar ni/ /bdag gis rje7sems can mang dgrol bgyi/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs char dang bcas pa'i sprin bzhin 93—1344

zab cing gsal ba'i gsung gis bka' sprul pa/ bzhin bzangs don grub ces bya'i ston par ni/ /mthu ldan khyod ni ston par rab 'gyur te/ /bdud sde bcas las 'di na mngon rgyal zhing / /kun nas 'jigs pa mngon par ltung byed 'gyur/ /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyis skyes bu de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan te/lung bstan zin pa dang / ji ltar gyur pa de rgyal po'i pho brang mnyan huldan kun du grags par gyur to⑤/ /ji tsam na rgyal po mnyan ldan gyis thos pa dang /der ④rang nyid song ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs des spro ba'i sems kyis (snyeskyes bu de la bsnyen bkur chen pos glang po che'i rgyab la bskyon te pho brang du khyer nas stan phyed la bzhag ste'u/ rgyal srid kyi phyed byen pas mchod pa dang / des smras pa/ rgyal po chen po bdag ni 'dod pa don du gnyer ba ma lags te/bdag rab tu byung nas tshangs par spyod pa spyad par gnang bar mdzad du gsol/de yang rgyal pos gnang nas legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung nas/ de der ji srid 'tsho'i bar du tshangs par spyod pa spyad de/ dus byas nas 'phrul dga'i lha rnams su skyes so/ /rgyal po mnyan 7ldan yang dus byas nas de'i rgyal srid la bzhag go/ /des kyang dus chung snyezad cig rgyal srid byas nas dus byas pa dang / blon po rnams kyis bsnyen bkur chen pos gzugs bzang rgyal por bskos te/ de lo drug khri'i bar du chos kyi rgyal po byas te—/ de nas shi 'phos nas dga' ldan gyi lha'i nang du skyes so/ /rgyal po chen po 'di ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na gzugs bzang ⑨zhes bya ba'i rgyal po de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du sems na de de ltar mi blta ste/ gser 93—1345
