rtogs pa brjod pa zhes bya ba/hpha7༄zhe/ /rgya gar skad du/ ārya na na di mi tra a ba dā na rmyenā ma/bod skad du/ 'phags pa dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs pa brjod pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo /'di skad bdag gis thos te/ bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgyad brgya lon par gyur pa na/ de'i tshe de'i dus na yul shi bi ka zhes bya ba na grong khyer byin gyes brlabs pa zhes bya ba yod dekye/ de na rgyal po rigs pa'i sde zhes bya ba gnas so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po rigs pa'i sde'i yul na dge slong dga' ba'i bshes gnyen zhes bya ba rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam gtan pa mngon par shes pa drug dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul che ba/ mthu che ba/ dpag tshad brgya stong phrag du ma na gnas pa'i sems can rnams las grog mo dang ku ta'i sems kyi spyod pa shes pa ④zhig gnas te/ de yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i 93—1407

dus kyi tshe dge slong gi dge 'dun 'dus pa rnams kyis 'di skad du/ khyod lta bu mya ngan las 'das na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nub par mi 'gyur ram zhes smras pa dang des de dag la smras pa/ nub par mi 'gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis lung bstan nas bshad do/ /'di ltar yang dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas dris pa/ gnas brtan yun ji srid cig gi bar du bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i dam pa'i chos gnas par 'gyur/ des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs dag dogs pa med kyis mya ngan dang smre sngags ma 'don cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi lag tu dam pa'i chos gtad par gyur te/ sbyin bdag dang sbyin pa po'i sbyin pa yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / gnas brtan dga' ba'i bshes gnyen la dge slong rnams kyis lku'adi skad ces smras so/ /gnas brtan bdag cag gis gnas brtan de dag gi mtshan yang mi 'tshal lo/ /gnas brtan gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag gnas brtan dang po'i mtshan ni pa ra dwa dza bsod snyems len zhes bya'o/ /gnas brtan gnyis pa'i mtshan ni gser be'u zhes bya'o/ /gnas brtan gsum pa'i mtshan ni ba ra dwa dza zhes bya'o/ /gnas brtan bzhi pa'i mtshan ni mi phyed pa zhes bya'o/ /gnas brtan lnga pa'i mtshan ni shing shun can zhes bya'o/ /gnas brtan drug pa'i mtshan ni bzang po zhes bya'o/ /gnas brtan bdun pa'i mtshan ni nag po zhes bya'o/ /gnas brtan brgyad pa'i mtshan ni bad sa'i bu zhes bya'o / /gnas brtan dgu pa'i mtshan ni ba lang skyong zhes bya'o/ /gnas brtan bcu pa'i mtshan ni lam pa zhes bya'o/ /gnas brtan bcu gcig pa'i ②93—1408

mtshan ni sgra gcan 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /gnas brtan bcu gnyis pa'i mtshan ni klu sde zhes bya'o/ /gnas brtan bcu gsum pa'i mtshan ni zur gyes shes huzhes bya'o—/ /gnas brtan bcu bzhi pa'i mtshan ni nags na gnas zhes bya'o/ /gnas brtan bco lnga pa'i mtshan ni mi pham pa zhes bya'o/ /gnas brtan bcu drug pa'i mtshan ni gtsug gi lam pa zhes bya'o/ /gnas brtan de dag ni rig pa gsum dang ldan pa sde snod gsum pa/ khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral ba / rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis tshe byin gyis brlabs te bsrings nas bcom ldan 'das kyi bkas rnguganas pa yin no/ /sbyin pa bo dang sbyin bdag rnams kyi 1sbyin pa yongs su dag par byed do/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis gnas brtan dga' ba'i bshes gnyen la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gnas brtan bdag cag gis gnas brtan de dag gang na bzhugs pa mi 'tshal lo/ /gnas brtan gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag gnas brtan dang po ba ra dwa dza bsod snyoms len ni 'khor dgra bcom pa stong dang lhan cig ba lang spyod kyi gling na gnas so/ /gnas brtan gser bee'u zhes bya ba ni 'khor dgra bcom pa lnga stong dang lhan cig shar gyi lus 'phags po'i gling na gnas so/ /gnas brtan ba ra dwa dza ni 'khor dgra bcom pa drug stong dang lhan cig byang phyogs kyi kha che'i yul na gnas so/ /gnas brtan mi phyed pa ni 'khor dgra bcom pa bdun stong dang lhan cig 'dzam bu'i gling na gnas so/ /gnas brtan shing shun can ni 'khor dgra bcom pa drug stong dang lhan cig byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling na gnas so/ /gnas brtan bzang po ni 'khor dgra bcom pa dgu stong dang lhan cig zangs gling na gnas so/ /gnas brtan nag byepo ni 'khor dgra bcom pa khri dang lhan 93—1409

cig sing ga la'i gling na gnas so/ /gnas brtan bad sa'i bu ni 'khor dgra bcom pa khri chig stong dang lhan cig pa na sa'i gling na gnas so/ /gnas brtan ba lang skyong ni 'khor dgra bcom pa brgyad stong dang lhan cig ri bo spos kyi ngad ldang la gnas so/ /gnas brtan lam pa ni 'khor dgra bcom pa stong phrag bcu gsum dang lhan cig lha'i gnas sum cu rtsa gsum na gnas so/ /gnas brtan sgra gcan 'dzin ni 'khor dgra bcom pa stong dang lhan cig thra yang ku'i gling na gnas so/ /gnas brtan klu sde ni 'khor dgra bcom pa stong phrag bcu gnyis dang lhan cig ri bo skya bo na bzhugs so/ /gnas brtan zur gyis shes ni 'khor dgra bcom pa stong phrag gsum dang lhan cig ri bo ngos yangs na gnas so/ /gnas brtan nags na gnas ni 'khor dgra bcom pa stong phrag bcu bzhi dang lhan cig lus 'phags kyi ri la gnas so/ /gnas brtan mi pham pa ni 'khor dgra bcom pa stong phrag bco lnga dang lhan cig rgyal po'i khab bya rgod phung po'i ri la gnas so/ /gnas brtan gtsug gi lam pa ni 'khor dgra bcom pa stong phrag drug cu dang lhan cig ri bo gnya' shing 'dzin na gnas so/ /gnas brtan de dag gis ni mi shes pa'am/ ma mthong ba'am/ ma thos pa'am/ mngon sum du ma byas pa ni cung zad kyang med do/ /dge 'dun kyi bzhes pa'am/ spyan drang ba'am/ bco lnga ston nam/ gtsug lag khang 'bul ba'am/ rab gnas sam/ gang cung zad mi shes pa med do/ /de dag tu gnas brtan bcu drug po de dag la 'khor du ma dang bcas pa cha lugs gzhan dang gzhan gyis de dang der byon zhing gnas te/ de ltar sbyin pa yongs su dag par byed do/ /ma 'ongs pa na mtshon gyi sti bskal pa byung ba 'das nas mi rnams dge ba bcu dang 93—1410

ldan pas tshe slar 'phel te/ lo brgyad cu thub pa na ston pa'i nyan thos de dag yang phyir la 'dzam bu'i gling du byon nas dam pa'i chos yang dag par ston par byed cing rab tu 'byin par byed do/ /ji srid skye dgu rnams kyi tshe lo drug brgya par gyur pa de srid du bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos gnas par gyur te/ mi rnams kyi tshe lo bdun brgya par gyur pa na nyan thos de dag gis gang sa'i steng 'di na bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstan pa'i tshogs ji snyed pa de dag gcig tu bsdus nas rin po che sna bdun gyi mchod rten gcig byas te kun nas bskor nas skyil mo krung bcas te 'dug nas 'di skad ces bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de 1 la 'dud pas phyag 'tshal lo zhes brjod de①/phyag byas nas phung po lhag ma med pa'i yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /rin po che sna bdun gyi mchod rten de yang nub nas 'og gi gser gye sa gzhi gang yin pa de la gnas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos nub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de'i rjes la rang sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun 'jig rten du 'byung ngo / /de nas mi rnams kyi tshe lo brgyad khri par gyur pa na de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa zhes bya ba 'jig rten du 'byung ngo 1/ /de'i tshe 'dzam bu'i ④gling ni 'byor ba rgyas pa/ bde ba/ lo legs ⑤pa/ mi dang skye bo khyemang pos yongs su gang zhing / bya gag 'phur ba tsam na grong khyer dang / grong dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang / yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang yod par 'gyur ro—/ /lan cig sa bon btab pas lo bdun gye bar du 'bras bu rnams skye bar 93—1411

'gyur ro/ /de'i ①nyan thos 'dus pa yang gsum du 'gyur te/ 'dus pa dang po la ni nyan thos 'dus pa bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'dus pa gnyis pa la ni nyan thos 'dus pa bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa bzhi 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'dus pa gsum pa la ni nyan thos bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa gnyis kyi khye'adus pa chen po 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin te/ gang 'di dag ni sbyin pa po dang sbyin bdag yin te/ yang de dag gis gzhan du bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i gsung rab la sangs rgyas la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun zhing bya ba byas par gyur pa yin te/ 'di lta ste/ gser gyi rang bzhin dang dngul gyi rang bzhin dang / bai ḍūrya'i rang bzhin dang / shel gyi rang bzhin dang /rin po che'i rang bzhin dang / ra gan gyi dngos po dang / khar 1 ba'i dngos po dang / mu tig dang / lcags kyi rang bzhin dang / zangs kyi dngos po dang / tsan dan gyi rang bzhin dang / a ka ru'i rang bzhin dang / dung gi rang bzhin dang / rwa'i ④rang bzhin dang ba so'i rang bzhin dang / sa'i rang bzhin dang / sna tshogs pa'i rang bzhin dang / rus pa'i rang bzhin dang sa las 'usgu gzugs sam mchod rten bzhengs su gsol zhing / tha na sor mo tsam gyi sku'am hūṃmachod rten bzhengs su gsol bas dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa ⑦ de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa'i gsung rab la mi'i 'thob pa rab tu thob nas/ 'dus pa dang bo la dang ba dang dang phyapa dang ldan pas rab tu byung nas skra dang kha sru byegs te chos gos bgos nas khyem nas ⑨khyem med par rab tu byung ste⑫/ smon lam ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su mya ngan las 'da'o/ /tshe dang 93—1412

ldan pa dag re zhig sangs rgyas la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa yin no/ /yang gang dag snang ba chos kyi phung bo brgyad khri po bcom ldan ①shākya thub pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed ⑤ par gyur cing / skyed du bcug pa dang / bris pa dang / 'drir bcug pa dang / bklags 1pa dang / klog tu bcug pa dang / gang dag theg pa chen po'i mdo sde zab pa zab par gyur pa stong pa nyid dang ldan pa ni 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / dam pa'i chos padma dkar po dang / rgya cher rol pa dang / gser 'od dam pa dang /yon tan 'od mchog dang / stong pa nyid kyi 'od mchog dang / phyag na rdo rje gsang ba la sogs pa dang sgyu 5 ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang / cho 'phrul chen po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bsod nams thams cad la thu(bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'phags pa zla ba sgon ma'i nying nge 'dzin dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / byang chub kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / byang chub bsdus pa dang /sangs rgyas thams cad yongs su 'dzin pa dang / glang po'i rtsal dang / sprin chen po dang / sor mo'i phreng ba dang / lang kar gshegs pa dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po dang / zla ba'i snying po dang / nyi ma'i snying po dang / nam mkha'i snying po dang / sa'i snying po dang / byams pas zhus pa dang / tshangs pas zhus pa dang / legs pa'i mtshan gyis zhus pa dang /drag shul can gyes zhus pa dang / dra ba can gyis zhus ⑥pa dang / klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa dang / drang srong rgyas pas zhus pa dang / brgya byin kyis zhus pa dang / lag na rin chen gyis zhus pa dang / mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon 93—1413

pas zhus pa dang / dpa' bo nam mkhas zhus pa dang / bu mo 'od ldan mas zhus pa dang / bu mo rin chen ldan gyis zhus pa dang / bu mo gser gyi 'od mchog gis ①zhus pa dang / bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed kyis zhus pa dang /dbang phyug chen pos zhus pa dang / rgyal po gzugs can snying pos zhus pa dang /dge ba bzang po gang gis zhus pa dang / lha'i bu mo legs pa'i mtshan gyis zhus pa dang / lha'i bu tsan dan kyis ṭazhus pa dang / lha'i bu rang gi 1rgyan gyis zhus pa dang / lag bzangs kyis zhus pa dang / seng ges zhus ④pa dang / seng ge rnam par rol pas zhus pa dang / dpas byin gyis zhus pa dang / gtsug na rin chen kyis zhus pa dang / zung gi mdo dang / byang chub sems dpa'i zlos gar dang / stag rna'i trertogs pa brjod pa dang / lam rnam par bshad pa dang / blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa dang / blo gros rgya mtshos bstan pa dang / dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa dang / bden pa la 'jug pa dang / ma skyes dgra'i 'gyur ba dang / sred med kyi 6bu'i 'gyur ba dang /stong 'gyur medang / 'dzam shebu'i gling 'gyur ba dang / 'dus par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi rgyan dang / thabs la mkhas pa dang / lag na utpa la dang / sangs rgyas bcu pa dang / chos bcu pa dang / sa bcu pa dang /'od dpag med kyi bkod pa dang / bde ba can gyi bkod pa dang / dam pa'i chos kyi yon tan bkod pa dang / tshogs kyi bkod rngupa dang / rnam dag me tog bsdus pa dang / 'jig rten dag pas bsdus pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dag pas bsdus pa dang / thams cad sdegs () las babs pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad lha las babs pa dang / rin bo che'i ⑪tog 93—1414

dang / rin po che'i phung po dang / rin po che'i za ma tog dang / mdzes pa brtsegs pa dang / rin chen skar mda' dang / rin chen sprin dang / rin chen ljon pa dang / rin chen gtsug dang / rin chen 'byung gnas dang /cod pan dra ba can dang / sdong po bkod pa dang / 'di dag la sogs pa bye ba phrag brgya ni theg pa chen po'i sde snod yin no/ /de bzhin du nyan thos kyi sde snod de/ mngon pa'i sde snod dang / 'dul ba'i sde snod dang / mdo sde'i sde snod 'di lta ste/ lung ring po rmyedang / lung bar ma dang / gcig las 'phros pa'i lung dang / yang dag par ldan pa'i lung dang / lung phra mo'o/ /de dag ni mdo sde'i sde snod ces bya'o/ /mngon pa'i sde snod gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dri ba drug dang yang dag par sbyar ba bsdus pa la ni mngon pa'i sde snod ces bya'o/ /de la 'dul ba'i sde snod gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dge slong gi 'dul ba dang / dge slong ma'i 'dul ba dang / ma mo'i 'dul ba dang /'dul ba'i ma mo ste/ tshe dang ldan pa dag /de dag la ni 'dul ba'i sde snod ces bya'o/ /'di dag ni skyes pa'i rabs te/ rtogs pa brjod pa'i rabs dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi rabs dang / sangs rgyas kyis 2snagasungs pa dang /rang sangs rgyas kyis 2bstan pa dang / byang chub sems dpas ④bstan pa dang /nyan thos kyis bstan pa dang / lhas bstan pa dang / byung sheb bsdus pa dang / chos nye bar bsdus pa dang / tha na tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig gsung par 'gyur ba yang bklags 'upar gyur pa dang / bzung bar gyur pa dang / glegs bam du bris par gyur pa dang / chos smra ba la mchod par gyur pa dang / de dag dang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa la mchod par gyur pa ⑦ 93—1415

dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / spos dang / mar me dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / glegs bam la kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gos rnams g.yogs shing dkris pa dang / glegs shing mchog byas par gyur pa dang / glegs thag kha dog sna tshogs pas glegs bam bcings par gyur pas dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa de dag thams cad ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa'i gsung rab la mi'i 'thob pa rab tu thob nas dad pas khyem spangs te/ skra dang kha spu byegs nas chos gos bgos te khyim nas khyim med par 'dus pa gnyis pa la rab tu dbyung steshe7 / smon lam ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar rngu'agyur ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag de dag ni re zhig chos la dge ba'i rtsa ba bsgrun pa yin no/ /'di ltar 'di dag ni sbyin pa po dang sbyin bdag yin te/ dge 'dun la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa dang /skyed du bcug pa yin te/ 'di ltar 'di dge 'dun spyan 'dren pa bsgrags 1pa dang / dge ba la 'dzud pa dang / brgyad ston byed pa dang / gso sbyong byed pa dang / rab tu mgron byetu 'bod pa dang / dge 'dun la mchod ston gsol ba dang / spyan 'dren pa dang / glo bur du srun 'dren pa dang / zla ston byed pa dang / stag res skor byed pa dang / chos sgogs pa spyan 'dren pa dang / lo lnga ston byed pa dang / gtsug lag khang dbul ba dang / mal stan 'dings pa dang / chos gos 'bul ba dang / gtsug lag khang gsar pa'i rab gnas byed pa dang / sman 'bul ba dang / yo byad 'bul bas dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa de dag thams cad ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa'i gsung rab la mi'i 'thob pa rab tu thob nas 'dus pa gsum pa la 93—1416

dad pas khyim spangs te/ skra dang kha spu phyi nas chos gos bgos te/ yang dag pa'i khyim nas khyem med par rab tu byung steshesna/ smon lam ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa 2snade dag ni re zhig dge 'dun la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa yin no/ /de nas gnas brtan dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rnam par rgya cher bshad nas/ shing ta 1la bdun srid tsam du nam mkha' la 'phags nas dge 'dun de dag gi mdun du cho 'phrul ya ma zung sna tshogs bstan te/ steng gi nam mkha' la 'dug nas che'i 'du byed dang srog gi 'du byed btang ste/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas dge slong de dag gis gnas brtan dga' ba'i bshes gnyen la lus bsregs nas mchod rten byas te/ dri dang / me tog dang / spos dang / mar me dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan rnams kyis mchod par byas so/ /rnam pa ④'di dag 'phags pa nas 'phags par brgyud nas bshad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sbyin pa po dang / sbyin bdag gang yin pa rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi snyegasung rab yun ring du gnas par gyur to thusnyam nas dga' ba rab tu bskyed pa'i phyir rtogs pa brjod pa 'di 'phags pa dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bshad do / /྅'phags pa dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dārtogs pa 9brjod pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po a dzi ta shrī bha dra 7dang / dge slong shākya 'od kyis bsgyur / / // skye93—1417

bsdur mchan/14༷7 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉tshol dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs brjod bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉don midri tā ba nā/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉do // rgya 〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉ṅkashesapa/14༷8 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke dag gi/ sti 〈〈co 〉7pa'i/14༷9 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gishes/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉dkyis bka'/ 1〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉dkyis/ du〈〈snar 〉donags/141༷ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/1411 ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7de/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉ra// ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉jang / ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dzamyu'i / ④〈〈pe 〉〉logs/ du〈〈pe 〉〉pas/1412 1〈〈snar 〉skoradi'i/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ ① 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pakhar/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉para'i/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉byes sku'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7bskyedapa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dang / ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gikhrim nas/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉te/1413 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da 'das/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnam/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stabag du〈〈pe 〉〉rgya/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉—la—/ 〈〈snar 〉〉du/ ⑥〈〈snar 〉ṅkazhus/1414 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stag/ ①〈〈co 〉dkyi/ ①〈〈co 〉stanas/ rjo〈〈pe 〉ma sa/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 'i/rjo〈〈co 〉dkyis/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉da ba/ ske〈po ra 〉ma ma/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉dkyis kad/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bsdegs—/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da me/1415 ①〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ bu〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉dkyi/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ du〈〈snar 〉〉dpa'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉'byung / du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tsho ga ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉maragyur ba/1416 ① 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉jing te/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toradas par/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rdzags/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gron—/1417 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉te/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da dag ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉twa/ ④〈〈co 〉7ra/ rjo〈〈co 〉dkyis/⑥ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngagyur ro/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉// // ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ ⑨〈〈co 〉〉par ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mar ta shri bha tra/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉da sarba maṅga lo//93—1418
bsdur 'bras re'u miga'adulab/ (44)93wa 1419

༄ / /gzhon nu ma bdun gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/kṇi༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sabha ku mā rī ka a dzub dā dzwa/ bod skad du/ gzhon nu ma bdun kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chags bral ldan dang legs par bshad pa dang / ngo mtshar dang ni de nyid don nges dang / /dam pa rnams kyi gcig tu mnyan bya yi/ /rtogs pa brjod pa bdag gis bshad kyis nyon/ /'di ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin pa rnams la ni/ longs spyod chen po'am/ lang tshos bar du gcod par mi 'gyur bas mdzes par gyur pa yin no/ /de yang 'di ltar rjes su thos te/ rgyal po kṛ tī 1zhes bya ba tshul dang dul ba la sogs pa yon tan kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srungs la dad pa yang dag par thob pa zhig byung bar gyur pa de / de'i bu mo bdun sngon du byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams la dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya 93—1420

cher bskrun pa'i stobs dang ldan pa de dag 'khor bas shin tu yid byung bar gyur nas—/ de rnams kyis dul ba dang zhe 1sar bcas pas pha la phyag byas te snyan pa'i tshig gis smras pa/ 'jig rten gnas pa chu nang song ba'i zla ba'i gzugs bzhin g.yo bar mthong / /'dod pa khros pa'i sbrul gyis lus skyil gdengs ka'i grib ma lta bur mthong / /'gro ba 'di dag sdug bsngal me yis kun du 'bar ba mthong bas na/ /rgyal po bdag cag nges par 'byung la mngon dga' dur khrod dag tu mchi/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ khyed ni byis pa bde la brten 7'os shing / /yid la bsams pa'i don yang ma byas na/ /dka' thub gnas su khyed rnams song shig ① ces/ /ji lta bur na nga yis smra bar nus/ /bu mos smras pa/ sa bdag khyed kyi mdzad spyod bdag cag rnams kyis 'tshal lags te/ /'gro la thugs rjes brlan zhing ④des pa'i ngang tshul ldan pas na/ /dgos pa med la'ang byams par mdzad na nyid kyi phang par ni/ /rnam bskyed sdig med nyer son bdag cag rnams lta smos ci 'tshal/ /khyed dang lhan cig gnas kyang dbang med bral ba mngon phyogs pa'i/ /phongs pa 'di yis phyir zhing nye bar gdung bar ma gyur ces/ /rgyal po shin tu dga' ba'i gnas su gyur pa gang dag yin pa yi/ /zhi ba'i go 'phang thob par 'tshal ba'i yid ni skyes par gyur/ /de nas rgyal po de snying brtse ba'i dbang gis yid rnam par nyams shing / mig gnyis zangs ltar dmar la mi 'gyur bas yang dang yang du bltas nas smras pa/ci phyir khang bzangs rang dgar gyur dang 'jam yangs pa'ikru/ /sna tshogs stan bzangs rgya chen rnam par spangs nas ni/ /dur khrod mi bzad skye bo ngan pa'i yid 'dra zhing / /sa gzhi rus pa dkar bo'i tshal pas bkram pas stan6 / /93—1421

gdung ba'i gdong can pha dang yul rmugs lta bur ni/ /mchi ma'i gdong can ma yang cig car ji ltar 'dor/ /g.yo med sems kyi rgyun du yid ni brtse ba yi /mdza' bshes ① spangs nas ci phyir dka' thub bstan mepar dga'/ /de nas bu mo de rnams kyis shin tu brtan pa'i yid kyis bsnyems par byas nas/ smras pa/pha dang ma dang mdza' bshes gces pa tha snyad tsam/ /'di dag srid par phyir yang lhung dang gnod pa'i gzhi/ /'byung ba'i don mthong shog tu gyur pa'i dri ma yis / /mi yi kyibadag po 'jig rten 'jig pas yongs su skyo/ /mdza' bshes rang mi gnyen gyi ngo bo sna tshogs pa/ /g.yon can phung khrol ④ldan pa 'di la su zhig chags/ /'tsho ba'i 'jig rten rmi lam mig 'phrul skye dang 'dra la/ /'di na su zhig gang gis rang mi'am skye bor brtag /mi yi ⑥dbang po 'jig rten dam chos gsung gi 'od zer snang bcas shing / /ji srid sangs rgyas nyi ma'i yid 'ong grags pa'i ⑦'od zer phreng yod pa/ /de srid phongs pa'i mun nag tshogs kyis shin tu g.yogs gyur pa'i/ /srid pa'i mun pa mi zad mun rum nas ni 'byung bar bya ba'i rigs/ /ji ltar rlung gis brdabs pas bskyod pa'i me lce 'bar ba'i khyem las ni/ /'byung bar byed pa'i skyes bu de la phan par 'dod rnams zlog mi byed/ /de bzhin sdug bsngal me chen rtser gnas srid pa ma lus gnod pa yi3sna/ /dra ba las ni nges par 'byung la phan phyir dam pas bzlog ⑨mi bya / /de nas rgyal po des bu mo de rnams mdza' bshes dang rang mi dang rtsa lag rnams la ltos ṅku pa med pa'i tshig rtsub po dang / rang gi lus dang srog la yang shin tu ma chags pa'i tshig gis lhag par yang mya ngan gyis gdungs par gyur pa'i yid kyis de rnams la yang smras pa/ dus min dka' thub mngon par 'dod pa 93—1422

ni—/ /yid dang rjes mthun don du mi 'gyur te/ /bu mo dus min mngal dang ldan pa la/ /yan lag cha shas mdzes pa mi skye bzhin/ /dus la bab par dka' thub la sbyor ba/ /zla ba skyon dang bral ba lta bur mdzes/ /de bas gzhon nus phan med blo 'gyur 'di'i/ /log pa'i lam du 'jug las bzlog par gyis/ /bde la brten zhing ⑨sdug bsngal ma mthong bas/ /lus kyis sdug bsngal bzod par mi 'gyur te/ /a mra'i shing ni rtsa ba ma zug la/ /glang chen mchog gi mche ba bsnun dang mtshungs/ /khong nas me 'bar ltas ngan sgra 'byin pa'i—/ /ce ②spyang 'jigs pa'i sgra sgogs tshang tshing gang / /'jigs pa rnams kyang 'jigs ⑪ par byed pa yi/ /mi bzad dur khrod dag ni 'jigs par bcas//khyed lus padma'i rtsa ltar 'jam pa la/ /sems gang sog les lta bur brtse ④med 'dis / /gzhan gyi ngor byed pa ni spangs byegyur pa/ /e ma ho gnam bskos khyebadag la brtse med sdang / /bee ḍūrya ltar sngo ljang ngur stiba'i gos gyon cing / /me tog rnam pa du ma'i tshogs ni bkram gyur dang / /bung ba pyos pa'i tshogs kyis khyab pa'i rtsed mo'i tshal/ /'dir kyeni bu mo khyed rnams mngon par dga' bar gyes/ /skyed mos tshal na sprung khang ngogs na me tog shing 'phyang zhing ⑨/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i ⑩chu rlabs mdzes pa'i phreng bas ska rags bcings/ /padma dag dang utpal rgyas gseb ngang pa sgra sgogs pa/ /brgya byin gyes kyang rnyed dka' bu mo dga' bas gnas par gyis/ /me tog na pa ma li ka yi dris bsgos gyur pa yi/ /chu rlabs mdzes par gyur pa'i nye bar g.yo ba yi/ /rlung dang bcas pa'i khyim 'di dang ni nags tshal ni/ /khu byug spyosgra 'byin pa yi bu mo dga' bar gyis/ /skar khung dra ba can nang bya rnams skad 'byin me tog dris 93—1423

bsgos dang / /sgeg ①pas khrus byas dri zhim bsgos pa'i nags dang 'dra ba'i rlung dag ni/ /khang bzangs mda' yab can dang bya gag bde bar nyal ba gang yin 'dir/ /bud med 'dus pa'i glu dbyangs rol mo ldan par spyod rnams dga' bar gyis/ /de nas gzhon nu ma du/rnams pha'i tshig des yi zhu ma rangs par gyur nas smras pa/ mi yi bdag po lha yul sa steng na/ /brgya phrag stong du srud pa ma byas pa'i/ /bde ba gzhan dag ci yang yod min te/ /bdag cag rnams ni don med mkhas pa yin/ /yul la lhag ④par sred cing goms pas na/ /dbang po rnams ni yul gyis ngoms pa med/ /srid pas 'jigs pa'i rtog pa'i shāblo can dag /srid pa'i longs spyad zad par bya phyir 'jug /ngo bo nyid kyis 'gyur zhing mi brtan la/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i chu rlabs ltar 'jigs pas/ /sdom can dbang po drug las rnam rgyal rnams/ /phyir zhing srid par 'jug las ldog par byed/ /byis pa srid pa'i btson rar phag lta bur//sems kyi spags pa'i spyod pas bslus gyur te/ /bde bar mngon par rlom zhing brkam pa dag /phongs ⑥shing 'jigs pa'i g.yang sa mtha' med lhung / /bdag tu rtog pas sems g.yengs skyes gyur pa/ /de ni rab 'bar mtshon cha'i 'khrul 'khor 'dra/ /yul la rjes su brten pas sems bcom pa/ /yongs su smin na snyug bsngal mi bzad rgyu/ /'gro ba 'di dag mi brtan dbang med cing / /sbrul gdug ⑦mtshon gyis zin 'dra'i yul rnams dag /rtogs kyang gang zhig ④srid la chags gyur pa/ /de ni mi yi gzugs ldan phyugs nyid yin/ /rnga rtsid shing la thogs pa'i g.yag bzhin du/ /blo yi lam ni rnyog pas nyer 'gags shing / /log par chags pa'i yal gas sems thogs pa'i/ /skyes bu ngan pa'i 93—1424

khyim rten ①phung bar 'gyur/ /dga' ba'i rgyu tsam 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten la/ /phongs pa rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung 'gyur na/ /yab cig srid pa'i dga' ba mang po las/ /slu bar mi 'gyur gang zhig mchis kye par gsungs/ /mi dbang srid na skal ba rngumanyam pa yis/ /nye bar bsgrubs shing bsags par gyur kyang ni—/ /bcom zhing sems ni dman pa dman pa yis/ /srid pa'i dgon pa gzhan du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po rgyar chud gyur pa'i nya bzhin du/ /skyes bu legs par brtags shing byed pa dang / /tha snyad kun la ngang gis mkhas pa yang / /khyem gyi btson thurar gnas na 'jig 5par 'gyur/ /sa yi bdag po 'bad pa mang po yis/ /khyim du rdzas rnams bsags pa byas pa dag /mi yis skad cig gis ni 'dor 'gyur te/ /legs bshad gcig pu 'di nyid lam du bstan—/ /de bas 'jig rten mgon pos 'tsho ba yi/ /'jig rten mi thurnams las bdag byar gsungs te/ /'chi ba mngon phyogs mi la rang gi las/ /ba la be'u bzhin du rjes su 'brangs/ /yongs su gyur na mi bzad gnyen sdug dang //sdug dang 'dre bar mngon pas 'dod des chog /sdug dang phrad pas dga' bar sems pa dag /nges par sdug dang bral ba'i snyug bsngal 'thob/ /mi dbang gzhan yang ngang gis mthar 'jig pa'i/ /'tsho ba'i 'jig rten dag na sdug pa su / /dam pa'i don la rnam dpyod mkhas pa yang / /sdug ces bya ba 'dis ྅blo rnam par g.yengs/ /sa bdag khyed ni gal te bdag cag la/ /sbug pa 'ga' zhig mchis na bdag cag rnams/ /ma smad 'phags pas bsten zhing 7mi phrogs pa'i/ /bde ba yid la 'dod pa sgrub tu gsol/ /de nas rgyal po de brtse ba'i yi ⑪ma rangs par gyur kyang / bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa la 93—1425

mngon par dad pas chos la bar chad byed pa'i 'jigs pa skyes pa dang /rang gi bu mo rnams kyis sngon gyi skye ba rjes su dran te 'gro bar 'dod pas na skye ba dran pas nyes so snyam du bsams te shin tu yun ring por cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /mi yi skyes bu de yis ni/ /'chi ①ba med par shes pas na/ /song bas yongs su ma spangs par/ /ci zhig ltar ni rjes snang smras/ /de nas bu mo de rnams kyis me tog phreng ba dang byug pa dang rgyan rnams spangs nas/ dul ba dang ldan par zhugs pa'i lus la gos dkar po phra zhing rab tu 'phyang ba gyon pas chu bo rlung gi shugs kyis bskyod ( pepa'i dbu ba'i phreng ba lta bu'am/ ston ka'i mtshan mo zla ba'i 'od kyis spyogos kyis bkab pa lta bu'am/ drang srong sme bdun gyi skar ma rang gi 'od zer gyi dra bas g.yogs pa lta bu dang / rim gyis ro bsreg ④pa'i gnas me'i dbus su ro bzhag pa cil cil zer ba rnam par bkram pa dang / ro rnam par mnam skyepa dri mi zhim cing 'jigs su rung ba dang / mi'i thod pa bya rgod kyis du mchu'i rtse mo rnon pos brdol ④ba'i bu ga nas glad pa dang chu ser rnam par 'jigs ⑧pas mi ro'i gdong la spags pas mtha' ma khyab cing 'jigs pa dang / rnyings shing dengs la mdog ⑨rnam par 'gyur ba'i rus pa dum bu'i tshogs kyis non cing rtsub pas sa'i phyogs rnams bgrod par dka' ba dang /lus can dag yongs su yid 'byung bar byed pa gshin rje'i gnas bzhin mya ngan dang yid mi bde ba dang / snyug bsngal ba'i gnas su gyur pa'i dur khrod du phyin par gyur to/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ mi yi khrag dang ⑪zhag gis dri mi zhim pas pyos par gyur pa'i bya rgod dang / /rgyu lto nar bas khyab cing mi sdug 'jigs pa'i ro ⑫yi yan lag rnams kyis khebs/ /kun da 'dra bar dkar 93—1426

zhing rtag tu dgod pa 'dra bar mtha' gas thod pa dang / /n+ya gro dha snying rmyesul nas 'ug pa sna tshogs hūṃ ⑤sgogs 'jigs pa'i dur khrod phyin/ /ce 1spyang kha ni mer bcas brlang ba'i sgra dag sgogs pas 'jigs pa dang / /la lar thod pa dkar po'i dra bas khyab cing bgrod dka' dang / srin bu rigs kyi tshigs kyis gzengs byashing rna khung bskyod pa dang / /bung ba sbrang ⑤bu brgya phrag mang po ro la 'phungs shing 'du/ /rus pa dkar dang dmar rlon rlung gis bskyod par gyur pa dang / /ro bsregs ⑥me gsal 'phro dang shing skam rtsa na sbrul nyal dang / /la lar mi yi lus ni mdung rnos phug nas bskyon pa dag /gshin rje rtag tu dga' ston byed la 'jug pa'i tshang bang 'dra/ /la lar mi mgo'i thod pa'i gseb nas khrag dang chu ser 'dzags ⑦pa yi/ /khu ba mi sdug dag la sred pa'i sha za'i tshogs kyis khyab/ /la lar cil cil zer ba'i ro bsreg me yis bskor ba dang / /mi ro'i khong nas rgyu long phyung ba gtor bas khyab par gyur/ /skyo bas brlan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /der ni bud med der brtags nas/ /'tsho ba'i 'jig rten rgyu mi rgyu'i/ /ngo bo nyid ni sems par gyur/ /skra yi snying ni rdul la gyis rtsub cing dmar/ /mig sbubs bya yi mchu dang sder mos brus/ /gsang gnas 'gyur zhing mi snyug rnag bcas par/ /bor ba'i bud med lus der rab tu bltas/ /dam pa'i spyod pa thang cig gnyer spugayos shing / /atpal 'dab ltar dkyus ring mig gis ni/ /ro yi gzeb de mngon par bltas nas kyang / /tshig mang rnam pa ⑩du ma smras par gyur/ /'di nyid rdo thal byugs pas dga' ba'i gnas khang ni/ /zla zer gsal bas spras par byas pa ru/ /sdug pa'i phong par brten zhing ⑫gnas pa las/ /de ni sa yi dkyil 'khor gzhi la nyal/ /93—1427

sdug pa'i lag pa'i gzeb tu nyal ba na/ /'brug sgra sgogs pa yis ni khyod skrag na/ /mer bcas ltas ngan ce kṇispyang sgra yis ni/ /dka' thub ma khyod ci phyir 'dir mi 'jigs / /'di nyid rang gi khyim 'khor zla zer de/ /ro smad phyi ba'i khur gyis dal 'gro la/ /rol cing dgod la sgeg par rnam lta ba du/ /brtse med bya rnams da ltar za bar byed/ /'gro ba 'di dag ngan cing mi brtan te/ /snying rje med pa'i sdug des khruci yi phyir/ /mi ro brgya yis khyab par gyur pa yi/ /dur khrod 'di ru khyod ni bor bar 'gyur/ /rang mi rtsa lag mdza' bshes sdug pa dang / /padmar bung ba bzhin du gnas pa las/ /ci phyir mtshan mos rgyu bas 'jigs kyang ni/ /nyon mongs deng 'dir dur khrod dag tu dga'/ /sngon ni mdzes shing snum la dkyus ring 'jam pa'i mig gis ce lta ba na/ /chags can rnams kyis mig 'bras mtha' dmar 'gyur zhing mi rnams nyams byed pa/ /'dod lha'i ri dwags rgyar gyur bud med de nyid deng ni bya rnams kyis/ /mig phyung sdug bsngal byas pas chags dang bcas rnams shin tu 'jigs 'u par byed/ /mi gtsang sna tshogs khong na mi mngon srog shing gi /lus la bdag gir chags pas long ba'i mig bslus ⑥zhes/ /bud med mchog 'di 'dod chags ldan pa rnams la ni/ /brkam pa'i bya yis mchus btog lhi/gdong gis nye bar dgod/ /pi wang gling bu'i sgra snyan rnams dang snyan pa'i glu gar dang bcas pas⑤ /mchog tu sdug pa'i pang na bag phab bde bar gnyid log pa'i/ /bud med de ni ce shespyang skad 'byin mu cor 7sgra bcas shing / /sa rdul gyis khyab rtsub pa'i dur khrod 'dir deng nyal bar gyur/ /gang du rnam par brtags kyang skra yi rtse mo tsam gyis ni/ /gtsang ba mi gtsang tshogs kyis tshang tshing skye'adir mi snad⑫/ /phung 93—1428

khrol chos can nad mang 'dod pa thang chad la nyu/ /rang bzhin ngan rnams ci phyir de ni chags par gyur/ /bu mo 'gro ba kun gye tshul yang 'di 'dra bas/ /rmi lam mig 'phrul chu zla lta bur rang bzhin gyis/ /g.yo ba rtogs pa ji srid srog ni lhag ma dang / /bcas shing lus gzhon bye gyur tshe chags dang nyer bral byos / /gshin rje'i chu srin dga' ba'i khar ni chud gyur cing / /skra dkar tshogs kyis twospyi nas bzung nas ni/ /srog mthar gyur pa'i gnod pa'i tsher ma'i gnad phug la/ /mchi mas mig khebs gyur tshe dge ba ji ltar bya/ /'jig rten pha rol mi bzad mun nag g.yang chen du/ /ltung sa/zhing lus byer gyur tshe dge ba 'dod gyur pa/ /dug can sbrul kha dog pa'i nang du chud gyur pa'i/ /sbal pa nga ro 'don dang mtshungs zhes mkhas rnams smra/ /ci phyir tshig rtsub phra ma ma 'byel spyi rtol zhwasmra ba dang / /snyan tshig bcos mas dzwa'ajig rten bslus par gyur nas di ring ni/ /mi smra gnas zhes spyod pa lta bus mdun so'i phrag nas ni/ /bya rnams tsham tshom med par mchu yi skam 87pas lce yang 'byin par 'gyur/ /chags pas mdongs shing log pepa'i yul goms yon pa'i 1— snabasam pa can/ /byis pa gang gis mig gi nyulngayul mthong bstan rmyepa rnam 'jig pa'i/ /mdzes pa'i ro smad de ni de ring 'jigs dang bral ba yi/ /mi bzad bya rgod mchu dang sder mor 'jog cing tshul du 'dri/ /gang dag rang gi khang pa sa gzhi me tog sel mas gtor ba yi/ /rtsig pa'i ri mo yongs 'gyur bzhin dang zur gyis lta byed cing / /sdug pa'i lag pa'i padmar brten zhing 4dal gyis 'gro ba yi⑩/ /bud med de yi rkang pa de ⑫ni wa dag za bar 'gyur/ /'di ltar lhan cig skyes pa'i mi sdug mi gtsang 'dam rdzab dang / /dregs pas myos shing sems lhung gyur pas 93—1429

sdug bsngal nyon mongs pa'i/ /lus la khyed ⑫kyis 'di ni rang bzhin ma zhir bltas nas ni/ /'tsho ba'i 'jig rten glog ltar rab tu 'jig la'ang yid byung gis / /yang dag ji bzhin thugs chud chos kyi rgyal pos sems can rnams/ /nyon mongs rma nang rgyun mi 'chad par 'dzag pas — /gdung ba la/ /rang bzhin bsel ba'i chos gsung chu yi bum pas tshim mdzad pa/ /sman pa'i mchog gyur ston pa de la rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes par dka' zhing g.yon can ma zhi ༷ snalas dang nyon mongs ldan/ /rnam par 'gyur la ma zhi skye bar bshad pa gang yin pas / /rmongs pa shing rta'i 'phang lo bzhin du dbang med 'khor/ /'jig rten mi bzad phongs ④pa'i rdo rjes lus ni nges 'joms 'gyur/ /gzhon nu'i tshe na ma yis lan chobur ldan pa'i skra byas shing / /gang la lang tsho mdzes pa'i nor bu'i phreng ba mchog bcings dang / /bram zes ⑥me tog bcas pa'i zhi ⑦ba'i chu thigs kyis gtor ba'i/ /bud med mgo la mi bzad khwa rnams thogs pas chonyon mongs so/ /gang zhig bag ma'i dus su me tog bzang bsgos shing / /ma yi lag pas dge mtshan bkra shis byas gyur pa'i/ /skra de di ring rab drag rlung gis bskyod nas ni/ /dur khrod dag gi shing la rnga yab nyid du gyur/ /rang bzhin sgrin par lta dang zur gyis lta gang song / /sgeg pa'i goms stabs dang ni dregs pyos gang du song / /dga' bas steg 1snacing glu dang dgod pa gang du song / /e ma sgyu ma'i gsang ba'i rab bkod ngo mtshar che/ dgod cing dal gyis rnam g.yo'i rna rgyan 'od kyis mkhur 3ba dmar po dang / /gang du srog dang mnyam pa'i mdzes pa'i ri mo 'bad de bris pa dang / /padma gzhon nu'i snying bo lta bu 'jam pa'i mkhur ⑪tshos gang yin der/ /bya rnams dpral bar gnas 93—1430

shing khrag gis spags pa'i mchu yis 'tshog par byed/ /'od can mu tig phreng ba'i lbu ba dkar zhing ba spu'i chu bal can/ /nu ma rgyas pa'i ngur pa zung ldan brang gi rdzing khyamachog yangs pa dag /g.yo ba'i gos lhung byas pas phongs pa'i mig ni gang du chags gyur pa/ /der ni rnam par rnags rmyepas sbrang bu'i tshogs rnams 'phungs par gyur/ /sngon ni tsan dan chu thigs phreng gtong ta 1la'i lo ma rlung yab dang / /mngag gzhug rnams dang bzang mo'i gdu bu'i sgrar ldan pa dag g.yog byed cing / /khang bzangs zla zer gyis spras dkar bas mdzes pa'i sngas ni rten gyur pa/ /de ni deng 'dir khwa yi sgo gshog 5rtsub pas baspyod pa'i rlung gis g.yob par gyur/ /gang gis sngon ni 'di bskyod cing / /gseb nang dag tu gnas bcas nas/ /lus kyi shing ni spangs nas ni/ /sems kyi spre'u de gang du song / /gang gis byed pa med 'di yang / /byed pa lta thubur ston byed pa/ /bdag med ro 'di spangs nas su/ /sems kyi bzhad gad mkhan gang song / /gang zhig rmongs las ⑥blo mdongs pas/ /nang na bdag tu 'dogs gyur cing / /mu stegs can rnams rmongs byed pa'i/ /rnam shes srin po de gang song / /gang gis yun ring rnam rmongs kyang / /yang dag par ni mi gnas pas/ /sna tshogs sems kyi sprusgyu ma mkhan/ /'gro ba 'di las gang du song / /bdag gi 'gro ba ser skya sogs/ /dka' thub pas kyang mi shes pas/ /nam mkha'i yul gyi spyod yul can/ /sems kyi rig 'dzin de gang song / /g.yo dang mi g.yo'i sgo dgu po/ /mi gtsang 'di ni spyod spyod pa/ /de nas lus kyi gzeb 'di las/ /sems kyi bya de gang du song / /mi bzad sul las sdug bsngal 'bab pa'i lan tshwa duchen pos rab tu khengs gyur thupa'i/ /srid pa'i rgya 93—1431

mtsho nyon mongs sbrul dang nyar 'gre gang yin der chud cing / /mi shes chu srin 'khrugs rngupa'i chu rlabs g.yo ba'i chu bor nub gyur pa/ /sems kyi mtshan mo spyod pa lus 'di spangs nas di ring gang du song / /nyes ④bral bcom ldan de ni gdul pa'i thabs rnams gang dag yin mkhyen gye/ /ma dul gang gis mthar ni dmyal bar me 'bar 'phro bar gyur pa yi/ /gser ltar ser ba'i gseb tu dbang med par ni 'dor byed pa/ /rang bzhin g.yo bar byed pa'i sems kyi rta de di ring gang du song / /de nas rdo rje'i 'od kyis 'khrig ma rgyas ljang ba/ /brgya byin dga' bas mig gdangs dul bcas nyer song ste/ /bu mo rnams la rang bzhin skal bzang tshig gis ni/ /rjes su mthun zhing dge bas legs so legs zhes smras/ /sring mo na tshod gzhon zhing 'dod lha'i gnas gyur dang / /rgyal rigs 'byor pa'i dpal gyi zubade ba spangs nas ni/ /sngon gyi drang srong rnams kyi bka' cel zhugs gyur pa/ /dka' thub 'dis bdag yongs dga' khyed rnams ci 'dod smṛs/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug lag mthil gnas bzhin shes par gyis/ /sum cu rtsa gsum bdag po'i bde ba'ang des rtogs la/ /lha rgyal brgya byin bdag yin khyed nyid gang 'dod dang / /sring mo bdag gis nges par gang bya myur du sgos/ /de nas gzhon nu de rnams yul gyi bde la 'dod rnged cing / /rang bzhin g.yo med sems kyis brgya byin zur mig gis bltas nas / /rang gi dge ba yongs smin rngubartan pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /kha na ma tho med gsal sna tshogs don ldan tshig 'di smras/ /brgya byen bdag cag skye ba'i sdug bsngal gyis ni gdungs gyur pa'i/ /srid pa'i bde ba'i zil pa'i kha chu 'dzag 'upa'i rgyu 'dra'i phyir/ /bzhin ras mdzes pa mya ngan mchi mas bris shing 93—1432

rnyogs ①pa yi/ /gnyen rnams spangs nas dka' thub 'di la rjes su zhugs pa min / /gzhan yang 'gro ba ma lus tshul ngan gyis bcings mi bzad pa/ /phongs ⑪pa brgya phrag stong gis bcom pas nges par skyo gyur cing snye/ /bkren pas nyam ④thag mthong bas nyes zad rnams kyis rjes 'brangs te/ /rga med mya ngan med pa'i go 'phang thob phyir brtson pa yin/ /gal te 'gro la rjes brtse lhag bsam ngang tshul ldan gyur cing / /ci ste brgya byin khyod khyakyis mchog ni yang dag ster nus na/ /'chi med mi phrogs tshangs bzhi 'utshangs pa'i go 'phang 1snarnam grol te / /srid pa'i 'jigs pas yongs gdungs 8bdag cag rnams kyis thob par mdzod/ /lus las byung zhing 'dzag pa'i dri ma skyon gyes bsgos par gnas pa dang / /ma yi mngal du mi gtsang 'dam kyi tshogs na yang ma spangs spyod/ /byung na rus pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis 'uni mgo babyung 6brgyal zhing nyam lho1thag pas/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i skye ba gcad ⑫par mdzod//rga ba'i srin mos skra dkar mche ba dkar po myu gu ldan pa yi/ /kha gdangs nas ni 'gro la gzhung lugs med par spyi nas 'dzin byed cing / /gang 'di mi yi brtson dran blo gros dga' ba'i dpal ni rab 'joms pa/ /lha yi dbang po khyod kyis gal te nus na de las bskyab par mdzod/ /dbugs rgod g.yo zhing lto ba sra la pags pa skya zhing rtsub pa dang / /longs spyod 'bar ba sna tshogs thob kyang spyod par mi nus stobs med pa/ /gang gis lus zin 'chi bdag pho nya'i skyes bu nad tshogs rab 'jigs pa/ /lha dbang khyod ni ci ste mchog sbyin 'dod na de las bdag cag skyobs/ /mig ni phyir phyogs gyur cing ⑫mi g.yo gnad rngurnams gcod pas sdug bsngal ba/ /nyon mongs 'khrugs snyepas rab tu lus 93—1433

bcom 'jigs pas phung po 'gyel ba dang / /gnyen rnams mthong bas mchi mas mkhur ①ba dag dang mchu ni bkrus gyur pa/ /gang gis zin na rab tu 'jigs 'gyur 'chi ༷ 7ba de las bdag cag srungs/ /gang gis yid khyab gyur na phyugs bzhin 'gyur zhing mya ngan gyis zin la/ /bya dang mi bya'i rnam pa blo la mi sems smad pa'i gnas snyebaskyed pa/ /tha mal bsel ba'i 'thor ba'i rlung gis g.yab ④kyang lus tshim mi 'gyur ba'i/ /'dod chags me chen de ni mchog sbyin khyod kyis nges par zhi bar mdzod/ /gang gi shugs kyis mig 'gyur g.yo zhing so yis sgos ⑤gnon la/ /skad cig gis kyang mi bzad dmyal ba'i 'bras bu ster byed sdig can ni/ /dengs pa'i lo ma dang ni chu dag za ba'i thub rnams kyis kyang ma bton pa'i/ /yid kyi sul gnas khro ba'i sbrul de brgya byin khyod kyis bsal bar mdzod/ /gang gis mig khebs gyur na blo gros ngan rnams zhi ba'i lam spong zhing / /log lta'i dug gis nye bar sbags pa'i yid kyis lam gzhan dag la bstenaskye/ /gang zhig rab rib bsal bas zag pa kun gyi rgyur ni rab gsungs pa/ /log yid khyem na spyod pa rmongs pa'i /krumun nag brgya byin khyod kyis soladu/ /brgya byin mchog ni de dag rnams/ /khyod la bdag cag rnams slong gis/ /dam bcas / don las 'gal ba ni/ /mkhas pas 'dod par mi byed do/ /de nas brgya byin gyis de rnams 'dod pa'i yul dag slong bar mi byed cing ltos pa med la gsal zhing mdzes pa'i tshig gis rnam par 'khrul (bye pas ngo mtshar du ⑪gyur cing yang dag par dad pas lus kyi spu zing zhes byed de/ smras pa / mi 'byor dngos po slong bar gyur pa ni/ /'jig rten dag na bra zhing zhum gyur pas/ /gang 'di bdag gis sbyin par nus pa yi/ /mchog rnams 93—1434

sbyin gyi khye bu mo khyed kyis smros/ /de nas bu mo de rnams kyis de'i nang na mi (byemangon pa'i rgyus rnam par smras pa'i tshig des yang dag par skyo bas nye bar bskyed pa'i khro bas brgya byin la smras pa/ ci phyir nye bar 'drid pa'i thabs dang ni/ /brgya byin mdzem med de dag gang du lhags/ /bde ba tsam dang mi mkhas blo can nam / /mi bsrun pa yi bgrod bya bdag cag min/ /'dir ni phyogs rnams rgya cher grags pa'i tshogs ldan pa'i/ /rgyal po'i rigs su gyur par khyod kyis mi shes sam/ /gang gis nor gyi zusnying po nges par bltas nas ni/ /nor bdag ming yang ji bzhin don dang ldan pa yi/ /rga bas gzir zhing ④'chi ba'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /dub cing yid 'byung zhum pa'i 'jigs spang phyir/ /lha yi mgon po gnas skabs 'dir zhugs kyi snye/ /dregs pas ma yin byes min mi brtan min/ /bsod nams byed pa rnams la 'tshe ba'i phyir/ /gang phyir khyed ko bdag cag sdug bsngal byed/ /gnyen dang mdza' bshes 'khor gyi sbyor ba yi/ /dga' bas brgya byin yun ring 'tsho bar 7gyis/ /rang byas mgo skal ldan pa'i 'bar ba yi/ /gang phyir lha yi bdag por khyod gyur des/ /gzhan gtses rgyu yis lha yi rgyal po yi/ /dam pa'i phun sum tshogs thob mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas dbang po chen po des de'i tshig gsal zhing tshig gi don sna tshogs ston pa'i tshig rnams kyis lus tshim zhing / mchog tu ngo mtshar du gyur la dad pas bzhin rab tu dang zhing mdzes pa dang / gzhan yang de rnams kyis bsam pa sad pa'i phyir shin tu bste stang gyedang bcas pa'i tshig gis smras pa/ kye ma ma dang 'dra ba'i sring mo dag /'jig rten dka' thub can dag kyang / /mgon du bdag ni lta 'dod na/ /ci phyir 'di ltar mchog ster ba/ /nga la khyed rnams brtse med 93—1435

'gyur / /de nas bu mo de rnams lhag par yang 'khrugs shing khro ba dang bcas pas tsho7brgya byin la smras pa/ bde sogs kyis ni bzhin ras la/ /chags byeshing 'dzum dang zur mig gis/ /rnam lta'i gnas ni gzhan yin zhing / /sbyin bya'i mchog kyang gzhan yin no/ /gal te brgya byin khyod kyis ni/ /mchog rab ster bar nus na ni/ /yul rnams kyi ni sha za ni/ /mi srun de las rgyal bar gyis/ /yang na 'dod pa 1spang dka' zhing / /log pa'i rtog 5pas chags gyur na/ /rgyun de nyid la rtag tu gnosakhye/ /gal te nus yod 'di 'drar gyes/ /mig stong ldan khyod mi brtan pa'i/ /'dod la yid ni chags gyur pa/ /khyod ni sbyin bya tha dad na/ /mchog ces pa ni ji ltar smra/ /ji ltar chu bo 'jigs pa yi/ /shugs kyis bdas par gyur pa'i mi/ /gzhan dag bsgral bar bya'o zhes/ /yongs rtogs byed pa'i rmongs pa'i gnas/ /skra rnams byegs par gyur nas ni/ /phyag dar khrod kyi gos 'chang thuzhing / /dgon pa yul du 'dod par ni/ /nam zhig de ltar 'gyur zhig gu/ /gnya' shing gang tsam rnam lta zhing / /sa yi lhung bzed lag thogs nas/ /dpyas mumed khyem nas khyim du ni/ /nam zhig slong mo spyod par 'gyurasnye/ /rnyed dang bkur ste chags med cing / /nyon mongs tsher ma'i 'dam rdzab dag /sbyor ba byed cing grong khyer gyi'u/ /sbyin pa'i gnas su nam zhig 'gyur/ / rtswa yi /bye tshogs las langs nas ni/ /ba mos phyi ba'i gos dag dang / /zas skom ngan ngon tsam gang gis/ /nam zhig lus la chags med 'gyur/ /shing drung ṣpe tso ltar ljang ba'i/ /ngur pa 'jam po'i gos can du/ /mthong chos bde ba'i dga' ston dang / /nam zhig bdag ni nyal bar 'gyur/ /'dor 11bar 'gyur ba'i lus srog la/ /chu dang rtswa yi 93—1436

zil pa ltar/ /ltos med yun ring goms pa yi/ /bde ba chen po nam zhig 'thob—/ /nam zhig ①chu ngogs sman ljongs su/ /gnas nas chu ngogs 'byung 'jig ④dang / /'tsho ①ba'i 'jig rten gnas 'dra bar/ /yang dang yang du lta bar 'gyur/ /lta ba kun gyi mar gyur pa'i/ /'jig tshogs lta ba 'byin pa dang / /srid pa'i longs spyod mi 'dod par/ /bdag ni nam zhig 'gyur zhig gu—/ /rmi lam smig rgyu sgyu ma sprin/ /dri za'i grong khyer mtshungs par ni/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten dag /nam zhig rtogs par byed par 'gyur/ /ming po 'di ltar dga' ba yi/ /re ba'i yid kyis ༄rnam rol pas/ /zang zing bcas shing g.yo ba yi/ /mchog de rnams kyis ci zhig bgyi/ /kye ma mchog rab sbyin par sems gzhan yang / /log par rtog ⑤pa skad cig tsam 'ga' zhig/lha mgon 'dod pa ngo bo nyid kyis pyagayo/ /g.yang sa chen po mun nag bcas 'dra bas/ /sems rgya che ba'i dam pas rnam par spangs/ / mi rigs kyi 'tshe ba kun gyi rgyur gyur cing / /'dod pas mi rnams 'khrul par byed pas na/ /'di ni smad bya 'jigs pa chen po ste/ /mi gtsang bsgos pa'i sbrul nag dag dang mtshungs—/ /gang 'di thog mtha' med nas 'gro ba dang / /'gro bar 'gyur dang gnas pa'i sems can lus/ /de ni gsod 'joms bstan rkyedang mtshungs pas na/ /sdig pa'i gzhir gyur 'dod pas ci zhig bya/ /lha dbang brgya byin 'dod pa'i yul 'di ni/ /phyag dar khrod 'drar byed 'dra'i ngo bo bas /brdzun par rtog cing rnam smin mi bzad pa'i/ /'dod pa yid kyis kyang ni su zhig bstan/ /bai ḍūrya kye sngo ljang skyes pa yi rtswa ⑩dang ni/ /me tog rgyas par gyur pa'i shing gi nags spangs nas/ /lcags kyu rnon pos spyi bor 'tshog cing 'dri ba 93—1437

dang / /glang chen dbang pos khyar skyed yul gyis bslus pa yin/ /mdung rtse lus bskyon grong gi kha ṭwāyi tshogs rnams kyi/ /gshog pa'i rlung gis rab tu g.yob par byed 'gyur ②la/ /mdza' bo rnams kyang g.yo byas mig gis 3lta byed par/ /skyes bu 'jigs par 'gyur ba'ang yul gyis brlag pa yin/ /byis pa log rtog rlung gis rab 'bar 'dod pa yis/ /rang nyid khang pa bdag nyid kyis ni sreg byed na/ /smyig rtebyam lo brgya lon pa phan tshun 'dar ⑩ ba yis/ /rang nyid kyis ni sreg par byed pa ji bzhin no/ /brgya byin gzhan yang rnam rgyal khang par gnas nas ni/ /'od 'phro nor bu'i dpal gyis dga' ba 'di las ni//me chen rang 'u /'bar 'jigs pa'i mnar med sar ⑦phyin pas/ /gang 'di dug can yul gyi bde ba de ni snyebade legs min/ /mtho ris gnas nas 'gro ba ngan pa'i gnas spu'ajug cing / /skad cig gis lhung 'pho ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir pa/ /gang dag pyong 'gyur lha yi 'jig rten mngon dga' ba/ /sngar myong gyur pa de ni bde ba myong ma yin/ /gser gyi padma kha khyer ngang pa nyal ba dang / /gang 'dir lha yi khang pa rdzing bur gru la rgal ⑩ba dag /'dod pa'i las kyis slar yang mi ro rul pa yis/ /gzings pa'i chu bo rab med nang du ltung ⑪bar 'gyur/ /yongs su gyur na dga' bral rmi lam lta bu yi/ /lha rnams bde la de ni brgya byin su zhig 'dod/ /'tsho ba'i 'jig rten khros pa'i sbrul gyis me 7ltar g.yo bar ni/ /thams cad rtog ⑫pas bdag cag thar la gzhol ba gnas / /srid 'gro tshang tshing nang na gnas pa'i byis pa rnams/ /'di bde yin zhes pa de log par brtags tsam ste/ /gang 'di srid pa ma lus sdug bsngal kun bskyed ces/ /yang dag gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /93—1438

'tsho ba'i 'jig rten rang bzhin sdug bsngal mang pos kṇigayengs 'gyur te/ /gang tshe 'di na bde ba myong ba'ang bya rog ta lar mtshungs/ /de yang phrad gyur sdug bsngal du mas zil gyis gnon 'gyur te/ /chu bo'i chu ni rgya mtshor phyin pa dag dang mtshungs/ /gang phyir bud med lag pa 1ge sar bcas pa'i padma'i 'dab 'dra dang / /gdu bu cung zad khrol ba tsan dan bsil bas bsgos par gyur pa yis/ /reg cing zangs ltar dmar bcas sor mo zlum pas brtse bas 'khyud par 1byas pa dang / /bsil yab rlung gi cergyan phreng gtor bas khyab par gnyid log gyur pa dag /'jag ma'i rtse mor bcer ba'i lam du thal ba dang 'dres rlung dmar ni/ /drag pos g.yob cing dub la phyi ba'i lus kyi slar yang nyal 'gyur te/ /de bas 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten skad cig thang cig g.yo bar shes gyis la/ /phongs pa'i 'bras 'byin 'dod pa spongs la tshams khyapa'i zhi la brten par gyis/ /de nas bu mo rnams la mig stong ldan/ /dga' bas lus kyi ba spu ldang 'gyur zhing / /brtson la mngon dga'i sems dang lhan cig gis/ /sum cu rtsa gsum mngon phyogs song bar gyurabhu / /de nas bu mo de rnams rab byung nyer son cing / /de nyid don la rnam brtag 7/blo mig dgang khyegyur pas/ /dregs pa'i chu rlabs g.yo zhing 'jigs par byed pa yi/ /sdug bsngal mtsho chen mtha' med 'khor ba brgal bar gyurashyi/ /'gro ba ma rig mdongs pa kun gyi mig gcig pa/ /rang bzhin 'gro don rnam ⑫byed nges pa'i bdag nyid kyiljo1 / /thub pas sems can rnams la tshul 'di gsungs pas na/ /sems can rnams kyi srid pa'i tsher ma zad par shog /gzhon nu ma bdun gyi rtogs ⑫pa brjod pa/slob dpon gsang ba ⑫byin gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //93—1439

stan mthon po dang / khri stan chen po dang / glu gar dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / phreng ba dang / spos nyug pa dang / rgyan dang kha dog 'chang ba ①las slar zlog par bgyi'o/ /'phags pa dgra bcom pa rnams kyi bslab pa la rjes su slob po 'u/ /rjes su sgrub po1/ /sems kyi rgyan gyi phyir dang / sems kyi yo byad kyi phyir dang / don gyi mchog sangs rgyas nyid rab tu 'grub pa'i slad du/bdag gso sbyong la gnas par slob dpon gyis gzung du gsol/ de ltar lan gnyis lan gsum du'o/ /bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa dang / gso sbyong gi sdom pa'i cho ga'o/ /slob dbon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bkyi ba dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/srog gcod pa spangs te srog gcod pa las bzlog par bgyi'o/ /de bzhin du/ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / phra ma dang / tshig rtsub mo dang / ngag 'khyal ba dang / brnab sems dang / gnod sems dang / log par lta ba las bzlog par bgyi'o/ /de ltar lan gnyis lan gsum du'o zhes pa bslab pa bcu'i cho ga klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas gsungs pa rtse thang ngulo tsā ba gzhon nu'i zhabs kyi 'gyur// //93—1444

na379༄khya/ /ye dharja'i 'grel pa/khye༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ ye dharmāsbyi ka /bod skad du/ ye dharmā'i 'grel pa/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /da ni ye dharmā te tu pra bā wa he hūṃ/zhes bya ba la sogs pas rgyud rab tu gnas pa'i don du grub pa'i mtha' gsungs pa yin te/ 'chad pa po rnams la yang gsungs pa yin no/ /mdo sde dang ni rnal 'byor gyi/ /khang par yang ni 'jug pa nang / /ye dharmā sogs tshigs bcad kyis/ /sangs rgyas grub mtha'i phyag rgyas btab/ /ces so/ /de yang ye dharmā sogs ni bod kyi skad du/ chos rnams gang dag rgyus 'byung de dag ni/ /rgyu dang de la 'gog pa gang yin pa'ang / /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis bka' stsal te/ /de skad gsungs pa'i tshul can dge sbyong che/ /zhes bya ba'o/ /chos rnams gang dag rgyus byung zhes pa la gang dag ni rab tu grags pa bdun po rnams te/ ma rig pa la sogs pa'i lcags sgog gis kun du bskor ba'i 'khor 93—1446

lo ni rgyu dang 'bras bu'i bdag nyid can no/ /de dag ni zhes pa nyon mongs pa dang / las dang sdug bsngal kyi yan lag gsum dang / gnyis dang bdun gyis phye bas gsum du yang gyur pa yin te/ ma rig pa'i thog ma yin par sangs rgyas nyid kyis gsungs pa yin no/ /ma rig pa dang / 'du byed dang /rnam par shes pa dang / ming dang / gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang /reg pa dang / tshor ba dang / sred pa dang / len pa dang / srid pa dang /skye ba dang / rga shi ste bcu gnyis po rnams so/ /ma rig pa ni 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug gi bdag nyid can no/ /'du byed ni sngon gyi las so/ /rnam par shes pa ni mngal du 'jug pa'o/ /ming dang gzugs ni nur nur po la sogs pa lnga'o/ /skye mched drug ni mig la sogs pa la 'dod do—/ /reg pa ni yul dang / dbang po dang / rnam par shes pa rnams phrad pa'o—/ /tshor ba ni bde ba la sogs pa'i bdag nyid can no/ /sred pa ni 'khrig pa'i 'dod chags so/ /len pa ni 'dod pa'i yul len pa'o/ /srid pa ni 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i srid pa'i 'bras bu can gyi las so/ /skye ba ni slar yang phung po nying mtshams sbyor ba'o/ /rga shi ni gsal lo/ /dang po dang /brgyad pa dang / dgu pa rnams ni nyon mongs pa'o/ /las ni gnyis pa dang /bcu pa'o/ /lhag ma bdun ni sdug bsngal lo/ /de gsum gyis bsdus pa'i phyir bcu gnyis ni chos rnams so/ /gsum las gsum dang gnyis las gnyis 'byung la / /bdun las bdun yin pa'i phyir/ de kho na 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rgyu dang 'bras bu yang ste/ 'gro ba thams cad de/ 'dir sems can gzhan ni 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin te/ stong pa 'od zer ltar chos rnams las stong pa'i 93—1447

chos rnams 'byung bar 'gyur te/ kha ton dang / mar me lta bu dag ni rgyu las byung ba'i don du'o/ /rgyu dang de rnams kyi yang de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis bka' zad te zhes pa ni/ de ji ltar thugs su chud pa de bzhin du gsungs pa'i phyir te/ gzhan ma yin par gsung ba nyid kyi phyir 'khor ba'i rgyu dang rkyen gsungs pa yin no/ /de la 'gog pa gang yin pa'ang / /zhes bya ba la/'ang gi sgra las de kho na rgyu dang bsams par gsungs pa yin gyi/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi mya ngan las 'das pa yan lag bcu gnyis 'gog pa'i mtshan nyid kyang gsungs pa yin te/ zung 'jug pa'i bde ba brtags pa nam mkha'i me tog ma yin zhing sems med pa bems po ma yin pa'i rang bzhin no/ /de skad gsungs pa'i tshul can dge spyong che/ /zhes bya ba ni zung du 'jug pa gsung ba'i tshul can yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ phyin ci ma log par gsung ba'i tshul can gyi tshangs pa'i cho ga'o/ /'di ni slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes gsungs pa gzhon nus bsgyur ba'o// //93—1448
